name: Archive files
description: Move selected files to an archive destination volume, optionally leaving a breadcrumb file at the original location.

name: Configure the cold data threshold
description: Set the file property and age that define cold data in AI Data Engine.

name: Configure the stale data threshold
description: Set the file property and age that define stale data in AI Data Engine.

name: Delete files
description: Permanently delete selected files from the investigation view.

name: Find and eliminate duplicate files
description: Find files that have identical copies, act on them and save the filter as a policy.

name: Find cold or stale files
description: Filter unstructured data by last-access time and size to list cold or stale files.

name: Group investigation results by owner
description: Display filtered investigation results grouped by data owner.

name: Identify and act on cold data
description: Take cold data from a dashboard finding through investigation to tagging, archiving or deletion, and optionally save it as a policy.

name: Identify and act on stale data
description: Take stale data from a dashboard finding through investigation to tagging, archiving or deletion, and save the filter as a policy.

name: Identify oversized or unused database tables
description: List the database tables discovered on connected database servers and filter them by discovered time, DB server or schema to find oversized or unused tables that could be reclaimed.

name: Target data cleanup by owner
description: Start from an owner's data on the dashboard, investigate it, decide whether to tag, archive or delete it, and save the filter as a policy.

name: Activate scanning for a data source
description: Activate scans on a connected system so AI Data Engine begins collecting its metadata.

name: Deactivate scanning for a data source
description: Deactivate AI Data Engine for a connected storage system so it is no longer scanned.

name: Enable or disable access to data protection volumes
description: Allow or prevent AI Data Engine from scanning data protection (DP) volumes on a connected system.

name: Enable or disable scanning of individual data resources
description: Turn scanning on or off for specific volumes, shares or buckets of a connected system.

name: Pause scanning of a system
description: Pause AI Data Engine scanning of a connected system.

name: Resume scanning of a system
description: Resume AI Data Engine scanning of a paused system.

name: Run an immediate scan of all data resources on a system
description: Trigger an immediate rescan of every volume, share or bucket on a connected system to refresh its metadata.

name: Copy files
description: Copy selected files from the investigation view to a destination volume.

name: Create a policy
description: Save the current investigation filter set as a named policy to track the matching data over time.

name: Delete a policy
description: Remove an existing policy.

name: Modify a policy
description: Change the name, description or action of an existing policy.

name: View files matching a policy
description: Open the investigation results for the files that currently match a policy.

name: View scan status
description: Review the scan status, progress, coverage and errors of connected systems to confirm scanning is healthy.

name: Tag files
description: Apply tags to selected files in the investigation view.

name: Monitor data that exceeds the retention threshold
description: Find files older than the retention threshold, review them with stakeholders, and create a monitor-only or email-notification policy that alerts on new files reaching the threshold.

name: Assign an AI Data Engine role to a user
description: Grant a Console member the AI Data Engine administrator or viewer role at the organization, folder or project level.

name: Find broadly accessible directories
description: Filter directories by open permissions to surface paths accessible across the organization.

name: Modify CIFS credentials of a data source
description: Update the SMB/CIFS credentials AI Data Engine uses to scan a connected system.

name: Add a data source
description: Connect a storage system as a data source to AI Data Engine by entering its connection details.

name: Deploy AI Data Engine Enterprise
description: Deploy the Enterprise edition of AI Data Engine from NetApp Console using the deployment wizard and install command.

name: Deploy AI Data Engine Lite
description: Deploy the Lite edition of AI Data Engine from NetApp Console using the deployment wizard and install command.

name: Retry failed scans
description: Rerun all failed scans for a connected system.

name: Configure a connection between Workflow Automation and Unified Manager
description: Sets up the database user and Workflow Automation credentials so Unified Manager can use Workflow Automation for protection workflows.

name: Configure a connection to an external data provider
description: Sets up the Unified Manager server to send performance statistics to an external data provider server through the maintenance console.

name: Create a database user
description: Creates a database user with the Integration Schema role so that Workflow Automation or other tools can access Unified Manager database views.

name: Enable or disable script upload
description: Turns the ability to upload and run alert scripts on or off in Unified Manager feature settings.

name: Remove the Workflow Automation setup from Unified Manager
description: Removes the configured Workflow Automation integration from Unified Manager.

name: Verify Unified Manager data source acquisition in Workflow Automation
description: Confirms that Workflow Automation successfully acquires and caches data from the Unified Manager data source.

name: Check cluster health in a MetroCluster configuration
description: Reviews MetroCluster events, connectivity and replication status to determine the health of clusters in a MetroCluster configuration.

name: Monitor MetroCluster connectivity
description: The connectivity status and issues between components of a MetroCluster configuration are displayed.

name: Monitor MetroCluster replication
description: The replication status of a MetroCluster configuration is displayed.

name: Perform a protection relationship failover and failback
description: Fails over to the destination by breaking the relationship, then reverses and resynchronizes to fail back to the original source.

name: View consistency group LUN relationships
description: Displays the protection relationships of LUNs that belong to consistency groups.

name: Calculate reclaimable space for Snapshot copies
description: Calculates how much space would be reclaimed by deleting selected Snapshot copies of a volume.

name: Create or modify a Storage Efficiency Policy
description: A custom Storage Efficiency Policy with specific efficiency characteristics is created or an existing one is edited.

name: Resolve a volume space full issue
description: Investigates a Volume Space Full event and applies suggested remedial actions to free or add capacity.

name: View FabricPool capacity
description: Displays capacity and cloud tier usage information for FabricPool aggregates and volumes.

name: View user and group quotas
description: The user and user group quota usage for a storage VM is displayed.

name: Access the maintenance console
description: Logs in to the Unified Manager maintenance console to perform maintenance functions not available in the web UI.

name: Add disk space to the data directory
description: Increase the disk space available to the Unified Manager data or database directory on the Linux host, VMware VM, or Windows server.

name: Change the Unified Manager host name
description: Changes the host name of the Unified Manager server and regenerates its HTTPS certificate to match the new name.

name: Enable or disable policy-based storage management
description: Turns the policy-based storage management feature on or off in Unified Manager feature settings.

name: Modify monitored cluster settings
description: The connection settings of a monitored cluster, such as host name, credentials or protocol, are changed.

name: Rediscover clusters
description: Unified Manager rediscovers monitored clusters to refresh their inventory and status.

name: Remove a monitored cluster
description: A cluster is removed from Unified Manager monitoring.

name: Restart the Unified Manager virtual machine
description: Reboots the Unified Manager virtual appliance from the maintenance console.

name: Restart Unified Manager services
description: The Unified Manager and associated MySQL services are stopped and started again in the required order.

name: Abort a protection job
description: Stops a running protection job.

name: Abort a protection relationship transfer
description: Stops an active data protection transfer, optionally clearing its restart checkpoint.

name: Add aggregates to a resource pool
description: Adds one or more aggregates as members of an existing resource pool.

name: Break a SnapMirror relationship
description: Breaks a SnapMirror relationship so the destination volume becomes writable.

name: Change the Unified Manager backup type
description: Unconfigures NetApp Snapshot backup so Unified Manager switches to a different backup method.

name: Configure database dump backup settings
description: Sets the backup path, retention count and schedule for Unified Manager MySQL database dump backups.

name: Configure destination efficiency settings for a protection relationship
description: Enables or disables deduplication, compression, autogrow and space guarantee on the destination volume while configuring SnapMirror or SnapVault protection.

name: Configure Snapshot-based backup for Unified Manager
description: Configures Unified Manager to back up its database with NetApp Snapshot copies on an ONTAP volume, including the destination storage VM and volume and any required ONTAP LUN and host iSCSI setup.

name: Create a cascade or fanout protection relationship
description: Extends an existing SnapMirror relationship with an additional relationship from its source (fanout) or from its destination (cascade).

name: Create a resource pool
description: Creates a named resource pool of aggregates to be used as protection destinations.

name: Create a SnapMirror or SnapVault schedule
description: Creates a named basic or advanced schedule for SnapMirror or SnapVault transfers.

name: Create a SnapMirror policy
description: Creates a SnapMirror policy that sets the transfer priority and other settings for mirror relationships.

name: Create a SnapMirror relationship
description: Protects a volume by creating a SnapMirror relationship to a destination volume.

name: Create a SnapVault policy
description: Creates a SnapVault policy with transfer priority and Snapshot copy retention labels for vault relationships.

name: Create a SnapVault relationship
description: Protects a volume by creating a SnapVault backup relationship to a secondary volume.

name: Create a storage VM association
description: Associates a source storage VM with destination storage VMs for SnapMirror or SnapVault relationship creation.

name: Create a version-flexible SnapMirror relationship
description: Creates a SnapMirror relationship using version-flexible replication so source and destination can run different ONTAP versions.

name: Create a version-flexible SnapMirror relationship with backup option
description: Creates a version-flexible SnapMirror relationship that also retains multiple Snapshot copies on the destination for backup.

name: Define the Snapshot backup schedule for Unified Manager
description: Sets the daily or weekly schedule and retention count for Unified Manager Snapshot copy backups.

name: Delete a resource pool
description: Deletes a resource pool from Unified Manager.

name: Delete a storage VM association
description: Removes one or more storage VM associations.

name: Delete Snapshot copies
description: Deletes selected Snapshot copies of a volume to free space.

name: Initialize or update a protection relationship
description: Starts a baseline transfer or an incremental update for one or more protection relationships with chosen transfer priority, rate and source Snapshot copy.

name: Modify a protection relationship
description: Changes the maximum transfer rate, protection policy or schedule of one or more protection relationships.

name: Modify a resource pool
description: Changes the name and description of an existing resource pool.

name: Quiesce a protection relationship
description: Suspends scheduled transfers for one or more protection relationships.

name: Remove a protection relationship
description: Permanently removes the protection relationship between source and destination volumes.

name: Remove aggregates from a resource pool
description: Removes one or more member aggregates from a resource pool.

name: Restore Unified Manager from a MySQL database dump backup
description: Restores the Unified Manager database from a MySQL database dump backup file using the maintenance console.

name: Restore Unified Manager from a Snapshot backup
description: Restores the Unified Manager database from a NetApp Snapshot copy backup using the maintenance console.

name: Restore volume data from a Snapshot copy
description: Restores a volume or selected files and directories from a Snapshot copy of the volume or its protection destination.

name: Resume scheduled transfers on a quiesced protection relationship
description: Restarts scheduled transfers for one or more quiesced protection relationships.

name: Resynchronize a protection relationship
description: Re-establishes a broken or quiesced protection relationship in its original direction with chosen transfer options.

name: Retry a failed protection job
description: Reruns a failed protection configuration or protection relationship operation job.

name: Reverse a protection relationship
description: Reverse-resynchronizes a broken relationship so the former destination becomes the source.

name: Set up protection relationships
description: Prepares Unified Manager and Workflow Automation, creates policies and schedules, and creates SnapMirror or SnapVault protection relationships end to end.

name: View resource pools
description: Displays the inventory of resource pools and their capacity and member aggregates.

name: View Snapshot copies
description: Displays the list of Snapshot copies of a volume.

name: View storage VM protection relationships
description: Displays storage VM disaster recovery protection relationships and their health.

name: View volume protection relationships
description: Displays the protection relationships of volumes and their details.

name: View volume protection status
description: Shows the data protection status of volumes on all or selected clusters from the dashboard.

name: View volume encryption status
description: Displays the encryption type and status of all monitored volumes.

name: Modify an NFS file share to support CIFS
description: An existing NFS file share workload is updated with ACL details so it can also be accessed over CIFS.

name: View NFS share details
description: Displays details of NFS shares on monitored clusters or storage VMs.

name: View SMB share details
description: Displays details of SMB/CIFS shares on monitored clusters or storage VMs.

name: Add a vCenter Server
description: A vCenter Server is added to (or its connection updated in) Unified Manager so its virtual machines can be monitored.

name: Remove a vCenter Server
description: A vCenter Server is removed from Unified Manager monitoring.

name: Acknowledge and resolve events
description: Selected events are acknowledged, annotated with notes and marked resolved.

name: Add a cluster
description: Adds an ONTAP cluster to Unified Manager so that it is discovered and monitored.

name: Add a script
description: A script file is uploaded to Unified Manager so it can be associated with alerts.

name: Add a value to an annotation
description: Adds a new value to an existing annotation.

name: Add an alert
description: Create an alert rule that sends notifications when specified events (health, performance or security) occur on selected storage objects.

name: Add correlated objects to performance comparison charts
description: Adds objects from the Performance Explorer objects grid to the Comparing pane so their counter charts are graphed together, and hides, shows or removes them as needed.

name: Analyze a dynamic performance event in a MetroCluster configuration
description: Determines the cause of a dynamic performance event on a MetroCluster cluster, reviewing victim and bully workloads on the local cluster and events on the partner cluster.

name: Assign an annotation to a storage object
description: Manually applies an annotation name-value pair to selected storage objects.

name: Assign events to users
description: Selected events are assigned to a specific user for follow-up.

name: Assign performance threshold policies to storage objects
description: Applies one or more user-defined performance threshold policies to selected storage objects from their performance inventory page.

name: Change the performance statistics collection interval
description: Changes how often Unified Manager polls clusters for performance statistics (5, 10 or 15 minutes) from the maintenance console.

name: Compare performance of volumes or LUNs in the same QoS policy group
description: Charts the IOPS, MB/s or IOPS/TB of all volumes or LUNs that share a QoS policy group together to find workloads that use too much of the shared limit.

name: Configure data retention settings
description: The number of months Unified Manager retains event and performance data before deleting it is set.

name: Configure event notification settings
description: Sets the SMTP server, sender address and connection security used to send event and alert notifications.

name: Configure global aggregate health thresholds
description: Sets the default capacity, growth and Snapshot copy health thresholds applied to all aggregates.

name: Configure global qtree health thresholds
description: Sets the default capacity health thresholds applied to all qtrees.

name: Configure global volume health thresholds
description: Sets the default capacity, Snapshot copy, quota, growth and inode health thresholds applied to all volumes.

name: Configure lag thresholds for protection relationships
description: Sets the global warning and error lag time thresholds for unmanaged protection relationships.

name: Configure Unified Manager to send alert notifications
description: Sets up event notification settings, remote authentication, authentication servers, users and alerts so that Unified Manager sends alert notifications.

name: Create a custom aggregate report
description: A report view or Excel chart is created showing aggregate capacity or performance, such as aggregates nearly full, overcommitted or with the most available IOPS.

name: Create a custom cluster storage report
description: A report view is created showing cluster, HA pair or node storage information, such as unallocated LUN capacity, capacity by model, available HA pair capacity or nodes running older ONTAP.

name: Create a custom NFS share report
description: A report view is created showing NFS shares with inaccessible mount paths or using the default export policy.

name: Create a custom qtree report
description: A report view is created showing qtrees that are nearly full.

name: Create a custom storage VM report
description: A report view is created showing stopped storage VMs or storage VMs approaching their maximum volume count.

name: Create a custom volume relationship report
description: A report view is created showing volume protection relationships grouped or sorted by issue, failure source, transfer status, duration, size or day.

name: Create a custom volume report
description: A report view or Excel chart is created showing volume capacity or performance, such as volumes nearing capacity, with thin provisioning disabled, or with cold data suitable for the cloud tier.

name: Create a group
description: Creates a named group for organizing storage objects.

name: Create a group action
description: Creates a group action that applies volume health threshold settings to all volumes in a group.

name: Create a group rule
description: Creates a rule with conditions that automatically adds matching storage objects to a group.

name: Create a quota email notification format
description: The sender, subject and body format of email notifications sent for user and group quota events are defined.

name: Create a user-defined performance threshold policy
description: Creates a new performance threshold policy, or one cloned from an existing policy, with the counter threshold values that should raise events.

name: Create an annotation
description: Creates a custom annotation with a name, description and optional values for use in annotation rules.

name: Create an annotation rule
description: Creates an annotation rule with conditions that automatically applies an annotation value to matching storage objects.

name: Create and schedule a custom report
description: A sample report view is created, customized, saved and scheduled for weekly email delivery.

name: Create quota email address rules
description: Rules are defined that generate email addresses for users and user groups exceeding quota limits.

name: Customize a report using Excel
description: A saved view is downloaded as an Excel workbook and customized with Excel features for use as a report.

name: Customize a report view
description: An inventory view is customized by showing, hiding or reordering columns, filtering, sorting or searching, and saved as a named report view.

name: Delete a group
description: Removes a group from Unified Manager.

name: Delete a group action
description: Removes a group action so it no longer applies to the group's members.

name: Delete a group rule
description: Removes a group rule so it no longer populates the group.

name: Delete a report schedule
description: A report schedule is deleted.

name: Delete a script
description: A script that is no longer needed is removed from Unified Manager.

name: Delete a value from an annotation
description: Removes a value from an existing annotation.

name: Delete an alert
description: Selected alerts are deleted.

name: Delete an annotation
description: Removes a custom annotation and its values.

name: Delete an annotation rule
description: Removes an annotation rule so it no longer annotates storage objects.

name: Determine storage object issues using events
description: Events for storage objects are queried through the API, analysed, and the underlying issues resolved.

name: Disable events
description: Disable unwanted events so they are no longer generated, including specific security events.

name: Edit a user-defined performance threshold policy
description: Changes the threshold settings of an existing user-defined performance threshold policy.

name: Edit health thresholds for specific aggregates
description: Overrides the global health threshold settings for one or more selected aggregates.

name: Edit health thresholds for specific qtrees
description: Overrides the global capacity threshold settings for one or more selected qtrees.

name: Edit health thresholds for specific volumes
description: Overrides the global health threshold settings for one or more selected volumes.

name: Enable or disable Active IQ platform event reporting
description: Generation and display of Active IQ platform events in Unified Manager is turned on or off.

name: Enable or disable alerts for resolved and obsolete events
description: A global setting controls whether alerts are sent when events move to the Resolved or Obsolete state.

name: Expand or collapse the counter charts pane
description: Expands or reduces the Counter Charts pane on the Performance Explorer page.

name: Export a report
description: The data in an inventory view is downloaded as a CSV, PDF or Excel report.

name: Filter performance inventory page data
description: Narrows the rows shown on an object inventory or performance inventory page by applying object, operator and value filter criteria.

name: Generate a hardware inventory report
description: Produces a hardware inventory report of monitored nodes for use in support contract renewal.

name: Identify workloads involved in a dynamic performance event
description: Shows which bully, shark or victim workloads caused or were affected by a dynamic performance event, using the Event details charts.

name: Modify a group
description: Changes the name or description of an existing group.

name: Modify a group action
description: Changes the name, description, group or threshold settings of an existing group action.

name: Modify a group rule
description: Changes the name, associated group, object type or conditions of an existing group rule.

name: Modify a report schedule
description: The name, recipients, frequency or format of an existing report schedule is changed.

name: Modify an alert
description: An existing alert's name, resources, events or actions are changed.

name: Modify an annotation rule
description: Changes the name, annotation, value or conditions of an existing annotation rule.

name: Modify or cancel a cluster maintenance window
description: The start or end time of a scheduled maintenance window is changed, or the window is cancelled.

name: Modify user and group quota email addresses
description: The email address used to notify a user or user group about quota events is changed.

name: Move workloads to a different aggregate
description: Finds the least-used aggregate in the cluster and moves high-performing volumes to it from an overloaded aggregate.

name: Move workloads to a node in a different HA pair
description: Finds a less-busy node and aggregate in a different HA pair of the same cluster, then moves high-performing volumes there to relieve an overloaded HA pair.

name: Move workloads to an aggregate on a different node
description: Finds the least-used node or the one with the most free performance capacity and an aggregate on it, then moves high-performing volumes there to relieve an overloaded node.

name: Open a counter chart in zoom view
description: Opens a selected performance counter chart in a separate, larger Zoom View browser window.

name: Plan node failover using the performance capacity used breakdown chart
description: Uses the Perf. Capacity Used breakdown chart on the Node Failover Planning page to predict whether a partner node can handle the load if the node fails.

name: Remove performance threshold policies from storage objects
description: Clears assigned user-defined performance threshold policies from selected storage objects so they are no longer monitored against those thresholds.

name: Reorder annotation rules
description: Changes the order in which annotation rules are applied to storage objects.

name: Reorder group actions
description: Changes the order in which group actions are applied.

name: Respond to a cluster imbalance performance event
description: Analyzes a cluster imbalance event and identifies high-performing volumes to move from the most loaded node to the least loaded node.

name: Respond to a dynamic QoS throttling performance event
description: Analyzes a dynamic performance event caused by QoS policy group throttling to find the throttled workloads and decide whether to change the QoS limit.

name: Respond to a node resource overutilization event
description: Analyzes a node overutilization event using the system diagnosis charts and applies the suggested actions to reduce node load.

name: Respond to a performance event caused by disk failure
description: Analyzes a dynamic performance event caused by a failed disk and RAID reconstruction to identify the affected and bully workloads.

name: Respond to a performance event caused by HA takeover
description: Analyzes a dynamic performance event caused by an HA takeover to confirm the cause and decide on remedial action such as giveback.

name: Respond to a QoS policy group performance event
description: Analyzes a system-defined QoS policy group event where workloads exceed their QoS limit and applies the suggested actions.

name: Respond to a system-defined performance threshold event
description: Analyzes a performance event raised by a system-defined threshold, reviewing the system diagnosis and suggested actions to resolve the breach.

name: Respond to a user-defined performance threshold event
description: Analyzes an event raised when a user-defined threshold policy is breached and determines whether action is needed.

name: Schedule a cluster maintenance window
description: A maintenance window is scheduled for a cluster so that its event notifications are suppressed during planned maintenance.

name: Schedule a report
description: A report schedule is created so a saved or imported report is emailed to recipients at a set frequency and format.

name: Search for storage objects
description: Storage objects are located by name using the global search, optionally limited to one object type.

name: Search performance inventory pages
description: Finds specific objects on an object performance inventory page by searching for names or text.

name: Select the counter charts to display
description: Adds or removes performance counter charts shown in the Performance Explorer Counter Charts pane.

name: Set the time range of performance charts
description: Changes the period shown in Performance Explorer and Zoom View counter charts, whether by picking a predefined range, a custom date and time range, or by zooming into a shorter period.

name: Show or hide threshold policies in counter chart zoom view
description: Shows or hides the threshold lines of assigned performance threshold policies in a Counter Charts Zoom View chart.

name: Sort performance inventory page data
description: Sorts the rows of an object performance inventory page by a selected column in ascending or descending order.

name: Subscribe to ONTAP EMS events
description: Unified Manager is subscribed to receive specific ONTAP EMS events from monitored clusters.

name: Test an alert
description: A test notification is sent for an alert to confirm it is configured correctly.

name: Test script execution
description: A script associated with an alert is confirmed to run correctly when the alert is tested.

name: Troubleshoot a workload with the workload analyzer
description: Uses the workload analyzer to review a workload's events, performance statistics and analytics over a chosen time range to diagnose performance problems.

name: Upload an Active IQ rules file
description: A new Active IQ rules file is manually uploaded so the latest platform event rules are used at a site without internet access.

name: View aggregates
description: Displays the list of monitored aggregates with their health details and related objects.

name: View alerts
description: The configured alerts are listed on the Alert Setup page.

name: View annotations
description: Displays the list of annotations and the details and values associated with each.

name: View clusters
description: List the clusters monitored by Unified Manager and view their details.

name: View events
description: List events and view event details, optionally filtered by event type such as performance or security events.

name: View management actions
description: The status of running, completed and failed remediation management actions is displayed.

name: View node IOPS by local and total workloads
description: Compares a node's IOPS from local workloads with its total IOPS in the Node Explorer charts to find indirect I/O traffic.

name: View nodes
description: Displays the list of monitored nodes with their health and detail information.

name: View performance capacity charts
description: Displays the performance capacity and performance capacity used counter charts for a node or aggregate in Performance Explorer.

name: View performance of All SAN Array clusters
description: Identifies clusters with the All SAN Array personality and displays their performance inventory and Performance Explorer details.

name: View performance threshold policies
description: Lists the defined performance threshold policies and their settings on the Performance Event Thresholds page.

name: View protection jobs
description: Displays protection jobs with their state and the details of their tasks.

name: View QoS policy group settings
description: Displays the configuration of traditional and adaptive QoS policy groups on monitored clusters, including the policy group applied to a specific volume or LUN.

name: View report schedules
description: Existing report schedules are listed and searched on the Report Schedules page.

name: View storage pool details
description: Displays the details of a storage pool used as cache by an aggregate.

name: View storage VMs
description: List the monitored storage VMs and view their health details and related objects. You can filter the list, for example by protection status.

name: View SVM IOPS by protocol
description: Displays an SVM's IOPS broken down by protocol in the SVM Explorer charts.

name: View virtual machine topology
description: The expanded topology and I/O path of a virtual machine from host to storage are displayed for latency analysis.

name: View volume and LUN latency to verify a performance guarantee
description: Uses hourly average latency charts for volumes or LUNs to confirm that workloads meet their guaranteed latency.

name: View volume latency by cluster component
description: Displays a volume's latency broken down by cluster component in the Volume Explorer latency chart.

name: View volumes
description: Displays the list of monitored volumes with their health details and related objects.

name: View volumes or LUNs in a QoS policy group
description: Lists the volumes and LUNs assigned to a specific traditional or adaptive QoS policy group.

name: View workload QoS minimum and maximum settings
description: Displays a volume or LUN's QoS minimum and maximum limits as lines on its IOPS and MB/s charts in Performance Explorer.

name: Add a network interface
description: Enables an additional network interface on the Unified Manager virtual appliance from the maintenance console.

name: Bookmark a Help topic
description: A Help topic is added to the favorites list for quick access.

name: View anti-ransomware status of volumes and storage VMs
description: Displays the anti-ransomware detection status of monitored volumes and storage VMs.

name: Add a user
description: Adds a local user, remote user or remote group to Unified Manager and assigns it a role.

name: Add an authentication server
description: Adds a remote authentication server so that its users and groups can be authenticated by Unified Manager.

name: Change the JBoss password
description: The JBoss instance password used by Unified Manager is changed with the services stopped and restarted.

name: Change the local user password
description: Changes the signed-in local user's own login password from the web UI.

name: Change the maintenance user password
description: Changes or resets the password of the Unified Manager maintenance (umadmin) user.

name: Change the SAML identity provider
description: Replaces the SAML identity provider URI and metadata that Unified Manager uses for SAML authentication.

name: Configure audit log settings
description: Sets the maximum audit log file size, total audit log size and retention period for Unified Manager audit logging.

name: Customize security compliance settings
description: Enables or disables the individual security compliance checks evaluated for clusters and storage VMs on the security dashboard.

name: Delete an authentication server
description: Removes one or more remote authentication servers from Unified Manager.

name: Delete users or groups
description: Removes one or more local users, remote users or remote groups from Unified Manager.

name: Disable nested group lookup for remote authentication
description: Turns off nested group lookup so that remote authentication only resolves direct group membership.

name: Disable SAML authentication
description: Turns off SAML authentication so that Unified Manager restarts using its standard login.

name: Download an HTTPS certificate signing request
description: Generates and saves a certificate signing request file to submit to a certificate authority.

name: Enable remote authentication
description: Enables remote authentication and selects and configures the authentication service (Active Directory, OpenLDAP or other) that Unified Manager uses to authenticate remote users and groups.

name: Enable remote logging of audit logs
description: Sends Unified Manager audit logs to a remote syslog server identified by host name, port and server CA certificate.

name: Enable SAML authentication
description: Enables SAML authentication against an identity provider so that users sign in through single sign-on.

name: Generate an HTTPS security certificate
description: Regenerates the self-signed HTTPS security certificate of the Unified Manager server.

name: Install a CA-signed HTTPS certificate
description: Uploads and installs a CA-signed HTTPS security certificate on the Unified Manager server.

name: Modify an authentication server
description: Changes the settings, such as the port, of an existing remote authentication server.

name: Modify user settings
description: Changes the settings, such as email address or role, of an existing Unified Manager user or group.

name: Regenerate the client certificate
description: Regenerates the Unified Manager client certificate from the maintenance console.

name: Set the maximum session timeout
description: Sets the maximum duration of a Unified Manager session after which it is terminated regardless of activity.

name: Set the session inactivity timeout
description: Sets how long an idle web UI session can remain inactive before it is terminated.

name: Test the authentication server configuration
description: Confirms that a remote user or group can be authenticated through the configured authentication servers.

name: Update SAML authentication after a security certificate change
description: Disables and reconfigures SAML authentication so that it works with a changed Unified Manager HTTPS certificate.

name: View cluster user authentication status
description: Displays how monitored clusters authenticate users, including counts of users per authentication method.

name: View security status of clusters and storage VMs
description: Displays the security compliance status and parameters of monitored clusters and storage VMs.

name: View the HTTPS security certificate
description: Displays the details of the HTTPS security certificate installed on the Unified Manager server.

name: View users
description: Lists the users and groups that can access Unified Manager with their roles and types.

name: Access the web UI
description: Open and log in to the Unified Manager web UI.

name: Configure SELinux context for a mounted Unified Manager directory
description: The SELinux context is set correctly for /opt/netapp (and /opt/netapp/data) when they are mounted from NFS or CIFS shares.

name: Configure the EPEL repository
description: The Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux repository is configured on the Linux host so Unified Manager prerequisites can be installed.

name: Configure the MySQL repository
description: The MySQL community repository is configured on the Linux host so the required MySQL version can be installed for Unified Manager.

name: Create the umadmin user and maintenance group
description: A maintenance group and umadmin user with a custom home directory and password are created on the Linux host before installing Unified Manager.

name: Download the Unified Manager software package
description: The Unified Manager installation or upgrade file for the target platform is downloaded from the NetApp Support Site and its checksum verified.

name: Install the 7-zip software package
description: The 7-zip package required by Unified Manager is installed on the Linux host.

name: Install Unified Manager
description: Unified Manager is installed and running on a supported host, either as a VMware virtual appliance or on a Linux or Windows server.

name: Perform the initial setup of the web UI
description: Completes the first-login setup of Unified Manager, including maintenance user email, AutoSupport, default password change, API gateway and cluster addition.

name: Create or modify a Performance Service Level
description: A custom Performance Service Level with specific performance objectives is created or an existing one is edited.

name: Provision a file share volume
description: A file share (NFS or CIFS) volume workload is provisioned with capacity, Performance Service Level and efficiency settings.

name: Provision a LUN
description: A LUN workload is provisioned on a storage VM supporting iSCSI or FCP with capacity and Performance Service Level settings.

name: Provision a storage workload
description: A new storage workload is created from the All Workloads view.

name: Enable periodic AutoSupport
description: Enables Unified Manager to send AutoSupport data to technical support periodically, optionally through an HTTP proxy.

name: Fix issues using automatic remediation
description: Issues that Unified Manager can remediate are fixed directly from the dashboard or event details using Fix It.

name: Resolve a Manageability SDK log rotation issue
description: Manageability SDK log rotation on the Windows host is fixed by installing the required Logrotate version.

name: Resolve protection relationship lag issues
description: Investigates and corrects a SnapMirror relationship whose lag time exceeds its threshold.

name: Resolve storage failover interconnect link down conditions
description: Finds storage failover interconnect link down events and takes corrective action using HA details.

name: Retrieve a support bundle to a client system
description: Copies a generated support bundle from the Unified Manager server to a local client system over SFTP/SCP.

name: Send a support bundle to technical support
description: Generates a full or light diagnostic support bundle and uploads it to NetApp technical support.

name: Send an on-demand AutoSupport message
description: Sends an AutoSupport message on demand to technical support or a specified email recipient.

name: Troubleshoot a failed protection job
description: Identifies the cause of a protection job failure event and performs corrective actions to resolve it.

name: Troubleshoot an offline volume
description: Investigates a Volume Offline event to determine whether a down node, stopped storage VM or broken disks caused it and resolve the issue.

name: Migrate a Unified Manager virtual appliance to a Linux system
description: Moves a Unified Manager virtual appliance deployment, including its database backup, to a Unified Manager installation on a Linux system.

name: Remove the umadmin user and maintenance group
description: The custom umadmin user and maintenance group are deleted from the Linux host after Unified Manager is removed.

name: Uninstall third-party prerequisite software from the Unified Manager host
description: Third-party products left behind after removing Unified Manager, such as Microsoft Visual C++ or Python, are uninstalled from the Windows host.

name: Uninstall Unified Manager
description: Unified Manager software (or its virtual appliance VM) is removed from the host.

name: Upgrade OpenJDK on the Unified Manager host
description: The OpenJDK runtime used by Unified Manager is upgraded to a newer version with the Unified Manager services stopped and restarted.

name: Upgrade the host operating system of the Unified Manager server
description: Unified Manager is moved to a server running a newer Red Hat Enterprise Linux major version by installing it on a new host and restoring a backup.

name: Upgrade Unified Manager
description: The Unified Manager software is upgraded to a newer release on its existing host.

name: Add an Amazon S3 bucket
description: Creates a new Amazon S3 bucket from the Amazon S3 system in the NetApp Console.

name: View Amazon S3 buckets
description: Displays the Amazon S3 buckets discovered in the Amazon S3 system in the NetApp Console.

name: Access the Astra API reference documentation
description: The online Astra REST API reference is opened from the API access page.

name: Create an API token
description: A new Astra API token is generated and saved for use with the REST API.

name: Issue an Astra REST API call
description: An Astra REST API call is run with an API token, either from the API reference page or as a curl example in Bash.

name: Revoke an API token
description: One or more Astra API tokens are revoked so they can no longer be used.

name: Fail back an app to the original source cluster
description: A failed-over app is resynchronized and returned to run on its original source cluster.

name: Fail over a replicated app
description: A replicated app is brought online on the destination cluster.

name: Promote a secondary PVC during a planned failover
description: The secondary PVC of a volume mirror relationship is promoted for use after a planned failover.

name: Protect Astra Control Center using Astra Control Center
description: An Astra Control Center instance is protected by a second instance through backup and restore or replication.

name: Restore a volume mirror relationship after a failover
description: A TridentMirrorRelationship is re-established after a failover so the volumes mirror again.

name: Resync a failed-over app replication relationship
description: A failed-over app replication relationship is resynchronized from the chosen source app instance.

name: Reverse app replication
description: The direction of an app replication relationship is reversed so the destination becomes the source.

name: Configure BlueXP for a Cloud Volumes ONTAP storage backend
description: BlueXP credentials, connector and working environment are set up so Cloud Volumes ONTAP can serve as the Astra Control Center storage backend.

name: Enable dynamic Azure NetApp Files pools
description: Dynamic Azure NetApp Files pools are enabled for self-managed clusters so backups and restores can use ANF.

name: Add a cluster
description: A Kubernetes cluster is added to Astra Control with a kubeconfig credential and brought under management.

name: Close an Astra account
description: The Astra account is closed after apps and clusters are unmanaged and credentials removed.

name: Unmanage a cluster
description: A Kubernetes cluster is removed from Astra Control management.

name: View clouds
description: The clouds defined and available to the Astra account are listed.

name: View clusters
description: Clusters known to Astra Control are listed, or the health and details of one cluster are displayed.

name: Add a bucket
description: An existing object storage bucket is added to Astra Control as a backup target.

name: Add an execution hook script
description: A script is uploaded to the account so execution hooks can use it.

name: Cancel an app backup
description: A backup of a managed app that is in progress is cancelled.

name: Clone an app
description: A managed app is cloned to the same or another cluster from its current state, a snapshot or a backup.

name: Create a mirrored PVC
description: A persistent volume claim is replicated with SnapMirror to a secondary cluster through a TridentMirrorRelationship.

name: Create a protection policy
description: A protection policy schedules snapshots and backups for a managed app with retention settings.

name: Create a scheduled backup of an entire cluster
description: A toolkit is installed to schedule backups of all or selected namespaces in a cluster.

name: Create an app backup
description: An on-demand backup of a managed app is created in a bucket.

name: Create an app replication relationship
description: SnapMirror replication of a managed app to another cluster and storage backend is configured.

name: Create an app snapshot
description: An on-demand snapshot of a managed app is created.

name: Create an execution hook
description: A custom execution hook is added to a managed app to run a script around data protection operations.

name: Delete an app backup
description: One or more backups of a managed app are deleted.

name: Delete an app replication relationship
description: An app replication relationship between storage backends is deleted.

name: Delete an app snapshot
description: One or more snapshots of a managed app are deleted.

name: Delete an execution hook
description: An execution hook is deleted from a managed app.

name: Delete an execution hook script
description: A script is removed from the account.

name: Disable an execution hook
description: An execution hook of a managed app is disabled.

name: Disable the execution hooks feature
description: The execution hooks feature is turned off for the account.

name: Edit a bucket
description: The settings of a bucket, other than its type, are changed.

name: Edit an execution hook
description: The settings of an execution hook of a managed app are changed.

name: Enable backup and restore for ontap-nas-economy volumes
description: Snapshot directories are enabled on ONTAP and in the provisioner so apps using ontap-nas-economy volumes can be backed up and restored.

name: Enable the execution hooks feature
description: The execution hooks feature is turned on so execution hooks can be created and run.

name: Recover volume data from a snapshot
description: A persistent volume is restored in place from a volume snapshot with a TridentActionSnapshotRestore custom resource.

name: Remove a bucket
description: A bucket is removed from Astra Control.

name: Replicate a primary PVC to a new secondary PVC
description: The existing secondary of a volume mirror relationship is replaced by a new secondary PVC.

name: Restore an app
description: A managed app is restored from a snapshot or backup, optionally filtering the resources restored.

name: Set the default bucket
description: A bucket is set as the default backup target for a cloud instance.

name: View app backups
description: The backups created for a managed app are listed.

name: View app snapshots
description: The snapshots taken for a managed app are listed.

name: View buckets
description: The buckets defined for the Astra account are listed.

name: View execution hook scripts
description: The scripts in the account are listed, including which execution hooks use each one.

name: View execution hooks
description: The execution hooks defined for a managed app are listed.

name: Create a storage backend with in-flight encryption
description: A Trident storage backend is created with a configuration that encrypts traffic between the cluster and storage.

name: Create a storage class for an encrypted storage backend
description: A Kubernetes storage class is created that provisions volumes from an encrypted storage backend.

name: Define an app to manage
description: A namespace or a set of Kubernetes resources is defined as an app that Astra Control manages.

name: Unmanage an app
description: An app is removed from Astra Control management.

name: View apps
description: Managed apps are listed, or the health and details of one app are displayed.

name: View namespaces
description: The namespaces available to Astra Control are listed.

name: Add a license
description: An Astra Control Center license file is added to enable full functionality.

name: Update a license
description: An existing Astra Control Center license is replaced with a newly downloaded license file.

name: Check the state of an execution hook
description: The state of execution hooks running with in-progress snapshots or backups is displayed.

name: Configure Prometheus
description: A Prometheus server is configured to scrape Astra Control Center cluster metrics.

name: Connect to Fluentd
description: Astra Control Center is connected to a Fluentd server to forward logs.

name: Disable the Fluentd connection
description: The connection that sends logs to Fluentd is disconnected.

name: Edit the Fluentd connection
description: The Fluentd endpoint settings are changed.

name: Monitor running tasks
description: The progress of tasks running for an app is shown on its Tasks tab.

name: View Astra Control Center metrics in Prometheus
description: The Prometheus UI is accessed to verify its targets and view Astra Control Center metrics.

name: View notifications
description: The notifications for the Astra account are listed and can be marked as read.

name: Add a proxy server
description: A proxy server is configured for Astra Control Center connections to the NetApp Support Site.

name: Disable the proxy server connection
description: The proxy server connection to the NetApp Support Site is disconnected.

name: Edit proxy server settings
description: The proxy server details and authentication information are changed.

name: Set up ingress for load balancing
description: An ingress controller and TLS secret are configured so Astra Control Center is reachable through a load-balanced ingress.

name: Create an immutable backup
description: An app backup is written to a WORM bucket so it cannot be changed or deleted during retention.

name: Add a certificate for LDAPS authentication
description: A CA certificate is added to Astra Control Center so it can connect to an LDAPS server.

name: Add a local user
description: A local user is created with a role and optional namespace constraints.

name: Add a namespace constraint to a role
description: A Member or Viewer user's role is limited to specific namespaces.

name: Add a remote LDAP group
description: An LDAP group is added to Astra Control Center and bound to a role so its members can sign in.

name: Add a remote LDAP user
description: An individual LDAP user is added to Astra Control Center and bound to a role.

name: Change your password
description: The signed-in local user changes their own password.

name: Configure an external cert-manager
description: An existing cert-manager is configured with a TLS secret and ClusterIssuer for Astra Control Center.

name: Disable remote authentication
description: LDAP remote authentication is disabled for Astra Control Center.

name: Disconnect remote authentication
description: The LDAP server connection is removed from Astra Control Center.

name: Edit remote authentication settings
description: The LDAP remote authentication connection settings are changed.

name: Edit storage backend authentication details
description: The credentials or authentication method Astra Control uses for a storage backend are changed.

name: Enable certificate authentication on an ONTAP storage backend
description: An ONTAP storage backend is configured to authenticate Astra Control with a client certificate.

name: Enable remote authentication with an LDAP server
description: Astra Control Center is connected to an LDAP or LDAPS server for remote user authentication.

name: Remove a namespace constraint from a role
description: A namespace constraint is removed from a Member or Viewer user's role.

name: Remove credentials
description: A stored credential is removed from the Astra account.

name: Remove local users
description: One or more local users are removed from the account.

name: Reset another user's password
description: An administrator sets a temporary password for another local user.

name: Rotate bucket credentials
description: The credentials Astra Control uses to access a bucket are replaced with new ones.

name: View users
description: The users defined for the Astra account are listed.

name: Create a cluster role kubeconfig
description: A service account, cluster role, binding and token-based kubeconfig are created so Astra Control can manage the cluster.

name: Download and extract the Astra Control Center bundle
description: The Astra Control Center software bundle is downloaded, verified and extracted, ready for installation.

name: Enable Astra Control Provisioner
description: The Astra Control Provisioner image is obtained and enabled in Astra Trident.

name: Install Astra Connector
description: The Astra Connector operator is installed on a cluster so Astra Control can manage it.

name: Install Astra Control Center
description: Astra Control Center is installed on a Kubernetes cluster and its system status verified.

name: Install the Astra kubectl plugin
description: The NetApp Astra kubectl plugin binary is installed in the local path.

name: Log in to the Astra Control Center UI
description: The administrator signs in to the Astra Control Center web UI with the installation credentials.

name: Remove resource limitations
description: The default resource quotas and limit ranges are deleted from the Astra Control Center namespace.

name: Run eligibility checks for cluster management
description: The cluster's Trident version, pods and storage class drivers are checked to confirm it can be managed by Astra Control.

name: Add a storage backend
description: An ONTAP storage backend is added or a discovered backend is brought under Astra Control management.

name: Change the default storage class
description: A different storage class is set as the default for a managed cluster.

name: Remove a storage backend
description: A storage backend is unmanaged if needed and then removed from Astra Control.

name: Unmanage a storage backend
description: A storage backend is removed from Astra Control management.

name: View storage backends
description: Storage backends and their state and details are listed.

name: View storage classes
description: The storage classes of a managed cluster are listed.

name: Clean up the monitoring operator after uninstall
description: The leftover monitoring agent, CRDs and namespace are removed from a managed cluster after uninstalling Astra Control Center.

name: Clean up Traefik CRDs after uninstall
description: Leftover Traefik custom resource definitions are deleted after uninstalling Astra Control Center.

name: Delete a failed app
description: A failed app is removed after deleting its backups and snapshots.

name: Generate a support bundle
description: A support bundle is generated and sent to NetApp Support, uploaded manually for air-gapped installations.

name: Uninstall Astra Control Center
description: Astra Control Center, its namespace and its operator components are removed from the cluster.

name: Upgrade Astra Control Center
description: Astra Control Center is upgraded by replacing its operator with the latest version.

name: Add an Azure Blob storage account
description: Creates a new Azure Blob storage account from the Azure Blob Storage system in the NetApp Console.

name: View Azure Blob storage accounts
description: Displays the Azure Blob storage accounts discovered in the Azure Blob Storage system in the NetApp Console.

name: Add an Azure NetApp Files system
description: Discovers Azure NetApp Files and adds it as a system in the NetApp Console using previously configured credentials.

name: Remove an Azure NetApp Files system
description: Removes the Azure NetApp Files system from the NetApp Console.

name: Manage volume snapshots
description: Performs snapshot actions (such as creating, restoring from or deleting snapshots) on an Azure NetApp Files volume.

name: Mount a volume
description: Mounts an Azure NetApp Files volume on a client by following the mount instructions provided in the Console.

name: Set up a Microsoft Entra application for Azure NetApp Files access
description: Creates a Microsoft Entra application, assigns it a role and adds its credentials to the Console so the Console can manage Azure NetApp Files.

name: Change a volume's service level
description: Moves an Azure NetApp Files volume to a capacity pool that provides a different service level.

name: Create a volume
description: Creates a new Azure NetApp Files volume, optionally from a snapshot of an existing volume.

name: Delete a volume
description: Deletes an Azure NetApp Files volume.

name: Modify a volume's size and tags
description: Changes the size and tags of an existing Azure NetApp Files volume.

name: Add a building block to the BeeGFS cluster
description: Expand the BeeGFS HA cluster by adding a building block's host_vars and group_vars to the inventory and rerunning the playbook.

name: Place the BeeGFS HA cluster in maintenance mode
description: Check and set the Pacemaker maintenance-mode property so the HA cluster stops managing BeeGFS resources during maintenance.

name: Stop and start the BeeGFS HA cluster
description: Stop all BeeGFS and HA cluster services across the cluster and later start them again.

name: Replace a file node
description: Physically replace a failed file node, reinstall and configure its OS, update the inventory, and rejoin it to the HA cluster with Ansible.

name: Configure BeeGFS clients
description: Use an Ansible client inventory and playbook to install and configure BeeGFS clients and mount the file system.

name: Configure individual block nodes
description: Define host_vars for each E-Series block node, including its system name, controller URL, storage protocol and HIC port settings.

name: Configure individual file nodes
description: Define host_vars for each file node, including its management address, cluster traffic IPs and storage protocol IPs.

name: Create the Ansible inventory for a BeeGFS HA cluster
description: Create the Ansible inventory directory and files (inventory, playbook, group_vars and host_vars) that describe the BeeGFS HA cluster to deploy.

name: Define a BeeGFS metadata service
description: Define the group_vars for a BeeGFS metadata service, including its floating IPs, configuration and backing E-Series volumes.

name: Define a BeeGFS storage service
description: Define the group_vars for a BeeGFS storage service, including its floating IPs, configuration and backing E-Series storage targets.

name: Define the BeeGFS management service
description: Define the group_vars for the BeeGFS management service, including its floating IPs and service-specific configuration.

name: Deploy BeeGFS building block hardware
description: Install and cable the file nodes, HCAs and E-Series block nodes that make up each BeeGFS building block.

name: Deploy the BeeGFS file system
description: Create the Ansible playbook and run it to deploy the BeeGFS HA cluster to the file and block nodes.

name: Map BeeGFS services to file nodes in the Ansible inventory
description: Define in inventory.yml the building blocks, i.e. which preferred and secondary file nodes run each BeeGFS management, metadata and storage service.

name: Plan the BeeGFS file system
description: Plan IP addressing and per-building-block service layout with a worksheet before building the Ansible inventory.

name: Specify common block node configuration
description: Define group_vars that apply to all E-Series block nodes, such as REST API credentials, firmware versions and global system defaults.

name: Specify common file node configuration
description: Define group_vars that apply to all file nodes, such as Ansible authentication, network interface settings and required firewall ports.

name: Verify the BeeGFS deployment
description: Confirm node reachability, cluster restart, service failover and file system performance before putting BeeGFS into production.

name: Troubleshoot unexpected BeeGFS failovers
description: Investigate why BeeGFS services failed over unexpectedly by checking monitor-detected failures, node departures and Pacemaker fencing.

name: Upgrade BeeGFS services
description: Upgrade the BeeGFS Ansible collection, update the inventory and playbook, and run the BeeGFS upgrade on the HA cluster.

name: Obtain authentication details for the REST API
description: The user token, Console account ID and Console agent ID needed to call the Backup and Recovery REST APIs are obtained.

name: Enable preview features
description: Enable preview feature flags for Backup and Recovery on the Console agent.

name: Log in to Backup and Recovery
description: Open Backup and Recovery from the Console and reach its workload management pages.

name: Activate backup for ONTAP volumes to object storage
description: Enable Backup and Recovery on an ONTAP system and complete the activation wizard (volume selection, backup strategy, review) so its volumes are backed up to object storage.

name: Add a bucket to a backup target
description: A new bucket is added to an already discovered backup target for use as a backup destination.

name: Apply an updated host time zone to a protection group
description: Refresh a host or vCenter and resave a protection group so its schedule uses the host's new time zone.

name: Back up a volume on demand
description: Create a manual backup of an ONTAP volume to object storage outside its schedule.

name: Back up a workload on demand
description: Create an immediate backup or snapshot of a protected workload resource (protection group, instance, database, virtual machine, or Kubernetes application) outside its schedule, from the web UI or with a Kubernetes custom resource.

name: Catalog an Oracle recovery point
description: Catalog an Oracle Database recovery point with RMAN so it can be used for recovery.

name: Change credentials for a backup target
description: The credentials Backup and Recovery uses to access a discovered backup target are updated.

name: Configure export of existing snapshots to backup
description: Choose whether existing snapshots are exported to object storage as backup files when backup is activated.

name: Configure yearly snapshot deletion
description: Choose whether yearly snapshots are removed from the source system after they are backed up.

name: Create a backup policy
description: Create a protection policy that defines backup architecture, schedules, and retention for workloads or ONTAP volume backups to object storage.

name: Create a clone
description: Create a clone of a database or virtual machine from a snapshot or backup, optionally with a scheduled refresh.

name: Create a protection group
description: Group workload resources into a protection group that shares a protection policy.

name: Create a replication policy
description: Create a policy that defines SnapMirror labels, retention, and transfer schedule for ONTAP volume replication.

name: Create a resource transformation template
description: A named resource transformation template used to transform resources during restore is created.

name: Create a snapshot policy
description: Create a policy that defines the schedule and retention of local snapshots for ONTAP volumes.

name: Create an execution hook template
description: A reusable execution hook template that runs scripts before or after protection operations is created.

name: Create and protect a Kubernetes application
description: Define a Kubernetes application from namespace resources or virtual machines and optionally assign a protection policy to it.

name: Deactivate backup for a system
description: Pause all backup and restore activity for an ONTAP system without deleting existing backups.

name: Delete a backup policy
description: Delete a protection policy that is no longer needed.

name: Delete a clone
description: Remove a clone and its associated resources.

name: Delete a Kubernetes application
description: Remove a Kubernetes application definition from Backup and Recovery.

name: Delete a protection group
description: Delete a protection group.

name: Delete a volume backup
description: Delete a single snapshot or backup file of an ONTAP volume.

name: Delete a volume backup relationship
description: Stop creating new backups for a volume while retaining its existing backup files.

name: Delete a workload backup
description: Delete selected snapshots, backups, or restore points of a protected workload such as a virtual machine, database, or Kubernetes application.

name: Delete all backups for a system
description: Delete all backup files in object storage for every volume of an ONTAP system.

name: Delete all backups for a volume
description: Delete all backup files in object storage for a single ONTAP volume.

name: Discover a backup target
description: An offsite backup target (AWS, Azure, StorageGRID, ONTAP S3) is discovered and added to Backup and Recovery.

name: Download guest files and folders from a Kubernetes VM restore point
description: Download files and folders from a restore point of a VM-based Kubernetes application.

name: Edit imported SnapCenter resources
description: The SnapCenter server connection details (password, port) for resources imported from SnapCenter are updated.

name: Enable S3-compatible storage as a backup target
description: S3-compatible object storage such as Wasabi is enabled as a backup target by setting allow-s3-compatible in the Backup and Recovery service configuration on the Console agent.

name: Enable the indexed catalog
description: Enable indexing on a source system so Search & Restore can locate volumes and files in backups.

name: Exclude volumes from indexing
description: Exclude specific volumes or storage VMs from the indexed catalog by setting feature flags on the Console agent.

name: Manage a volume replication relationship
description: Perform replication actions such as update, break, or resync on an ONTAP volume's replication relationship.

name: Modify a backup policy
description: Change the settings of an existing protection policy.

name: Modify a protection group
description: Change the resources or policy of an existing protection group.

name: Modify protection settings for a workload resource
description: Change the policy, schedule, and retention applied to a protected SQL Server instance.

name: Modify volume backup settings
description: Change the snapshot, replication, and backup policies applied to one or more protected ONTAP volumes.

name: Mount an Oracle recovery point
description: Mount an Oracle Database recovery point on a host.

name: Protect a workload resource
description: Assign a protection policy to a SQL Server instance, database, or availability group so it is backed up on schedule.

name: Refresh a clone
description: Update an existing clone with a newer copy of its source data.

description: Stop protecting a workload resource (protection group, instance, database, or Kubernetes application) by removing its protection policy, optionally keeping its existing backups and snapshots.

name: Restore a Kubernetes application
description: Restore a Kubernetes application from a snapshot or backup to its original namespace, a different namespace, or a different cluster.

name: Restore a virtual disk
description: Restore VMware virtual disks from a backup.

name: Restore a virtual machine
description: Restore a virtual machine from a snapshot or backup to its original or an alternate location.

name: Restore a volume from a backup
description: Restore an ONTAP volume (or its folders and files) from a backup file in object storage.

description: Restore selected files and folders from an ONTAP volume backup in object storage using Browse & Restore.

name: Restore guest files and folders
description: Restore individual files and folders from a virtual machine backup into a guest VM.

name: Resume a backup schedule

name: Set the maximum transfer rate for backups
description: Limit the network bandwidth used to upload backups to object storage.

name: Skip a scheduled clone refresh
description: Skip the next scheduled refresh of a clone.

name: Split a clone
description: Split a clone from its parent so it becomes an independent copy.

name: Suspend backup schedules
description: Temporarily stop scheduled backups for a protection group, host, instance, or database.

name: Unmount an Oracle recovery point
description: Unmount a previously mounted Oracle Database recovery point.

name: Unregister backup for a system
description: Unregister the Backup and Recovery service from an ONTAP system so backups stop and no further charges accrue.

name: View backup-to-object advanced settings
description: Review the cluster-level backup-to-object storage settings configured for an ONTAP system.

name: View live disk mount sessions
description: List the active live disk (VMDK or virtual disk) mount sessions opened for guest file restores, optionally acting on or deleting a session.

name: View resources in a Kubernetes restore point
description: List the Kubernetes resources that were backed up in a specific application restore point.

name: View volume backups
description: List the snapshots, replicas, and backup files that exist for an ONTAP volume.

name: Add a Kubernetes cluster and discover workloads
description: Register a Kubernetes cluster with a Console agent so its workloads are discovered.

name: Add a KVM management platform
description: A KVM management platform credential is registered in Backup and Recovery so its virtual machines can be protected.

name: Add a VMware vCenter Server

name: Add a workload host and discover resources
