name: Add credentials for host resources
description: New credentials that Backup and Recovery uses to access application hosts are added in Settings.

name: Configure an Oracle database
description: Set authentication, RMAN catalog, and node settings for a standalone or RAC Oracle database.

name: Configure the log directory for a host
description: Configure the directory where host log backups are stored so they are included in snapshots.

name: Delete a host
description: Remove a discovered workload host from Backup and Recovery.

name: Edit a host
description: Change the information of a discovered workload host.

name: Edit a Kubernetes cluster
description: Change the registered information, such as the name, of a Kubernetes cluster.

name: Edit credentials for host resources
description: Existing host credentials in Backup and Recovery settings are updated.

name: Import resources from SnapCenter
description: Import application, host, or vCenter metadata from SnapCenter into Backup and Recovery.

name: Migrate a Kubernetes cluster to a new Console agent
description: Move a disconnected Kubernetes cluster to a different Console agent.

name: Reconnect a Kubernetes cluster to a Console agent
description: Restore the connection between a disconnected Kubernetes cluster and its Console agent.

name: Remove a Kubernetes cluster
description: Remove a Kubernetes cluster from Backup and Recovery management.

name: Transfer management of imported SnapCenter resources to Backup and Recovery
description: Take over protection of hosts and resources imported from SnapCenter so Backup and Recovery, not SnapCenter, manages them.

name: End a free trial
description: An active Backup and Recovery free trial is ended.

name: Create a protection report
description: Generate a report of protection status for a chosen scope and time range.

name: Delete a protection report
description: Delete a generated protection report.

name: Download a protection report
description: Download a generated protection report.

name: Export job monitoring results
description: Download job monitoring results as a CSV file for all jobs or a JSON file for one job.

name: View a protection report
description: Open and review a generated protection report.

name: View Backup and Recovery jobs
description: List, sort, filter, and inspect the details of backup, restore, clone, and retention jobs in the job monitor.

name: View backup and restore notifications
description: Review backup and restore alerts in the Console notification center.

name: View the protection dashboard
description: Review protection health, protected and at-risk workloads, and job summaries on the Backup and Recovery dashboard.

name: View volume backup status
description: List ONTAP volumes and review the status of their snapshot, replication, and backup protection.

name: View workload protection details
description: Review the protection status of hosts, protection groups, availability groups, instances, and databases for a workload.

name: Configure a private endpoint connection to object storage
description: Create a private interface endpoint to the object store and install its certificate so backups travel over a private connection.

name: Configure DNS for host discovery in an air-gapped local deployment
description: Add host name entries to the local deployment's internal CoreDNS so database hosts can be discovered in an air-gapped environment.

name: Prepare Console agent networking for backup to object storage
description: Ensure the Console agent network allows the connections and private endpoints required for backups to cloud object storage.

name: Switch to a different workload
description: The Backup and Recovery interface is switched to show a different workload type.

name: Enable or disable ransomware scans on backups
description: Turn ransomware scanning of backup files on or off for a system or an object storage provider.

name: Scan a volume backup for ransomware
description: Run an on-demand ransomware scan on a volume backup file in object storage.

name: Associate a Kubernetes namespace with a folder or project
description: Register Kubernetes namespaces with a Console folder or project for access control.

name: Associate credentials with a workload resource
description: Associate existing or new credentials with a SQL Server instance so it can be protected.

name: Create a CA certificate for a storage system
description: A CA certificate is created and installed in the Backup and Recovery service containers so the service can communicate securely with StorageGRID or ONTAP.

name: Disable User Account Control remote restrictions on the SnapCenter host
description: Set the LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy registry value on the SnapCenter Windows host so SnapCenter resources can be imported.

name: Grant Console agent permissions for backup to object storage
description: Verify and update the Console agent's cloud role so it has the permissions required for backup to object storage.

name: Set up object storage access permissions for backups
description: In the cloud provider, create the identity used to reach the backup bucket (an AWS IAM user or a Google Cloud service account with a custom role), grant it the bucket permissions, and generate the access keys that are entered in Backup and Recovery so backups can be written to Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage.

name: Set up role-based access control for Backup and Recovery
description: The identity and access project structure is created, user roles are assigned, workloads are discovered and users are added to projects so access to Backup and Recovery is role-based.

name: Discover ONTAP systems and volumes without activating backup
description: Discover ONTAP systems and their volumes in Backup and Recovery without activating backup for them.

name: Restart the Backup and Recovery service
description: Restart the Backup and Recovery service on the Console agent host.

name: Upgrade Trident Protect on a Kubernetes cluster
description: Upgrade the Trident Protect components on a managed Kubernetes cluster.

name: Add an object store to a cluster
description: A new object store is created and made available for tiering on a cluster.

name: Attach a mirror object store to an aggregate
description: A second object store is attached to an aggregate so tiered data is mirrored to it.

name: Change a volume's tiering policy
description: A volume's tiering policy and cooling period are changed to a different setting.

name: Enable tiering on additional volumes
description: Additional volumes on a tiering-enabled cluster are assigned a tiering policy so their inactive data moves to the cloud tier.

name: Migrate tiered data back to the performance tier
description: Data of a volume that was tiered to object storage is brought back from the cloud tier to the local performance tier.

name: Modify aggregate tiering settings
description: An aggregate's tiering fullness threshold and inactive data reporting setting are changed.

name: Remove a mirror object store from an aggregate
description: The mirror object store is detached from an aggregate, leaving only a single object store.

name: Set up tiering from an on-premises cluster to object storage
description: Inactive data from an on-premises ONTAP cluster is tiered to a newly defined object store after preparing the provider's storage, credentials and permissions.

name: Swap the primary and mirror object stores
description: The primary and mirror object stores of an aggregate exchange roles.

name: View object stores configured for a cluster
description: Details about the object stores configured for a cluster are displayed.

name: Discover an additional cluster for tiering
description: An undiscovered on-premises ONTAP cluster is discovered and added to the Console so its data can be tiered.

name: Search for a cluster across Console agents
description: A cluster managed by any Console agent is located by name so tiering can be configured through the right agent.

name: Measure cloud network latency and throughput
description: A cloud performance test measures network latency and throughput between the cluster and the object store.

name: View tiering information for a cluster
description: Tiering details and savings for a cluster are displayed.

name: Fix failed tiering operational health
description: Clusters showing a failed tiering operational health are identified and the underlying cause is corrected.

name: Retrieve results from list APIs
description: Call an asynchronous Copy and Sync list API and retrieve its result through the messages API.

name: Add a data broker to a data broker group
description: Create a new data broker in an existing data broker group, for example the group that serves a sync relationship, so the group has more data brokers to run its syncs.

name: Authenticate to Copy and Sync
description: Authenticate to the NetApp Console to get access to Copy and Sync: sign in through the web UI, or for the API obtain a Console user token and account ID and send them in the Authorization header.

name: Delete a data broker group
description: Delete a data broker group from Copy and Sync.

name: Modify a data broker group configuration
description: Change and unify the settings of a data broker group, such as scanner settings tuned for object-storage-to-object-storage sync.

name: Move a data broker between groups
description: Move a data broker from one data broker group to another.

name: Remove a data broker from a group
description: Remove a data broker from its data broker group.

name: Rename a data broker group
description: Change the name of a data broker group.

name: View a data broker configuration
description: Display the configuration details of a data broker.

name: Copy ACLs between SMB shares
description: Copy access control lists from a source SMB share to a target SMB share as part of a sync relationship, either with the built-in Copy and Sync option or manually from a Windows host.

name: Create a sync relationship
description: Create a sync relationship that copies files from a source to a target and keeps changed data in sync, including starting from a system on the Console Systems page.

name: Delete sync relationships
description: Delete one or more sync relationships from Copy and Sync.

name: Perform an immediate data sync
description: Run a sync of a sync relationship immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled sync.

name: Create an encrypted NFS sync relationship
description: Create a sync relationship between NFS servers that encrypts data in flight between the source and target data brokers.

name: Add a purchased license
description: Purchase a Copy and Sync license from NetApp and add it to the service to pay for sync relationships.

name: Subscribe to Copy and Sync from a cloud marketplace
description: Set up pay-as-you-go billing for sync relationships through a cloud provider marketplace subscription.

name: Update a license
description: Update an existing Copy and Sync license with renewed license information.

name: Configure sync relationship notifications
description: Enable alerts and email notifications for events on a sync relationship.

name: Create a report
description: Generate a report for a source or target path to help tune data broker configuration and performance.

name: Delete a report
description: Delete one or more reports for a path.

name: Download a report
description: Download a Copy and Sync report as a PDF.

name: View report errors
description: Display the errors recorded in a Copy and Sync path report.

name: Modify a data broker proxy configuration
description: Change the proxy server settings that a data broker uses.

name: Configure a data broker group to use HashiCorp Vault secrets
description: Enable a data broker group to retrieve cloud credentials from HashiCorp Vault by editing each data broker's local configuration.

name: Grant a data broker access to cloud storage
description: Create the cloud IAM identity, keys or bucket permissions a data broker needs to read and write cloud object storage used in sync relationships.

name: Update sync relationship credentials
description: Replace the source or target credentials that a sync relationship uses so it can continue to sync.

name: Install a data broker
description: Deploy a new Copy and Sync data broker on a cloud virtual machine or an on-premises Linux host so it can run sync relationships.

name: Troubleshoot a data broker
description: Identify data brokers in Unknown or Failed status, find the failure reason and correct the issue.

name: Uninstall a data broker
description: Remove the data broker software from its host.

name: Find duplicate files
description: Filter investigation results to list files that have duplicates across storage systems, optionally downloading or acting on them.

name: Access Data Classification
description: Log in to the Console and open the Data Classification service from the Governance menu.

name: Copy files
description: Copy selected files from the Investigation page to an NFS or CIFS destination.

name: Delete files
description: Permanently delete selected files from the Investigation page.

name: Move files
description: Move selected files from the Investigation page to an NFS or CIFS destination.

name: Add a file shares group
description: Add a group of NFS or CIFS file shares as a data source to be scanned by Data Classification.

name: Add a StorageGRID service as a data source
description: Add a StorageGRID service with its endpoint and credentials so its buckets can be scanned.

name: Change the scan type
description: Switch a system or individual repositories between mapping-only and full classification scans.

name: Create a custom category classifier
description: Create a custom classifier of type category defined by a set of sample text files.

name: Create a custom personal identifier
description: Create a custom classifier that detects a personal identifier by keywords or regular expression, optionally masking results.

name: Create a saved query
description: Save a set of investigation filters as a named query, optionally as a policy with actions.

name: Download a data investigation report
description: Export the filtered Data Investigation results as a CSV or JSON report.

name: Enable scanning of data protection volumes
description: Enable Data Classification access to data protection (DP) volumes and activate scanning on them.

name: Enable scanning on data source repositories
description: Activate mapping or classification scans on all or selected volumes, shares or buckets of a data source system.

name: Exclude directories from scanning
description: Define directory paths in the custom configuration file so Data Classification skips them during scans.

name: Generate a compliance report
description: Select the systems to include and download a regulatory compliance report such as PCI DSS, HIPAA or Privacy Risk Assessment.

name: Generate a data subject access request report
description: Search for a data subject by name or identifier and download a report of files that mention that person.

name: Generate a governance report
description: Generate and download a governance report such as the data discovery assessment or full data mapping overview report.

name: Modify a custom classifier
description: Edit the logic (keywords, patterns or files) of an existing custom classifier.

name: Modify a saved query or policy
description: Change the name and description of an existing saved query or policy.

name: Pause or resume scanning for a repository
description: Temporarily pause active scans on selected repositories and resume them later.

name: Prioritize scans
description: Give selected repositories priority so they are scanned before other repositories.

name: Remove a file shares group
description: Delete a group of file shares so it is no longer a Data Classification data source.

name: Stop scanning a repository
description: Turn off scanning for a repository by setting its scan type to Off.

name: Verify Data Classification access to volumes
description: Confirm Data Classification can reach and read the volumes of a system by checking network connectivity, NFS export policies and CIFS credentials.

name: View file metadata
description: Display the metadata details of a file in the Investigation page, optionally tagging it.

name: View files that contain personal data
description: List and investigate files that contain personal or sensitive personal data, overall or by specific data type.

name: View scan status of repositories
description: Display scan settings and mapping/classification progress for all repositories of a system.

name: View the governance dashboard
description: Open the Data Classification governance dashboard and review its tiles (data age and size, open permissions, sensitive data with wide permissions, top repositories by sensitivity, storage savings opportunities), optionally filtering into the Investigation page.

name: Connect Data Classification to Active Directory
description: Integrate an Active Directory server so Data Classification can report file owners, users and permissions.

name: Define group IDs as open to organization
description: Add group IDs to the custom configuration so files accessible to those groups are classified as open to the organization.

name: View user permissions for files and directories
description: Display the users and groups that have access to a file or directory and their permission levels.

name: Deploy Data Classification
description: Deploy a NetApp Data Classification instance, either as a cloud instance created by the Console wizard or by installing the software on your own Linux host (with or without internet access), and connect it to the Console.

name: Verify Linux host readiness for Data Classification
description: Download and run the prerequisites script to confirm the Linux host meets the requirements for installing Data Classification.

name: Upgrade Data Classification software
description: Upgrade the Data Classification software on a private-mode Linux host using the downloaded software bundle and upgrade script.

name: Clean up a test failover environment
description: Remove the test VMs and resources created by a failover test for a replication plan.

name: Fail back applications to the original source site
description: Return failed-over workloads of a replication plan to the original source site.

name: Fail over applications to the disaster recovery site
description: Fail over the workloads of a replication plan from the source site to the disaster recovery site, optionally from a selected snapshot.

name: Migrate applications to another site
description: Move VMware applications protected by a replication plan from the source site to another site.

name: Test failover of a replication plan
description: Run a non-disruptive test failover of a replication plan to the disaster recovery site using a chosen or new snapshot.

name: Add a site
description: Add a source or target VMware or Kubernetes site to Disaster Recovery.

name: Add an AppVault
description: Create an AppVault object-storage target connected to a Console agent for storing protection data.

name: Add resources to a site
description: Add a vCenter server or Kubernetes cluster to an existing disaster recovery site so its workloads are discovered.

name: Change an AppVault endpoint
description: Change the storage endpoint that an AppVault points to.

name: Clone a resource transformation template
description: Create a copy of an existing resource transformation template.

name: Configure replication plan schedules
description: Set how often compliance checks run and schedule automated test failovers for a replication plan.

name: Create a replication plan
description: Create a disaster recovery replication plan by selecting source and target vCenters, choosing VMs, datastores or resource groups, mapping resources for failover and test failover, and reviewing the plan.

name: Create a resource group
description: Create a resource group of VMs or Kubernetes resources to be protected together in a replication plan.

name: Create a resource transformation template
description: Create a resource transformation template that adds, copies, moves, removes, replaces or tests resource attributes during recovery.

name: Delete a replication plan
description: Delete a replication plan, optionally removing its primary and secondary snapshots.

name: Delete a resource transformation template
description: Remove a resource transformation template.

name: Delete an AppVault
description: Remove an AppVault from Disaster Recovery.

name: Modify a replication plan
description: Change settings of an existing replication plan, such as its details or the snapshot retention count for datastores in its failover mapping.

name: Modify a resource group
description: Edit or delete an existing resource group from the resource groups list.

name: Modify a site
description: Edit a vCenter site's name, location, server details or scheduled discovery settings.

name: Reconcile replication plan snapshots
description: Reconcile snapshots between the source and target sites of a replication plan on demand.

name: Refresh site discovery
description: Manually trigger rediscovery of the resources in a disaster recovery site.

name: Replicate applications to a disaster recovery site
description: Replicate VMware applications from the source site to a remote disaster recovery site using SnapMirror through a replication plan.

name: Run a compliance check on a replication plan
description: Run an on-demand compliance check of a replication plan to confirm it is still valid for failover.

name: Update AppVault credentials
description: Update the credentials an AppVault uses, reviewing the AppVaults and replication plans affected.

name: End the Disaster Recovery free trial
description: End the free trial early, optionally deleting all trial data immediately.

name: Estimate disaster recovery capacity needs
description: Determine the physical used capacity of volumes hosting VMware datastores to size the Disaster Recovery license.

name: Start a Disaster Recovery free trial
description: Begin a 30-day free trial of the Disaster Recovery service after setting up a Console agent.

name: Subscribe to Disaster Recovery through a cloud marketplace
description: Subscribe to Disaster Recovery through AWS Marketplace or Azure Marketplace after the trial ends.

name: Cancel a disaster recovery job
description: Cancel a running Disaster Recovery job from the job monitoring page.

name: Create a disaster recovery report
description: Generate a predesigned report, such as a summary of failovers and failbacks, to analyze disaster recovery readiness.

name: View datastore information
description: View information about the datastores discovered in a vCenter site.

name: View disaster recovery jobs
description: Review Disaster Recovery jobs with their timestamps and status on the job monitoring page.

name: View the disaster recovery dashboard
description: Review replication plan health, recent warnings and jobs, and discovery and protection counts on the Disaster Recovery dashboard.

name: View virtual machine information
description: View information about the virtual machines discovered in a vCenter site.

name: View workload protection status
description: List vCenter or Kubernetes workloads and see whether each is protected.

name: Add subnet mapping for a site
description: Define subnet mappings for a vCenter site so failed-over VMs receive addresses in the target subnets.

name: Add ONTAP permissions for Disaster Recovery
description: Create an ONTAP role that has the REST API permissions Disaster Recovery needs to manage the cluster.

name: Configure Microsoft Sentinel as a SIEM
description: Microsoft Sentinel is set up in Azure (Log Analytics workspace, Entra ID app registration, custom role and role assignment) and authenticated in Ransomware Resilience so alerts are sent to it.

name: Disable a SIEM integration
description: Sending data to a connected SIEM system is paused.

name: Access Ransomware Resilience in the Console
description: The user logs in to the Console and opens Ransomware Resilience from the Protection menu.

name: Add a backup destination
description: A cloud or object-storage backup destination is added in Ransomware Resilience settings for use by protection strategies.

name: Add a bring-your-own license
description: A purchased BYOL license serial number is added to the Console so Ransomware Resilience is licensed.

name: End a pay-as-you-go subscription
description: The PAYGO subscription is set not to continue after the current payment method expires.

name: Start a free trial of Ransomware Resilience
description: A 30-day free trial of Ransomware Resilience is started from the Console.

name: Subscribe to Ransomware Resilience through a cloud marketplace
description: A pay-as-you-go subscription to Ransomware Resilience is purchased through a cloud provider marketplace.

name: Update an expired Ransomware Resilience license
description: An expiring or expired license is renewed, including manually uploading the license file when the Console cannot update it automatically.

name: Download Ransomware Resilience reports
description: Protection, alert, recovery or readiness drill data is downloaded as CSV report files.

name: View workload health on the dashboard
description: The dashboard's summary of workload protection, alerts and recovery status is reviewed.

name: Access technical documentation from the dashboard
description: Links to documentation and support resources are opened from the dashboard Actions menu.

name: Add a detection policy to a workload that keeps its existing backup policies
description: Only a ransomware detection policy is applied to a workload while its existing backup and snapshot policies stay in place.

name: Change the protection policy of a workload
description: The protection of an already protected workload is edited to assign a different policy.

name: Conduct a ransomware attack readiness drill
description: Configure and start a simulated ransomware attack on a test workload, then investigate the alert and restore the workload to confirm the organization is ready for a real attack.

name: Create a protection group
description: A named protection group of workloads is created and protected with a policy.

name: Create a user activity agent
description: A user activity agent is deployed in a chosen cloud provider and region to enable user activity detection.

name: Create a user directory connector
description: A connection to a user directory is added so user activity can be attributed to users.

name: Create an automated response to user activity alerts
description: An automated response behavior is created that acts automatically when user activity alerts are raised.

name: Create an isolated recovery environment
description: An isolated environment is created for cleaning and clean restore of workloads after an attack.

name: Delete a data collector
description: A user activity data collector is removed from the user activity monitoring configuration.

name: Delete a protection group
description: A protection group is deleted.

name: Delete a ransomware protection strategy
description: A ransomware protection strategy is removed from the list of managed strategies.

name: Delete a user directory connector
description: An existing user directory connector is removed.

name: Dismiss alert incidents as false positives
description: Selected incidents in an alert that are determined not to be threats are dismissed as false positives.

name: Edit the protection of a protection group
description: A different or new protection policy is applied to all workloads in a protection group.

name: Exclude file paths from user activity monitoring
description: Specified file paths are added to the exclusion list so they are not monitored for user activity.

name: Identify privacy exposures in a file share workload
description: A file share workload is scanned for personally identifiable data and its privacy exposure is reviewed.

name: Mark alert incidents as restore needed
description: Neutralized incidents are marked as restore needed so the affected workload becomes ready for recovery.

name: Modify an automated response to user activity alerts
description: The settings of an existing automated response to user activity alerts are changed.

name: Protect a workload with a ransomware protection strategy
description: A new or existing ransomware protection strategy is assigned to a workload, replacing any existing backup or snapshot policies.

name: Remove workloads from a protection group
description: One or more workloads are removed from a protection group.

name: Restore a workload after a ransomware attack
description: A workload in the restore-needed state is restored from a clean recovery point.

name: Restore files after a ransomware attack
description: Selected files of a workload in the restore-needed state are restored from a clean recovery point.

name: Review and act on protection recommendations
description: Recommended protection actions on the dashboard are reviewed and then acted on or dismissed.

name: Simulate a ransomware encryption attack
description: A test dataset is encrypted by a provided script to trigger an encryption alert.

name: Simulate data breach and data destruction attacks
description: Malicious user activity is simulated on a protected volume to trigger data breach and data destruction alerts.

name: View impacted files for an alert incident
description: The list of files impacted by a specific alert incident on a workload is displayed.

name: View ransomware alerts and incidents
description: Alerts and their incidents (malicious file activity or anomalous user behavior) are reviewed, including incident details, from the dashboard, Alerts page or an alert email link.

name: View workload protection status
description: The protection details of workloads are displayed, either per workload or as the workloads covered by a given protection strategy.

name: View workloads that need to be restored
description: Workloads in the restore-needed state and their recovery status are reviewed.

name: Discover workloads on systems
description: Selected systems, per Console agent, are discovered so their workloads appear in Ransomware Resilience.

name: Refresh workload discovery for previously selected systems
description: Discovery is refreshed so newly created workloads on already selected systems are identified.

name: Log in to the replication service
description: Opens the NetApp Replication service from the NetApp Console navigation.

name: Manage data replication relationships
description: Reviews the health of replication relationships and performs actions on them, such as changing the schedule, in NetApp Replication.

name: Set up data replication between systems
description: Creates a one-time or scheduled data replication relationship between ONTAP systems in NetApp Replication.

name: Access the volume caching service
description: Opens the Volume Caching service from the NetApp Console navigation.

name: Assign an export policy to a cache
description: Assigns a different export policy to an existing cache.

name: Monitor cache jobs
description: Shows the status of Volume Caching operations on the Console Audit page, with optional filters.

name: Delete a cache
description: Deletes a cache from Volume Caching.

name: Modify a cache
description: Changes a cache's name or size, including resizing it to a new percentage of the origin volume size.

name: View cache details
description: Lists caches, with optional filters, and shows the details of a selected cache.

name: Add a data collector
description: Configures and tests a new data collector so that Data Infrastructure Insights collects data from a device or application.

name: Add a Fibre Channel device manually
description: Adds a Fibre Channel device identification manually on the Fibre Channel Identify tab.

name: Add a widget to a dashboard
description: A chart or table widget showing the selected asset metrics is added to a dashboard.

name: Add an in-context filtered widget to an asset page
description: Adds a widget to an asset page in edit mode that is automatically filtered to objects related to that asset.

name: Add an IP device manually
description: Adds an IP device identification manually on the IP Address Identify tab.

name: Assign a business entity to assets
description: Applies a business entity annotation to the objects selected in a query through bulk actions.

name: Assign an annotation to an asset
description: Adds or changes an annotation value on an asset from the asset page User Data section.

name: Assign an application to assets
description: Associates one or more applications with one or more assets, or removes them, from a query or the asset page.

name: Change the order of annotation rules
description: Moves an annotation rule up or down to change the order in which rules are evaluated.

name: Clone a data collector
description: Creates a copy of an existing data collector with the same configuration.

name: Control data collector polling
description: Pauses, resumes or starts polling for one or more selected data collectors through bulk actions.

name: Copy table values to the clipboard
description: Copies values from a query or asset table to the clipboard to use elsewhere.

name: Create a business entity
description: Defines a business entity with tenant, line of business, business unit and project values.

name: Create a dashboard
description: Creates a new named dashboard and adds widgets to it, such as a virtual machine performance dashboard.

name: Create a device resolution rule
description: Creates a host or tape auto resolution rule that identifies devices from a chosen source.

name: Create a maintenance window
description: Defines a maintenance window that suppresses alerts from selected monitors for chosen devices or attributes.

name: Create a metric monitor
description: Creates a monitor that raises warning or critical alerts when a chosen object metric crosses defined thresholds.

name: Create a query
description: Creates a new query for a chosen object type.

name: Create a report
description: Builds a new report in Reporting from a selected data source.

name: Create a webhook notification
description: Prepares the receiving service and creates a Data Infrastructure Insights webhook that sends monitor alerts to it.

name: Create a Workload Security webhook
description: Creates and tests a webhook that sends Workload Security alerts to a target such as Microsoft Teams.

name: Create an annotation
description: Defines a new custom annotation with a name, description and data type.

name: Create an annotation rule
description: Creates a rule that automatically applies an annotation value to the assets returned by a query.

name: Create an anomaly detection monitor
description: Creates a monitor that alerts on anomalous behaviour of a chosen object metric.

name: Create an application
description: Creates an application with a unique name and priority.

name: Create an expression in a dashboard widget
description: Converts widget queries into an expression that calculates a derived metric, such as system I/O or read IOPS percentage.

name: Delete an annotation rule
description: Removes an existing annotation rule.

name: Describe kube-state-metrics counters
description: Reference list of the kube-state-metrics counters that are collected for Kubernetes objects.

name: Describe the automatic device resolution process
description: Overview of the automatic device resolution cycle: research the environment, plan rules, create or revise rules, and review results.

name: Exclude root aggregates and volumes from I/O density reports
description: Uses a query, an annotation and an annotation rule to find root aggregates and volumes so that I/O density reports include only internal data volumes.

name: Export Fibre Channel device identifications
description: Exports the identifications of selected Fibre Channel devices to a .CSV file.

name: Export IP device identifications
description: Exports the identifications of selected IP devices to a .CSV file.

name: Export query results
description: Exports the results of a query to a .CSV file.

name: Identify devices with rule-assisted manual identification
description: Selects several unidentified Fibre Channel devices and identifies them manually with help from resolution rules.

name: Identify inactive devices
description: Runs a storage query with the isActive column to find devices that are no longer active.

name: Modify a query
description: Edits an existing query's criteria and columns.

name: Modify an annotation rule
description: Edits the settings of an existing annotation rule.

name: Publish an annotation for reporting
description: Publishes an annotation so that it can be used in Reporting.

name: Run an automatic device resolution update
description: Starts an update that reapplies automatic device resolution rules.

name: Unpublish an annotation from reporting
description: Removes an annotation from Reporting and clears the references that still use it.

name: View alerts
description: Displays and manages alerts raised by monitors, either for all alerts or for the alerts related to one asset.

name: View asset performance charts
description: Uses the asset page Performance section to show performance charts for chosen metrics and related resources.

name: View installed data collectors
description: Displays the list and status of configured data collectors.

name: View queries
description: Lists the saved metric queries, with filtering and sorting.

name: Configure a Workload Security ONTAP SVM data collector
description: Adds (and optionally tests) a Workload Security data collector that uses a connected agent and SVM or cluster management credentials to monitor user file activity on an ONTAP SVM.

name: Set up Workload Security

name: Create a read-only ONTAP user for the data collector
description: Creates a read-only ONTAP role and user that the Data Infrastructure Insights ONTAP data collector uses to collect data.

name: Export audit events

name: Invite a user
description: Invites one or more users by email so that they get accounts in the Data Infrastructure Insights tenant.

name: Deploy a Workload Security agent
description: Prepares an agent host and installs the Workload Security agent on it so that Workload Security collectors can run.

name: Install a data collection agent

name: Troubleshoot a failed data collector

name: Manually update acquisition unit software
description: Downloads and applies an acquisition unit patch or data collector package manually, then restarts the acquisition unit.

name: Migrate an ONTAP data collector to REST
description: Replaces an existing ONTAP data collector with a REST collector by adding the REST collector, pausing the old one and validating the data.

name: Add a file server

name: Create a project
description: Add a new project with a name and optional description in Settings > Projects.

name: Modify a file server
description: Change a registered file server's server type, credentials or export path settings.

name: Modify a project

name: Switch between projects

name: Upload export and directory paths for a file server
description: Fill in the CSV template of export and directory paths and upload it to a file server, instead of discovering the paths automatically.

name: Activate or deactivate a job

name: Approve a cutover job
description: Review a Bulk Cutover job run, download its chain-of-custody report and approve the cutover.

name: Configure a bulk discovery job
description: Create and schedule a Bulk Discover job on a file server to scan its data before migration.

name: Configure a bulk migration job
description: Create a Bulk Migrate job by mapping sources to destinations, customizing job settings, then reviewing and submitting it.

name: Delete a job

name: Generate a job error report

name: Modify a job configuration
description: Change a job's configuration from its Job Details page.

name: Pause, resume, stop, or start a job run

name: Retry errored files and directories
description: Re-run the files and directories that failed in a job's most recent run.

name: Start a cutover job

name: View job run details

name: View jobs
description: List jobs in the Job Config List with filters, or open one job's details page.

name: Configure NFS access for worker nodes

name: Configure SMB access for worker nodes

name: Configure real-time email notifications

name: Add a user
description: Create a new Data Migrator user with a first name, last name and email address.

name: Disable a user
description: Disable a registered user so they can no longer log in.

name: Enable a user
description: Re-enable a disabled user so they can log in again.

name: Log out of the UI
description: Log out of Data Migrator and return to the Welcome page, where you can log back in with registered credentials.

name: Reset a user password

name: Connect deployed workers to the control plane

name: Create control plane and worker VMs

name: Deploy control plane and Linux worker images
description: Copy or import the control plane and Linux worker images (AMIs, VHDs or image imports) into the cloud account so VMs can be created from them.

name: Register for a support site account
description: Register and verify a NetApp Support Site account so you can get access to Data Migrator.

name: Verify the control plane deployment
description: Confirm that the control plane VM deployed correctly by checking the boot service status, logs and Kubernetes pods.

name: Generate a support bundle
description: Generate a support bundle for a chosen date range and set of metrics from the Help menu.

name: Register the instance for support
description: Record the instance ID from the About dialog and use it to register the instance for NetApp support.

name: Resolve metadata update conflicts after cutover
description: Use the cutover chain-of-custody report's metadata conflict CSV and PowerShell on the Windows worker to fix metadata that failed to update during cutover.

name: Retrieve application credentials from OpenBao
description: Fetch the OpenBao root token and look up the stored credentials used to access the Data Migrator, Keycloak, Temporal and Postgres interfaces.

name: Troubleshoot an SMB mount failure caused by a host name

name: Troubleshoot Azure VM access
description: Restore access to an Azure-hosted control plane VM by restarting it or resetting its SSH public key from the Azure portal.

name: Unseal OpenBao
description: Unseal the OpenBao secrets store on the control plane server with the unseal key so the application can reach its secrets again.

name: Upgrade the control plane and workers
description: Upload an upgrade bundle and upgrade the control plane and worker nodes to a new release, checking the logs as needed.

name: View capacity and storage efficiency savings

name: Manage a watchlist
description: View, edit or delete an existing watchlist.

name: Manage config drift templates
description: Clone, share, edit or delete existing configuration drift templates.

name: View storage system inventory
description: View and download inventory details for systems and support-entitled switches in your install base.

name: Renew support contracts
description: Select systems with expired or expiring software and hardware support contracts and send a renewal request.

name: Upgrade a support offering
description: Request an upgrade of the support offering for a storage system, optionally after comparing the available offerings.

name: Acknowledge storage system risks

name: Generate or schedule a report

name: View cluster and node health

name: View storage system performance graphs

name: View storage system risk history
description: View the wellness risk history graph for a selected risk category over time.

name: View the sustainability dashboard
description: Open the sustainability dashboard to view the sustainability score and power and carbon metrics of storage systems.

name: View the Value Insights dashboard
description: Review overall health, NetApp-delivered savings and stability, and security and planning insights on the Value Insights dashboard.

name: View virtual machine data from Data Infrastructure Insights
description: View virtual machine and ESX host data collected by Data Infrastructure Insights from the Digital Advisor inventory.

name: Remediate ransomware risks
description: Review ransomware defense risks for storage systems and apply the recommended actions to protect them.

name: Remediate security vulnerabilities
description: Detect high-impact security vulnerabilities on storage systems and apply the recommended corrective actions, such as upgrading the OS.

name: View and remediate storage system risks
description: Review the risks behind wellness actions and apply corrective actions, manually or through Unified Manager or generated Ansible scripts.

name: View support cases with the Valuable Insights widget
description: Review support cases and the business and technical value details for a storage system in the Valuable Insights widget.

name: Download the firmware update Ansible package
description: Download the disk, shelf and other firmware update Ansible package for your systems from the firmware upgrade risks in Digital Advisor.

name: Generate an ONTAP upgrade plan
description: Generate an upgrade plan to the recommended target ONTAP version for one or more eligible clusters.

name: Host firmware files on a web server
description: Place the downloaded firmware files on a web server and record its base URL so the Ansible playbook can retrieve them.

name: Update storage firmware using an Ansible playbook
description: Run the NetApp firmware update Ansible playbook, either inside the NetApp Docker image or on a host with Ansible installed, to update disk, shelf and other firmware on the cluster.

description: Confirm from the cluster CLI that the new disk, Flash Cache, shelf and ACP firmware versions are installed after the update.

name: View firmware update recommendations
description: Review the firmware update recommendations for your clusters and track update progress and eligibility.

description: Add entries to the Web Services Proxy cors.cfg file to allow cross-origin requests to the API.

name: Download the command line interface

name: Change the default host type

name: Change the host protocol
description: Convert the controller host I/O module or host ports to a different host protocol.

name: Configure NVMe over RoCE or TCP connectivity between hosts and the storage array
description: The protocol-specific NVMe over Ethernet setup is complete: switches, host networking and array-side ports are configured.

description: The Linux host discovers the storage array's NVMe-oF subsystems on every path and connects to them so the namespaces become visible.

name: Create a host

description: Remove a host or host cluster definition from the storage array.

name: View iSCSI sessions
description: Display iSCSI sessions connected to the storage array and optionally save the report.

name: View storage systems

description: Delete a snapshot consistency group.

description: Delete a snapshot image.

name: Delete a snapshot schedule
description: Delete a snapshot schedule.

description: Delete a snapshot volume.

description: Increase the reserved capacity allocated to a storage object used by copy services.

description: Change the settings of a snapshot consistency group.
