name: Replace a host interface card
description: Replace a failed host interface card (host I/O module) with one of the same type to restore host connectivity.

name: Replace a power supply
description: Hot-swap a failed power supply or power canister in a controller or drive shelf to restore power redundancy.

name: Turn on a drive locator light
description: Turn on the locator LED of a drive to find it physically.

name: Turn on a shelf locator light
description: Light the locator LED on a shelf to physically identify it, then turn it off.

name: Turn on locator lights for a pool, volume group or SSD Cache
description: Turn on the locator lights of all drives in a pool, volume group or SSD Cache to find them physically.

name: Turn on storage array locator lights
description: Light the locator LEDs of the storage array to physically identify it, then turn them off.

name: Unassign a hot spare
description: Return a hot spare drive to the unassigned state.

name: Update battery learn cycles
description: Change the schedule of the automatic controller battery learn cycles.

name: Upgrade a host interface card
description: Replace existing host interface cards (host I/O modules) with a different type to change or increase host port connectivity.

name: View drive status and settings
description: Display drives, filtered by attributes if needed, and view the status and settings of a selected drive.

name: View hardware components
description: Display shelves, controllers, drives and other hardware components with their status.

name: Configure multipath failover on a host
description: The host's multipath software (DM-Multipath, native NVMe multipathing or the Windows DSM) is installed or enabled so I/O fails over between paths to the storage array.

name: Configure the NVMe multipath I/O policy
description: The Linux host's NVMe multipath I/O policy is checked and set to round-robin.

name: Create a file system on a mapped volume on the host
description: A mapped volume on the host is partitioned where needed, formatted with a file system or VMFS datastore, and mounted so it is ready to use.

name: Determine host port GUIDs for InfiniBand
description: The host's InfiniBand port GUIDs are found with ibstat and recorded, and the recommended HBA settings are applied.

name: Determine host WWPNs
description: The HBA vendor utility is installed, the host's FC worldwide port names are found, and the recommended HBA settings are applied.

name: Determine SAS host identifiers
description: The host's SAS HBA identifiers are found with the HBA vendor utility or BIOS and recorded, and the recommended HBA settings are applied.

name: Discover storage on the host
description: The host rescans its storage adapters so volumes newly assigned on the array are detected.

name: Set up the NVMe-oF initiator on a Linux host
description: The Linux host has the NVMe packages, transport modules and interfaces it needs to act as an NVMe-oF initiator, and its host NQN has been retrieved.

name: Enable a feature pack
description: Apply a feature pack key file to change the features enabled on the storage array.

name: Enable a premium feature
description: Enable a premium feature by applying its feature key file.

name: Obtain a feature key file
description: Gather the chassis serial number and feature enable identifier and request a feature key file from NetApp.

name: Add a syslog server for alerts
description: Add one or more syslog servers (up to five) that receive storage array alerts and send a test alert.

name: Add alert email recipients
description: Add email addresses that receive storage array alert notifications.

name: Add an SNMP community
description: Add a community name for SNMPv2c trap alerts.

name: Add an SNMPv3 trap user
description: Define a new SNMPv3 user for sending traps.

name: Add SNMP trap destinations
description: Add trap destinations with their community or user names and send a test trap.

name: Configure SNMP alerts
description: Set up SNMP alerting by choosing SNMPv2c communities or SNMPv3 users so traps can be sent to a server.

name: Configure SNMP MIB variables
description: Set the SNMP MIB-II system variables such as name, location and contact.

name: Configure statistics polling intervals
description: Set how often the Web Services Proxy automatically polls storage systems for statistics.

name: Configure the mail server and alert recipients
description: Set the mail server and sender information for email alerts and add recipient addresses.

name: Delete a syslog server for alerts
description: Remove a syslog server from the alert configuration.

name: Delete SNMP trap destinations
description: Remove trap destinations so they no longer receive SNMP alerts.

name: Delete the alert mail server or email recipients
description: Delete the configured mail server or selected recipient addresses for email alerts.

name: Import alert settings to other storage arrays
description: Copy alert configuration from one storage array to multiple other storage arrays.

name: Modify a syslog server for alerts
description: Edit the address and UDP port of a syslog server used for alerts.

name: Modify alert email recipients
description: Change an email address that receives storage array alert notifications.

name: Modify an SNMP community
description: Rename an existing community used for SNMPv2c trap alerts.

name: Modify an SNMPv3 trap user
description: Edit the name and authentication or privacy settings of an SNMPv3 trap user.

name: Modify the alert mail server
description: Change the mail server address, sender information and contact information used for email alerts.

name: Remove an SNMP community
description: Delete a community used for SNMPv2c trap alerts.

name: Remove an SNMPv3 trap user
description: Delete an SNMPv3 user used for traps.

name: Set the default time range for performance graphs
description: Choose the default time range shown in performance graphs.

name: Show or hide hardware component status descriptions
description: Display or hide pop-over status descriptions for drives, controllers, fans and power supplies in the hardware view.

name: View iSCSI statistics
description: View iSCSI protocol statistics for the storage array.

name: View iSER over InfiniBand statistics
description: Display iSER over InfiniBand statistics and optionally set a new baseline.

name: View NVMe over Fabrics statistics
description: Display NVMe over Fabrics statistics for the storage array, optionally setting a new baseline.

name: View operations in progress
description: Display long-running operations on the storage array and optionally stop, reprioritize or clear them.

name: View performance data
description: Display performance metrics for storage objects as graphs or a table, and optionally export the tabular data to CSV.

name: View shelf component status and settings
description: Display the status and settings of shelf components such as power supplies, fans and batteries.

name: View SSD Cache statistics
description: View performance statistics for an SSD Cache.

name: View the event log
description: Display, refresh, save or clear the storage array event log.

name: Change Web Services Proxy ports to resolve port conflicts
description: Assign different port numbers in wsconfig.xml and restart the webserver so the proxy no longer conflicts with other services.

name: Configure a management port
description: Set the speed and IPv4/IPv6 addressing of a controller's management port.

name: Configure an InfiniBand subnet manager on a host
description: OpenSM is installed and set to run at boot on the host's HCA ports, so the InfiniBand fabric has a subnet manager.

name: Configure controller management IP addresses using DHCP
description: The storage array controllers' management ports get IP addresses from a DHCP server so the array can be reached from the management station.

name: Configure DNS server addresses
description: Set the DNS server addresses used by the controllers, manually or via DHCP.

name: Configure host networking for iSER over InfiniBand
description: The host's iSCSI services, InfiniBand interfaces and iSER settings are configured so it can connect to the array over iSER.

name: Configure host networking for SRP over InfiniBand
description: The host's OFED/RDMA stack is installed and configured to load the SRP module and daemon so it can connect to the array over SRP.

name: Configure host-side iSCSI networking
description: The host iSCSI initiator is configured (session count, replacement timeout, startup mode) and its sessions to the array's iSCSI ports are started.

name: Configure network switches for NVMe over RoCE
description: The Ethernet switches carrying NVMe over RoCE traffic have end-to-end flow control (Priority Flow Control or Global Pause Frames) enabled.

name: Verify IP network connections between host and storage array
description: Pings from each host initiator address to each array port confirm that the IP network paths work, including jumbo frames.

name: Add a directory server
description: Add an LDAP directory server for user authentication and role mapping.

name: Add a syslog server for audit logs
description: Add a syslog server that receives audit log records and test the connection.

name: Change a local user password
description: Change the password of a local user profile, such as admin.

name: Change the Cloud Connector password
description: Replace the Cloud Connector administrator password with a new one.

name: Configure login lockout
description: View and set the Web Services Proxy login lockout settings through the settings/lockout API endpoints.

name: Configure role-based access for Web Services Proxy users
description: Add or remove roles for Web Services Proxy user accounts in the users.properties file.

name: Configure SAML authentication
description: Configure SAML single sign-on by uploading IdP metadata, exporting service provider files, mapping roles and testing SSO login.

name: Configure session timeout
description: Enable or disable the management session timeout and set its duration.

name: Configure SSH remote login for a controller
description: Enable or disable remote SSH login to a controller.

name: Configure the login banner
description: Set the text of the banner shown to users before they log in.

name: Create an access token
description: Generate an access token with a chosen validity duration for authenticating to the storage array REST API and CLI.

name: Define audit log policies
description: Set the audit log overwrite policy and the types of events recorded.

name: Delete events from the audit log
description: Delete a number of the oldest audit log events, optionally exporting them to CSV first.

name: Delete trusted certificates
description: Remove one or more imported trusted (CA) certificates from the E-Series certificate store.

name: Disable certificate validation for storage arrays
description: Set trust.all.arrays to true in wsconfig.xml so the Web Services Proxy skips certificate validation for storage arrays.

name: Disable SYMbol HTTPS
description: Change the device-management SYMbol client strategy in wsconfig.xml so the proxy stops preferring HTTPS for SYMbol communication with arrays.

name: Enable certificate revocation checking
description: Enable OCSP-based checking of revoked certificates, optionally specifying an OCSP responder address.

name: Enable SSL for the Web Services Proxy
description: Set the SSL port in wsconfig.xml so the Web Services Proxy serves HTTPS.

name: Encrypt user passwords in the Web Services Proxy
description: Re-encrypt the passwords stored in the Web Services Proxy users.properties file with the securepasswds utility or a service restart.

name: Erase drives
description: Securely erase unassigned drives so their data cannot be recovered before reuse or removal.

name: Export certificates
description: Export installed certificates to a file.

name: Export SAML service provider metadata
description: Save the SAML service provider metadata file so it can be registered with the identity provider.

name: Import a StorageGRID certificate into the Cloud Connector keystore
description: Stop the service, import the StorageGRID certificate into the application keystore and restart it so Cloud Connector trusts the StorageGRID target.

name: Import directory services settings to other storage arrays
description: Copy directory services configuration from one storage array to multiple other storage arrays.

name: Import trusted certificates
description: Import CA-signed or self-signed certificates into the trusted certificate store (System Manager for the controllers, or Unified Manager / Storage Plugin for vCenter for managed arrays) so that the peer's chain of trust validates, including resolving untrusted certificates.

name: Install a server certificate for Cloud Connector
description: Create a server certificate and CSR with keytool, get it signed by a CA and import the server and CA certificates into the Cloud Connector keystore.

name: Install CA-signed management certificates
description: Complete a certificate signing request for the array management interface, submit it to a certificate authority, and import the signed certificate chain. The management interface is the controllers in System Manager, or the management server in Unified Manager, the vCenter plugin or the Web Services Proxy. After the import, browsers connect without certificate warnings.

name: Modify a syslog server for audit logs
description: Edit the address, port or protocol of a syslog server that receives audit log records.

name: Modify access token settings
description: Enable or disable access tokens for the storage array and change the token expiration settings.

name: Modify directory server settings and role mappings
description: Edit the connection settings and group-to-role mappings of an existing directory server.

name: Modify local user password settings
description: Change local user password policy settings such as whether passwords are required and the minimum password length.

name: Modify SAML role mappings
description: Assign identity provider user attributes and groups to the predefined management roles.

name: Remove a directory server
description: Remove a directory server connection and its role mappings.

name: Reset management certificates
description: Revert management certificates to the original self-signed certificate.

name: Revoke access tokens
description: Invalidate all existing access tokens on the storage array.

name: Update stored storage array passwords
description: Update the storage array passwords that the management software stores.

name: View audit log activity
description: Display and filter the security audit log events recorded on the storage array.

name: View certificates
description: View installed management and trusted certificate information.

name: View local user roles
description: Display the local user roles and their permissions.

name: Cable storage system hardware
description: Cable the inter-controller mirroring, host and SAS drive shelf connections of the storage system.

name: Complete storage system setup
description: Cable the data hosts, connect and configure the management connection and perform the initial storage system configuration.

name: Configure Cloud Connector for the first time
description: Log in with the default password and use the configuration wizard to set the admin password and pass phrase, choose the target type and connect to the Web Services Proxy.

name: Connect power and power on the storage system
description: Connect each shelf's power supplies to separate PDUs and power on the drive shelves and then the controller shelves.

name: Install a 40U storage cabinet
description: Gather tools, unpack and move the cabinet to its permanent location, then level it and reinstall trays to complete the cabinet installation.

name: Install Cloud Connector
description: Run the Cloud Connector installer on a Linux host.

name: Install SANtricity Storage Manager on a management station
description: SANtricity Storage Manager, which provides SMcli, is downloaded and installed on the management station or host.

name: Install storage system hardware in a rack
description: Prepare the site and unpack the storage system, then mount and secure its controller and drive shelves in a rack or cabinet.

name: Install the Web Services Proxy
description: Download the Web Services Proxy and Unified Manager package and install it on a host server.

name: Log in to Unified Manager on the Web Services Proxy
description: Open Unified Manager (or the interactive Web Services API documentation) in a browser at the Web Services Proxy server address and sign in, setting the admin password on first login.

name: Perform initial storage array setup with the System Manager Setup wizard
description: Browse to a controller IP address, set the administrator password on first login, and use the System Manager Setup wizard to verify hardware and hosts, name the array, accept pools, configure alerts and enable AutoSupport.

name: Verify host configuration support in the Interoperability Matrix
description: The NetApp Interoperability Matrix Tool confirms that the planned host OS, protocol and storage array combination is supported.

name: Add capacity to a pool or volume group
description: Add unassigned drives to an existing E-Series pool or volume group to expand its capacity.

name: Add volumes to a workload
description: Create and add volumes to an existing E-Series application workload.

name: Change volume cache settings
description: Modify the read and write cache settings of a volume.

name: Change volume controller ownership
description: Change which controller owns a volume.

name: Change volume media scan settings
description: Enable, disable, or adjust media scan settings for a volume.

name: Configure resource provisioning for new pools and volume groups
description: Enable or disable the system-wide setting that makes new pools and volume groups resource-provisioned.

name: Configure resource provisioning on an existing pool or volume group
description: Enable or disable resource provisioning on an existing pool or volume group.

name: Create a pool
description: Create an E-Series disk pool, automatically or manually, from unassigned drives.

name: Create a volume group
description: Create an E-Series volume group from a set of drives with a chosen RAID level.

name: Create a workload
description: Create an application workload of a chosen application type.

name: Create an SSD Cache
description: Create an SSD Cache from SSD drives to accelerate read performance.

name: Create volumes
description: Create one or more E-Series volumes in a pool or volume group and optionally assign them to a host.

name: Delete a pool or volume group
description: Delete a pool or volume group and its volumes to return drives to unassigned capacity.

name: Delete a volume
description: Delete an existing E-Series volume and free its capacity back to the pool or volume group.

name: Import a remote storage volume
description: Import data from a remote storage device volume to a local volume on the storage array.

name: Import storage configuration settings to other storage arrays
description: Copy the storage configuration of a source storage array to one or more target storage arrays.

name: Increase the capacity of a volume
description: Expand the reported capacity of an existing E-Series volume using free capacity in its pool or volume group.

name: Initialize volumes
description: Initialize one or more volumes, erasing their data.

name: Manage remote storage import progress
description: From the Remote Storage page in System Manager, open View Operations to see the progress of each remote storage import (percent complete, time remaining). Where needed, stop, resume, reprioritize or disconnect an import.

name: Modify pool settings
description: Change the configuration settings (name, capacity alerts, preservation capacity, priority) of an existing E-Series disk pool.

name: Modify remote storage connection settings
description: Change the connection settings of a remote storage object used for remote storage volume import.

name: Modify SSD Cache settings
description: Change the settings of an existing SSD Cache, such as its name.

name: Modify volume group settings
description: Change the configuration settings of a volume group, such as its name or capacity alert thresholds.

name: Modify volume settings
description: Change the settings of an existing E-Series volume, such as name, host I/O caching, media scan, or ownership.

name: Modify workload settings
description: Change the name or application attributes of a workload.

name: Provision storage for a vSphere datastore
description: Create volumes, set up host access, assign the volumes and create a datastore in the vSphere Client.

name: Remove a remote storage object
description: Remove a remote storage object after a remote storage import is complete or no longer needed.

name: Remove capacity from a pool or SSD Cache
description: Remove drives to reduce the capacity of an existing pool or SSD Cache.

name: Check volume redundancy
description: Check the redundancy data of volumes for consistency.

name: Clear recovery mode
description: Take the storage array out of recovery mode after the underlying condition has been resolved.

name: Collect configuration data
description: Save the storage array's RAID configuration data to a file for technical support.

name: Collect I/O path statistics
description: Save I/O path statistics to a file for technical support analysis.

name: Collect support data
description: Manually collect a support data bundle from the storage array to send to technical support.

name: Configure AutoSupport features
description: Enable or disable individual AutoSupport features for the storage array.

name: Configure the AutoSupport delivery method
description: Select HTTPS or SMTP delivery for AutoSupport dispatches, set its parameters and test the connection to technical support.

name: Disable the AutoSupport maintenance window
description: End the AutoSupport maintenance window so that automatic support case creation resumes.

name: Enable the AutoSupport maintenance window
description: Start an AutoSupport maintenance window of a set duration that suppresses automatic support case creation.

name: Import AutoSupport settings to other storage arrays
description: Copy AutoSupport configuration from one storage array to multiple other storage arrays.

name: Re-enable drive ports
description: Re-enable drive ports that were disabled after an error once the problem is corrected.

name: Recover from problems using the Recovery Guru
description: Follow Recovery Guru guidance to diagnose and fix reported storage array problems and recheck the result.

name: Retrieve a health image
description: Capture a controller health image for technical support analysis.

name: Retrieve recovery support files
description: Download recovery support files from the storage array for technical support.

name: Retrieve trace buffers
description: Save controller trace buffers to a file for technical support analysis.

name: Schedule AutoSupport dispatches
description: Set the days and times at which AutoSupport dispatches are sent.

name: Send an AutoSupport dispatch
description: Manually send an AutoSupport dispatch to technical support.

name: View AutoSupport status
description: Show whether AutoSupport and its individual features are enabled.

name: View software and firmware inventory
description: Display and save the storage array's software and firmware version inventory.

name: View the AutoSupport log
description: Display current or archived AutoSupport logs and search them for dispatch status and history.

name: View the storage array profile
description: Display, search and save the detailed storage array profile.

name: View the unreadable sectors log
description: Display, save or clear the log of unreadable sectors detected on drives.

name: Activate staged OS software
description: Activate controller OS software and firmware that was transferred but not yet activated.

name: Clear staged OS software
description: Remove staged controller OS software that has not been activated.

name: Manage the software repository
description: Add or remove OS software files in the software repository used for controller upgrades.

name: Review SANtricity OS upgrade considerations
description: Describes how dual controllers fail over and take back LUNs so I/O continues during a SANtricity OS upgrade.

name: Run a pre-upgrade health check
description: Run the pre-upgrade health check on selected storage arrays to confirm they are ready for a software upgrade.

name: Uninstall Cloud Connector
description: Remove Cloud Connector from the host by running its uninstaller.

name: Uninstall the Web Services Proxy
description: Remove the Web Services Proxy and Unified Manager from the host server.

name: Upgrade controller OS software and NVSRAM
description: Upgrade the controller operating system software and NVSRAM firmware on one or more storage arrays.

name: Upgrade drive firmware
description: Upgrade the firmware on storage array drives.

name: Upgrade storage controllers
description: Prepare the array, remove the existing controllers and batteries, install new controllers, power on and validate the controller software version.

name: Access the management node REST API UI
description: Open the management services REST API UI and authorize with cluster administrator credentials.

name: Add initiators to a volume access group
description: Add one or more initiators to a volume access group.

name: Add volumes to a volume access group
description: Add one or more volumes to a volume access group.

name: Assign LUN IDs to Fibre Channel volumes
description: Set the LUN IDs of Fibre Channel volumes in a volume access group.

name: Create a volume access group
description: Create a volume access group that maps initiators to volumes.

name: Create an initiator
description: Create one or more iSCSI or Fibre Channel initiators on the storage cluster.

name: Delete a volume access group
description: Delete a volume access group.

name: Delete an initiator
description: Delete one or more initiators from the storage cluster.

name: Modify a volume access group
description: Edit the name or attributes of a volume access group.

name: Modify an initiator
description: Change the alias or attributes of an existing initiator.

name: Remove initiators from a volume access group
description: Remove one or more initiators from a volume access group so that they no longer reach its volumes.

name: Remove volumes from a volume access group
description: Remove one or more volumes from a volume access group so that its initiators no longer reach them.

name: View Fibre Channel port details
description: Display the status and details of the cluster's Fibre Channel ports.

name: View Fibre Channel sessions
description: Display the active Fibre Channel sessions to the cluster, with optional filters.

name: View iSCSI sessions
description: View active iSCSI sessions and their connection status.

name: View volume access group details
description: Display the details of a volume access group, including its initiators and volumes.

name: Configure custom protection domains
description: Create custom protection domains and assign storage nodes to them so that data stays available if a whole domain fails.

name: Set protection domain monitoring
description: Set the protection domain monitoring level for a storage cluster.

name: Reclaim datastore space with VAAI UNMAP
description: Run VAAI UNMAP on a datastore to return freed blocks to the cluster.

name: Set the cluster full threshold
description: Set the capacity percentage at which the cluster raises a cluster-full warning alert.

name: Access Hybrid Cloud Control
description: Open the management node address in a browser and log in to Hybrid Cloud Control.

name: Access the management node per-node UI
description: Open and log in to the per-node UI of the management node.

name: Add a node to a storage cluster
description: Add one or more pending nodes, including Fibre Channel nodes, to an existing Element storage cluster so that they become active.

name: Add a storage cluster to the management node inventory
description: Add a storage cluster asset so the management node can manage it.

name: Add an asset to the management node
description: Add a controller (vCenter), compute node or BMC hardware asset to the management node inventory by using the REST API.

name: Add drives to a cluster
description: Add available drives, block or metadata (slice/MDSS) drives, to the Element storage cluster so that they take part in the cluster.

name: Configure NTP for the cluster
description: Set the cluster's time source, either NTP servers that the cluster queries or NTP broadcast servers that it listens to.

name: Disable maintenance mode on a storage node
description: Take a storage node out of maintenance mode in Hybrid Cloud Control.

name: Disable the smartd service on compute nodes
description: Stop the smartd service on ESXi compute nodes and prevent it starting at boot.

name: Enable maintenance mode on a storage node
description: Put a storage node into maintenance mode in Hybrid Cloud Control.

name: Enable or disable volume load balancing
description: Turn cluster volume load balancing on or off, so volumes are balanced across nodes by their QoS settings or by actual usage.

name: Log in to the Element software UI
description: Open the Element software UI with the cluster MVIP or host name.

name: Modify a controller asset
description: Edit the stored properties of a vCenter controller asset on the management node.

name: Modify BMC connection information for a compute node
description: Update the stored BMC credentials and connection information of a compute node on the management node.

name: Modify management node cluster settings
description: View or change the cluster settings of the management node in its per-node UI.

name: Modify storage cluster credentials
description: Update the stored credentials of a storage cluster asset on the management node.

name: Power off compute resources
description: Shut down VMs, ESXi hosts and the vCenter appliance to power off the compute side of a NetApp HCI system.

name: Power on compute resources
description: Power on compute nodes and the vCenter appliance and verify datastores are visible.

name: Power on storage resources
description: Power on storage nodes and verify the storage cluster is online.

name: Remove a drive from a cluster
description: Remove one or more drives, including failed or MDSS slice drives, from the Element storage cluster.

name: Remove a node from a storage cluster
description: Remove one or more nodes from an Element storage cluster.

name: Remove a storage cluster from the management node inventory
description: Remove a storage cluster asset from the management node.

name: Remove an asset from the management node
description: Remove a compute, controller or storage asset from the management node inventory by using the REST API.

name: Remove Witness Nodes after expanding a cluster
description: Remove Witness Nodes from a storage cluster once it has been expanded beyond two storage nodes.

name: Restart a node
description: Restart a node in an Element storage cluster.

name: Shut down a storage cluster
description: Stop host I/O and halt all nodes of an Element storage cluster in an orderly way, using the Shutdown API or the vCenter Plug-in Shutdown action.

name: Shut down a storage node
description: Shut down a node in the storage cluster from the vCenter Plug-in.

name: Test the management node settings
description: Run system tests from the management node UI to validate its network and cluster settings.

name: View cluster details
description: Display the details of a storage cluster registered in the vCenter Plug-in.

name: View controller assets
description: View the stored vCenter controller assets on the management node and their connection status.

name: View drive details
description: View details of the active drives in the storage cluster.

name: View management node OS and services versions
description: Check the management node OS version and the versions of the management services from the REST API UI.

name: View NetApp HCI inventory
description: Display the storage and compute nodes of an installation and their details.

name: View node details
description: Display the configuration and status details of a storage node.

name: View storage cluster assets in the management node inventory
description: View the storage cluster assets registered in the management node inventory, including their IDs, installation ID and connection status.

name: View the hardware tag of a compute node
description: Find the hardware tag of a compute node needed for management node API calls.

name: Add a rule to a replication policy
description: Define a rule in a custom SnapMirror policy that says which labelled snapshots are transferred and how many are kept.

name: Add SnapMirror labels to snapshot schedules
description: Tag a snapshot schedule with a SnapMirror label so that its snapshots are replicated according to a SnapMirror policy.

name: Add SnapMirror labels to snapshots
description: Tag an existing snapshot or group snapshot with a SnapMirror label so that a SnapMirror policy transfers it.

name: Assign a replication source and target to paired volumes
description: Set the replication source and target volumes in a volume pair.

description: Create clones of the volumes captured in a group snapshot.

name: Copy a snapshot schedule

description: Create a custom SnapMirror policy for replication between Element and ONTAP.

name: Create a group snapshot
description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a group of volumes.

name: Create a replication target volume
description: Create a volume with replication-target access on the remote cluster so that it can be paired as a replication target.

name: Create a SnapMirror endpoint
description: Register an ONTAP cluster as a SnapMirror endpoint on the Element cluster, using its management IP and credentials.

name: Create a SnapMirror relationship
description: Create a SnapMirror replication relationship between an Element volume and an ONTAP volume.

name: Create a snapshot schedule
description: Create a schedule that automatically takes snapshots of one or more volumes at set intervals.

name: Create a volume snapshot
description: Create a snapshot of a volume.

name: Delete a cluster pair
description: Delete a replication pairing between two clusters.

name: Delete a group snapshot
description: Delete a group snapshot.

name: Delete a snapshot schedule
description: Delete a snapshot schedule.

name: Delete a volume pair
description: Remove a replication pairing between two volumes.

name: Delete a volume snapshot
description: Delete an individual volume snapshot.

description: Create a portset, optionally with network interfaces, and bind it to an igroup.

name: Create a vVol binding
description: Bind a vVol LUN to a protocol endpoint LUN.

name: Create a WWPN alias
description: Create an alias for an FC initiator WWPN in an SVM.

name: Create an initiator group
description: Create an initiator group (called a host group on ASA r2 systems) with initiators, with no initiators, or with nested igroups, so that LUNs can be mapped to those hosts.

name: Create an NVMe LIF
description: Create a network interface with an NVMe data protocol and verify it is online.

name: Create an NVMe subsystem
description: Create an NVMe subsystem, optionally with one or more host NQNs.

name: Create SAN LIFs before transition
description: FC or iSCSI LIFs are created on the target node and its HA partner for the LUNs being transitioned.

name: Delete a portset
description: Delete a portset.

name: Delete a vVol binding
description: Remove the binding between a vVol LUN and a protocol endpoint.

name: Delete a WWPN alias
description: Delete an FC WWPN alias from an SVM.

name: Delete an initiator group
description: Delete an initiator group (host group on ASA r2 systems), including one that is mapped.

name: Delete an NVMe subsystem
description: Delete an NVMe subsystem, including one that still has hosts or mapped namespaces.

name: Delete the FC service
description: The FC service is stopped and removed from an SVM.

name: Delete the iSCSI service
description: The iSCSI service is stopped and removed from an SVM.

name: Delete the NVMe service from an SVM
description: Stop and delete the NVMe service from an SVM.

name: Determine supported FC target port speeds
description: Look up the FC target port speeds supported by the system and ONTAP version.

name: Determine the maximum supported SAN nodes and hosts per cluster
description: Look up the maximum supported nodes and SAN hosts per cluster for the platform and ONTAP version.

name: Determine whether the cluster can support more SAN hosts
description: The current number of FC ITNs or iSCSI sessions is counted to determine whether the cluster can support additional SAN hosts.

name: Disable an FC port
description: An FC port is administratively disabled.

name: Disable automated host discovery of NVMe/TCP controllers
description: Automated discovery of NVMe/TCP controllers by hosts is disabled on the SVM.

name: Disable the FC service
description: The FC service of an SVM is disabled so it stops serving FC traffic.

name: Disable the iSCSI service
description: The iSCSI service of an SVM is disabled so it stops serving iSCSI traffic.

name: Disable the NVMe service on an SVM
description: Disable (stop) the NVMe service of an SVM without deleting it.

name: Enable automated host discovery of NVMe/TCP controllers
description: Automated discovery of NVMe/TCP controllers by hosts is enabled on the SVM.

name: Enable or disable iSCSI on a network interface
description: Enable or disable the iSCSI service on individual storage system network interfaces.

name: Map a LUN to an igroup
description: Map one or more LUNs (block devices or storage units) to an initiator group so that its host initiators can access them, creating the igroup if needed.

name: Map an NVMe namespace to a subsystem
description: Create an NVMe subsystem map so the namespace is accessible to the subsystem's hosts.

name: Modify a portset
description: Change the network interfaces (LIFs) associated with a portset.

name: Modify an initiator
description: Edits the name of an initiator in an initiator group.

name: Modify an initiator group
description: Change the properties of an existing initiator group, such as its name, description, OS type or client access.

name: Modify an NVMe subsystem
description: Change the properties of an existing NVMe subsystem, such as its comment.

name: Modify the FC adapter speed
description: The FC adapter is taken offline, its speed is changed to a supported value and it is brought back online.

name: Modify the FC node name
description: The FC/FCoE world wide node name of an SVM is changed.

name: Register an SVM with an iSNS server
description: Register an SVM's iSCSI service with an iSNS server for target discovery.

name: Remove a host from an NVMe subsystem
description: Remove a host NQN from an NVMe subsystem.

name: Remove a nested initiator group from an initiator group
description: Remove a child initiator group from a parent initiator group, including when the parent is mapped to LUNs.

name: Remove a network interface from a portset
description: Remove a SAN LIF from a portset, unbinding the portset from its igroup first if it is the last LIF.

name: Remove a reporting node from a LUN map
description: Remove a node from the reporting-nodes list of a LUN map so the LUN is no longer reported through that node's paths.

name: Remove initiators from an initiator group
description: Remove one or more initiators from an initiator group, including a mapped initiator group.

name: Restore a single LUN from a snapshot
description: Restore one LUN in a volume from a snapshot after stopping host access.

name: Restore a single LUN from a SnapVault backup
description: Restore a LUN from a SnapVault secondary volume by cloning the backup snapshot and copying the LUN.

name: Set the iSCSI target alias
description: A user-friendly alias is assigned to the SVM iSCSI target.

name: Start or stop the FC service on an SVM
description: Start or stop the FC/FCoE protocol service of an SVM.

name: Start or stop the iSCSI service on an SVM
description: Start or stop the iSCSI protocol service of an SVM.

name: Start or stop the NVMe service
description: The NVMe service of an SVM is started or stopped.

name: Unmap a LUN from an igroup
description: A LUN mapping to an igroup is removed.

name: Unmap an NVMe namespace from a subsystem
description: Delete an NVMe subsystem map so the namespace is no longer presented to the subsystem.

name: Update LUN map reporting nodes for a volume move
description: Add the destination nodes to and remove the previous or remote nodes from the Selective LUN Map reporting-nodes list around a volume or LUN move so that hosts keep optimized paths.

name: Verify host connectivity
description: Check in System Manager that SAN hosts are connected to the storage system.

name: Verify that the FC configuration is supported
description: Check the Interoperability Matrix to confirm the host, HBA and ONTAP FC configuration is supported.

name: Verify that the FC service is running on an SVM
description: Confirm that the FC service is running on an existing SVM and that FC LIFs are configured before provisioning.

name: Verify that the iSCSI configuration is supported
description: Check the Interoperability Matrix to confirm the host and ONTAP iSCSI configuration is supported.

name: Verify that the iSCSI service is running on an SVM
description: Confirm that the iSCSI service is running on an existing SVM and that iSCSI LIFs are configured before provisioning.

name: View FC adapter ports
description: Display the physical FC adapter ports on the cluster nodes and their settings, such as state, speed and WWPN.

name: View FC fabric switches
description: Retrieve all switches of a Fibre Channel fabric connected to the cluster.

name: View FC fabric zones
description: Retrieve the zones of the active zoneset of a Fibre Channel fabric.

name: View FC fabrics
description: The FC fabrics connected to the cluster, and the devices attached to them, are displayed.

name: View FC services
description: The FC service configuration of one or all SVMs is displayed.

name: View initiator groups
description: List initiator groups (igroups) and their properties, initiators and mapped LUNs, for all igroups or a specific one.

name: View iSCSI services
description: The iSCSI service configuration of one or all SVMs is displayed.

name: View iSCSI sessions
description: Retrieve iSCSI sessions, for all sessions, a specific session or a target portal group.

name: View LUN maps
description: Retrieve the LUN-to-igroup mappings in the cluster or the details of a specific LUN map.

name: View LUNs
description: List LUNs (storage units or block devices) or show the details of a specific LUN, including its configured and used space.

name: View NVMe interfaces
description: List NVMe interfaces, or show the details of one.

name: View NVMe services
description: List the NVMe services on SVMs, or show the details of one.

name: View NVMe subsystem controllers
description: Retrieve the NVMe subsystem controllers for the whole system, for one subsystem or a specific controller.

name: View NVMe subsystem hosts
description: Retrieve all hosts of an NVMe subsystem or a specific subsystem host.

name: View NVMe subsystem maps
description: Retrieve all NVMe namespace-to-subsystem maps or a specific map.

name: View NVMe subsystems
description: Retrieve NVMe subsystems and their properties, including the namespaces mapped to a subsystem.

name: View portsets
description: List portsets, or show the details of one.

name: View SAN initiators
description: The SAN initiators known to the SVM and their igroup membership are displayed.

name: View vVol bindings
description: Retrieve all vVol bindings or a specific binding.

name: View WWPN aliases
description: Retrieve FC WWPN aliases, all or filtered by name or a specific alias.

name: Zone FC switches by host initiator and LIF WWPNs
description: Create and activate FC switch zones that group each host initiator WWPN with the target FC LIF WWPNs so the hosts can reach the cluster.

name: Add a mediator to a cluster
description: Install the mediator CA certificate and add an ONTAP Mediator or ONTAP Cloud Mediator to the cluster and its peer so it can arbitrate SnapMirror active sync or MetroCluster IP automatic unplanned switchover.

name: Add MetroCluster configurations to Tiebreaker monitoring
description: MetroCluster configurations are added to the Tiebreaker software for monitoring and observer mode is optionally disabled so automatic switchover can occur.

name: Add or remove volumes in a SnapMirror active sync consistency group
description: Change the volume membership of a SnapMirror active sync consistency group relationship by recreating it with a common snapshot.

name: Boot replacement controllers at a MetroCluster disaster site
description: Boot the replacement controller modules at the disaster site to ONTAP during MetroCluster disaster recovery.

name: Configure a replacement FC switch after a site disaster
description: A new FC switch at the disaster site is preconfigured, zoned and enabled so its fabric is restored.

name: Configure asymmetric SnapMirror active sync protection for SAN
description: LUNs are added to a consistency group protected by an asymmetric SnapMirror active sync relationship to a destination cluster and initialized.

name: Configure SnapMirror active sync for NAS
description: A NAS SVM and its volumes are protected by a SnapMirror active sync relationship to a destination SVM with automated failover.

name: Configure symmetric active/active SnapMirror active sync protection for SAN
description: A consistency group of LUNs or NVMe namespaces is protected with a symmetric active/active SnapMirror active sync relationship so both sites serve I/O.

name: Configure Tiebreaker or ONTAP Mediator monitoring for a MetroCluster configuration
description: Add the MetroCluster configuration to third-site monitoring, either by adding ONTAP Mediator to ONTAP or by adding the configuration to the Tiebreaker software, at initial setup or to resume monitoring after maintenance.

name: Convert a SnapMirror active sync relationship from symmetric active/active to asymmetric
description: A symmetric active/active SnapMirror active sync relationship is converted to an asymmetric relationship.

name: Convert a SnapMirror active sync relationship to symmetric active/active
description: An asymmetric SnapMirror active sync relationship is converted to a symmetric active/active relationship.

name: Convert a SnapMirror SAN relationship to asymmetric SnapMirror active sync
description: An existing iSCSI or FC SnapMirror relationship is converted to an asymmetric SnapMirror active sync relationship without a new baseline transfer.

name: Convert a SnapMirror SAN relationship to symmetric active/active SnapMirror active sync
description: An existing iSCSI or FC SnapMirror relationship is converted to a symmetric active/active SnapMirror active sync relationship.

name: Create a common snapshot for a SnapMirror active sync relationship
description: Manually create a common snapshot between the primary and secondary consistency groups or NAS SVMs of a SnapMirror active sync relationship.

name: Create a MetroCluster DR group
description: A disaster recovery group pairing nodes across the two sites is created in a MetroCluster IP configuration.

name: Create an unprotected volume in a SnapMirror active sync NAS configuration
description: A new volume, such as a clone, is added to an SVM protected by SnapMirror active sync for NAS without being included in the protection.

name: Delete a MetroCluster DR group
description: A DR group is deleted from a MetroCluster IP configuration.

name: Delete failed plexes owned by the surviving site
description: Failed remote plexes of surviving-site aggregates are taken offline and deleted to prepare the MetroCluster configuration for switchback.

name: Disable automatic unplanned switchover
description: Automatic unplanned switchover is turned off on both MetroCluster clusters, for example before an ONTAP revert.

name: Disable Tiebreaker observer mode
description: Turn off observer mode so the Tiebreaker software can trigger switchovers.

name: Enable and start the ONTAP Mediator service
description: The ONTAP Mediator and SCST services are re-enabled and started on the Mediator host.

name: Enable automatic unplanned switchover for MetroCluster
description: Check and enable automatic unplanned switchover in a MetroCluster configuration, for example after an ONTAP upgrade or revert.

name: Enable high-availability mode for Cloud Volumes ONTAP in Azure
description: Register the high-availability mode feature in the Azure subscription so Cloud Volumes ONTAP HA pairs can use it.

name: Enable NVFAIL on switchover for volumes
description: Set the volume option that marks volumes as in-NVFAILed-state when a MetroCluster switchover occurs.

name: Enable storage failover and cluster HA on MetroCluster controllers
description: Enable storage failover and cluster HA on the controller modules of a MetroCluster HA pair.

name: Exclude a volume from SnapMirror active sync NAS protection
description: A volume in a SnapMirror active sync NAS SVM is excluded from business continuity protection.

name: Halt or reboot a node without takeover in a two-node cluster
description: Halt or reboot a node in a two-node cluster without triggering storage failover takeover by migrating LIFs and disabling cluster HA.

name: Heal MetroCluster aggregates after a switchover
description: Run the MetroCluster healing phase for data aggregates and restore plex mirrors after a switchover, in FC or IP configurations, before switchback.

name: Heal the root aggregates after a MetroCluster switchover
description: Switch back the mirrored root aggregates to the disaster site so the configuration is ready for switchback.

name: Increase the ONTAP Mediator mailbox timeout
description: The default ONTAP Mediator mailbox timeout used by a MetroCluster IP configuration is increased.

name: Install ONTAP Mediator
description: Download and install the ONTAP Mediator package on a Linux host, including repository access and UEFI Secure Boot key setup when needed.

name: Isolate replacement drives from the surviving site
description: Disconnect the iSCSI initiators on the surviving nodes so replacement drives at the disaster site are isolated.

name: Modify a mediator configuration
description: The settings of a configured mediator, identified by its UUID, are updated.

name: Move epsilon before a manual takeover
description: Epsilon is moved from the node that will be taken over to its partner before a manual takeover.

name: Perform a forced switchover after a disaster
description: Fence off the disaster site and perform an unplanned (forced) MetroCluster switchover to the surviving site.

name: Perform a MetroCluster switchover and switchback
description: A negotiated switchover, healing, and switchback of the MetroCluster configuration are performed from the management GUI.

name: Perform a negotiated MetroCluster switchover
description: Perform a planned (negotiated) switchover of a MetroCluster configuration so that the partner site takes over storage and client access, for example before maintenance or a controller upgrade.

name: Perform a planned failover of a SnapMirror active sync relationship
description: The primary and secondary roles of a SnapMirror active sync relationship are switched in a planned, non-disruptive failover.

name: Power on the equipment at the MetroCluster disaster site
description: Power on the shelves, switches and bridges at the disaster site (with disk autoassignment disabled where required) in preparation for switchback.

name: Prepare for MetroCluster switchover and switchback
description: The required cluster conditions and disaster-site steps are verified before switchover and switchback operations are performed.

name: Prepare for switchback in a mixed MetroCluster configuration during transition
description: Prepare the MetroCluster FC nodes for switchback after a disaster that occurs during an FC-to-IP transition.

name: Reconfigure the ONTAP Mediator connection for a MetroCluster IP configuration
description: The existing ONTAP Mediator configuration is removed and a Mediator connection, to the same or a different instance, is re-established for the MetroCluster IP configuration.

name: Recover LUNs in NVFAIL state after switchover
description: The NVFAIL state is cleared on affected volumes and their LUNs are brought online and checked for consistency after a switchover.

name: Recover SnapMirror active sync when the primary site and the secondary site's Mediator link are down
description: When Site A and Site B's link to ONTAP Mediator are both down, LUNs are unmapped, the consistency group relationship is deleted and broken, and protection is re-established once Site A returns.

name: Recover volumes in NVFAIL state after a switchover
description: Clear the in-NVFAILed-state flag on volumes so they can be accessed after a switchover.

name: Reestablish FabricPool object stores after MetroCluster disaster recovery
description: Replace the FabricPool mirror object store that was destroyed with the disaster site.

name: Reestablish SnapMirror active sync protection after an unplanned failover
description: After an automatic unplanned failover, the relationship resynchronizes and operations fail back to the original source cluster.

name: Relocate local tier ownership within an HA pair
description: Moves ownership of one or more local tiers from one node to its HA partner without disrupting data access.

name: Remove a MetroCluster configuration from Tiebreaker or Mediator monitoring
description: Remove the MetroCluster configuration from Tiebreaker, ONTAP Mediator or other monitoring software before maintenance.

name: Remove a SnapMirror active sync NAS configuration
description: SnapMirror active sync protection of a NAS SVM is removed by deleting and releasing the relationship.

name: Remove a SnapMirror active sync SAN configuration
description: SnapMirror active sync protection is removed from a SAN consistency group by deleting and releasing the relationship and cleaning up host mappings.

name: Remove ONTAP Mediator
description: Remove a configured ONTAP Mediator (or ONTAP Cloud Mediator) from the cluster, whether it is used by MetroCluster IP or by SnapMirror active sync.

name: Replace hardware and boot new controllers at a MetroCluster disaster site
description: Replace the failed hardware at a MetroCluster disaster site and bring up the new controllers during disaster recovery.

name: Restore connectivity to the disaster site in a MetroCluster IP configuration
description: The iSCSI initiators on the surviving nodes are reconnected so the surviving site can reach storage at the disaster site again.

name: Resume fan-out protection after a SnapMirror active sync failover
description: The asynchronous fan-out leg of a SnapMirror active sync configuration is recreated and resynchronized from the new primary after failover.

name: Set the HA configuration state of controller modules and chassis
description: In Maintenance mode, check the ha-config state of the controller module and chassis and set it to the value the configuration needs (ha, mcc, mccip).

name: Set the HA mode on an existing controller module
description: The storage failover mode of an existing controller module is set to HA so it can form an HA pair with a new controller.

name: Simulate a switchover using MetroCluster Tiebreaker
description: Run a Tiebreaker switchover simulation to confirm that Tiebreaker would trigger a switchover.

name: Stop and disable the ONTAP Mediator service
description: The ONTAP Mediator and SCST services are stopped and disabled on the Mediator host.

name: Switch back a MetroCluster configuration
description: Perform a MetroCluster switchback so that the recovered site resumes ownership of its aggregates and SVMs after healing.

name: Test healing and switchback of a MetroCluster configuration
description: After a test switchover, aggregates are healed, healing and mirroring are verified, and a manual switchback is performed and confirmed.

name: Test MetroCluster operation after a power line disruption
description: Turn off one set of rack PDUs and confirm that the MetroCluster components keep running and ONTAP clears the error when power returns.

name: Test MetroCluster operation after a switch fabric failure
description: Disable one FC switch fabric and confirm that the MetroCluster configuration continues serving data, then re-enable it.

name: Test MetroCluster operation after loss of a single FC-to-SAS bridge
description: Power off one FC-to-SAS bridge and confirm that the drives behind it remain available through a single path.

name: Test MetroCluster operation after loss of a single storage shelf
description: Power off a pool 1 shelf and confirm that aggregates, SVMs and volumes remain online and serving data.

name: Test MetroCluster switchover, healing, and switchback
description: Confirm correct MetroCluster operation by performing a negotiated switchover, healing and switchback and checking the results.

name: Test takeover and giveback
description: Confirm that an HA pair fails over correctly by running a storage takeover and a giveback in each direction and checking the failover status.

name: Update ONTAP Mediator after a host name or IP address change
description: ONTAP Mediator is restarted so it uses the host's new host name or IP address.

name: Upgrade the host running MetroCluster Tiebreaker
description: Uninstall Tiebreaker, upgrade the host operating system and reinstall Tiebreaker.

name: Verify a successful MetroCluster switchback
description: Confirm that aggregates were switched back, SVMs are in the correct state and the switchback operation succeeded.

name: Verify connectivity to a cloud mediator
description: Test connectivity from the cluster to a cloud mediator.

name: Verify prerequisites for SnapMirror active sync
description: Cluster peering, SVM peering, LIFs, storage units, host OS and protocol support are confirmed before configuring SnapMirror active sync.

name: Verify replacement node connectivity to remote site storage
description: Confirm that the replacement nodes at the disaster site can see the disks at the surviving site.

name: Verify SVMs and aggregates after a MetroCluster switchover
description: Confirm that aggregates were switched over and that the secondary SVMs are running.

name: Verify that a MetroCluster configuration is ready for switchback
description: Simulate the switchback operation and review the output to confirm the system is ready.

name: Verify that a MetroCluster configuration is ready for switchover
description: Simulate a switchover from the surviving site and review the output to confirm the system is ready.

name: Verify the disaster site storage configuration before switchback
description: Confirm from the surviving site that all disaster-site storage is visible and that replaced disks are unowned.

name: View HA pair status
description: Display the HA status of cluster nodes, including interconnect state, whether takeover or giveback is possible, and takeover or giveback failure codes and reasons.

name: View MetroCluster DR groups
description: List the DR groups in a MetroCluster IP configuration, or show the details of one.

name: View ONTAP Mediator configurations
description: Retrieve the ONTAP Mediator configurations on a cluster.

name: Adjust the capacity of an FSx for ONTAP file system
description: The SSD storage capacity of a file system is manually changed.

name: Assign a volume efficiency policy to a volume
description: Associates a volume efficiency policy with a volume.

name: Assign FabricPool object tags to a volume
description: Assigns user-created custom tags to a volume so that its objects tiered to the cloud are tagged.

name: Calculate reclaimable snapshot space
description: Calculates how much space would be freed by deleting selected snapshots of a volume.

name: Calculate the rate of data growth for LUNs
description: Monitor a LUN over a period and compute its average daily data growth for capacity planning.

name: Change the compression type of a volume
description: A volume is switched between secondary compression and adaptive compression.

name: Change the inactive data compression threshold of a volume
description: Changes the threshold after which cold data on a volume is compressed by inactive data compression.

name: Change the ONTAP S3 FQDN used for FabricPool tiering
description: The ONTAP S3 server FQDN is changed and the FabricPool object store configuration is updated to use it.

name: Change the storage class for tiered data
description: Select a different cloud storage class for inactive data tiered from Cloud Volumes ONTAP.

name: Change the tiering policy of a volume
description: Change a volume's FabricPool tiering policy and, for the snapshot-only or auto policy, its tiering minimum cooling period.

name: Change the unreclaimed space threshold for a cloud tier
description: Changes the unreclaimed space threshold that controls FabricPool object defragmentation on an object store.

name: Check the status of a performance tier promotion
description: The progress of promoting FabricPool data from the cloud tier back to the performance tier is shown.

name: Configure a mirrored FabricPool aggregate in a MetroCluster configuration
description: An aggregate is mirrored within the MetroCluster and attached to a FabricPool mirror so tiered data is protected at both sites.

name: Configure aggregate-level background deduplication
description: Enables, disables or checks cross-volume background deduplication at the local tier level.

name: Configure aggregate-level inline deduplication
description: Enables, disables or checks cross-volume inline deduplication for volumes in a local tier.

name: Configure automatic deletion of FlexClone files and FlexClone LUNs
description: A FlexVol volume is configured to automatically delete FlexClone files and FlexClone LUNs when space runs low.

name: Configure FlexGroup volume autosize
description: A FlexGroup volume is configured to automatically grow and shrink its size.

name: Configure quotas on a FlexGroup volume
description: Creates quota rules for a FlexGroup volume, activates quotas and monitors initialization and the quota report.

name: Configure the efficiency operation schedule of a volume
description: Set when deduplication/efficiency operations run on a volume, by a time schedule or by the amount of new data written.

name: Configure volume autosize
description: Configure a volume to automatically grow (and optionally shrink) or free space when it becomes full.

name: Create a FabricPool mirror
description: A second object store is attached to a FabricPool local tier as a mirror.

name: Create a quota rule
description: Create a quota rule that limits disk or file usage for a user, group or qtree.

name: Create a volume efficiency policy
description: Create a volume efficiency policy that defines when deduplication and compression run.

name: Delete a FabricPool volume object tag
description: User-created object tags are removed from a FabricPool volume.

name: Delete a quota rule
description: Delete a quota rule.

name: Delete a volume efficiency policy
description: Delete a volume efficiency policy from an SVM.

name: Determine Flash Pool candidacy and optimal cache size
description: Uses the Automated Workload Analyzer to decide whether a local tier would benefit from Flash Pool and what cache size to use.

name: Determine storage system limits
description: Look up the storage limits for the system model and ONTAP version in NetApp Hardware Universe.

name: Determine the cache size impact of adding SSDs to a storage pool
description: Calculates how much Flash Pool cache is gained when SSDs are added to an SSD storage pool.

name: Disable cloud write mode on a volume
description: Disables direct writes to the cloud tier on a FabricPool volume.

name: Disable data compression on a volume
description: Active efficiency operations are stopped and data compression is disabled on the volume.

name: Disable quotas on a volume
description: Quota enforcement is turned off for a FlexVol or FlexGroup volume.

name: Enable advanced capacity balancing on a FlexGroup volume
description: A FlexGroup volume uses advanced capacity balancing so that large file data is spread across its constituents.

name: Enable aggressive read-ahead mode on a FabricPool volume
description: A FabricPool volume uses aggressive read-ahead when it reads data from the cloud tier.

name: Enable automatic capacity management for an FSx for ONTAP file system
description: The file system automatically grows its SSD capacity and sends capacity notifications.

name: Enable cloud write mode on a volume
description: Enables a FabricPool volume to write data directly to the cloud tier, either at creation or on an existing volume.

name: Enable data tiering to object storage on volumes
description: Enable tiering of inactive volume data from Cloud Volumes ONTAP to low-cost object storage by setting a tiering policy.

name: Enable inline data compaction
description: Inline data compaction is enabled on a volume.

name: Enable logical space reporting and enforcement
description: Logical space reporting and enforcement are enabled for a volume or SVM.

name: Enable or disable an efficiency policy
description: An efficiency policy is enabled or disabled.

name: Enable quotas on a volume
description: Activate quotas on a volume so that quota rules are enforced; they can be deactivated the same way.

name: Enable space allocation for a LUN
description: Enable space allocation on a LUN so hosts are notified of out-of-space conditions and can reclaim unused blocks.

name: Enable storage efficiency on a FlexGroup volume
description: Turns on storage efficiency and the required deduplication and compression operations on a FlexGroup volume.

name: Enable storage efficiency on a volume
description: Enables deduplication, compression and compaction settings on a volume to save storage space.

name: Increase a volume's active file system before migrating from 8K adaptive compression
description: Enlarges a volume's active file system by its compression savings so it does not run out of space when 8K adaptive compression is removed.

name: Manage storage efficiency policies for an SVM
description: Adds, edits, enables, disables or deletes the volume efficiency policies of a storage VM from its settings page.

name: Modify a FabricPool volume object tag
description: User-created object tags on a FabricPool volume are changed.

name: Modify a volume efficiency policy
description: Change the settings of an existing volume efficiency policy.

name: Modify FlexGroup rebalancing configuration
description: The non-disruptive capacity rebalancing settings of a FlexGroup volume are changed.

name: Modify quota limits
description: Quota rule limits are changed and the quotas are resized to take effect.

name: Modify the cloud retrieval policy of a volume
description: Changes how data tiered to the cloud is retrieved back to the performance tier for a volume.

name: Modify the default snapshot reserve for an SVM
description: Set the snapshot reserve percentage and automatic snapshot deletion at the storage VM level.

name: Modify the snapshot reserve of a volume
description: Change the percentage of volume or storage unit space reserved for snapshots.

name: Monitor space utilization of a FabricPool-enabled local tier
description: Displays performance-tier and cloud-tier space usage of a FabricPool-enabled local tier and its volumes.

name: Move a file between FlexGroup volume constituents
description: Move a file from one constituent of a FlexGroup volume to another constituent in the same FlexGroup, for example to rebalance capacity.

name: Prevent automatic deletion of a FlexClone file or LUN
description: A specific FlexClone file or FlexClone LUN is protected from automatic deletion when the volume needs space.

name: Promote a FabricPool mirror
description: The mirror object store of a FabricPool becomes the primary object store.

name: Promote all data of a volume to the performance tier
description: All data of a FabricPool volume, including snapshot data, is brought back from the cloud tier to the performance tier.

name: Promote file system data of a volume to the performance tier
description: The active file system data of a FabricPool volume is brought back to the performance tier while snapshot data stays in the cloud tier.

name: Re-enable storage efficiency on a SnapMirror relationship
description: Update a SnapMirror relationship with storage efficiency re-enabled so that transfers keep the source volume's storage efficiency savings on the destination volume.

name: Reinitialize quotas on a volume
description: Modifies quota rules and reinitializes quotas on each affected volume so that extensive rule changes take effect.

name: Remove a FabricPool mirror
description: The mirror object store is detached from a FabricPool local tier.

name: Remove a volume efficiency policy from a volume
description: Disassociates a volume efficiency policy from a volume.

name: Repack existing compressed data on a volume
description: Existing compressed data on a volume is repacked with inactive data compression.

name: Replace a FabricPool mirror in a MetroCluster configuration
description: A damaged object store mirror of a FabricPool aggregate in a MetroCluster configuration is removed and replaced with a new mirror object store.

name: Replace an object store using a FabricPool mirror
description: An existing FabricPool object store is replaced by mirroring to a new object store, promoting it and removing the old one.

name: Resize quotas
description: Apply changed quota limits on one or more volumes without reinitializing quotas.

name: Resolve capacity issues by moving volumes
description: Analyzes a capacity alert and moves volumes to another aggregate or system to avoid running out of space.

name: Resume a halted efficiency operation
description: A halted volume efficiency operation is resumed from its checkpoint.

name: Run an efficiency operation on a volume manually
description: Start deduplication, compression or compaction on demand on a volume, either on new data only or by scanning existing data (volume efficiency start).

name: Set a FabricPool per-node PUT rate threshold
description: FabricPool PUT operations to the cloud tier are throttled at a per-node rate threshold.

name: Set the capacity limit of an SVM
description: Set, change or remove a maximum storage capacity limit for a new or existing SVM.

name: Set the media cost of a local tier
description: Assign a currency-per-GB media cost to local tiers in System Manager so the costs of storing active and inactive data can be compared.

name: Set the storage efficiency mode of a volume
description: Sets a volume's storage efficiency mode (default or efficient), either when the volume is created or on an existing volume.

name: Start FlexGroup capacity rebalancing
description: Start (immediately or on a schedule) a nondisruptive capacity rebalance that redistributes data across the constituents of a FlexGroup volume.

name: Stop FlexGroup capacity rebalancing
description: Stop an ongoing or scheduled capacity rebalance operation on a FlexGroup volume.

name: Stop volume efficiency operations
description: Stops an active deduplication or postprocess compression operation on a volume.

name: Trigger FabricPool migration and tiering
description: A scheduled migration and tiering scan is requested for a volume so data moves between the performance and cloud tiers per its tiering policy.

name: View cluster capacity
description: View the storage capacity and utilization of a cluster.

name: View efficiency operation status
description: The status and statistics of efficiency operations on a volume are shown.

name: View efficiency space savings
description: The space saved on a volume by deduplication, compression and compaction is shown.

name: View FabricPool mirror details
description: Information about FabricPool mirrors, including mirror type and degraded state, is displayed.

name: View FabricPool object tags on a volume
description: Displays the custom tiering object tags assigned to a volume.

name: View file and inode usage of a volume
description: The number of files used and the maximum number of files (inodes) of a volume are shown.

name: View FlexGroup capacity balance and rebalancing status
description: Show the capacity balance (imbalance size and percentage) and the rebalancing engine state of a FlexGroup volume.

name: View local tier capacity
description: The capacity details of a local tier are shown.

name: View node capacity for creating and deleting FlexClone files and LUNs
description: Shows how much capacity a node has to create and delete FlexClone files and FlexClone LUNs.

name: View quota rules
description: List quota policy rules, or show the details of one.

name: View snapshot reserve usage of a volume
description: Display how much of a volume's snapshot reserve is used by snapshots and how much remains available.

name: View space savings from FlexClone files and FlexClone LUNs
description: Displays the space saved by FlexClone files and FlexClone LUNs in a volume.

name: View space usage of a FlexGroup volume
description: Shows the space used by a FlexGroup volume and each of its constituents.

name: View space used by a FlexClone volume
description: Determines the actual physical space consumed by a FlexClone volume.

name: View the aggressive read-ahead mode of a volume
description: The aggressive read-ahead mode set on a FabricPool volume is shown.

name: View the capacity limit of an SVM
description: Shows the maximum capacity limit and usage of storage VMs.

name: View the capacity of volumes in an SVM
description: The capacity used by the volumes in a storage VM is shown.

name: View the quota report
description: Display quota report records showing usage against quota limits.

name: View the quota state of a volume
description: Shows whether quotas are on, off or initializing for a FlexVol or FlexGroup volume.

name: View the storage efficiency mode of a volume
description: Displays the storage efficiency mode configured on a volume.

name: View volume efficiency policies
description: Display volume efficiency policies and their attributes.

name: View volume footprint savings from temperature-sensitive storage efficiency
description: Displays a volume's footprint savings with or without temperature-sensitive storage efficiency.

name: View volumes with sequential packing enabled
description: Lists volumes that contain sequentially packed data.

name: Add a cloud tier
description: Define an object store (for example Amazon S3, Azure Blob, StorageGRID, IBM COS, Alibaba, Google Cloud or ONTAP S3) as a FabricPool cloud tier with storage aggregate object-store config create or Add Cloud Tier in System Manager, including in MetroCluster configurations.

name: Add an existing Cloud Volumes ONTAP system to NetApp Console
description: An existing Cloud Volumes ONTAP system is added to NetApp Console for management.

name: Add HA pairs to an FSx for ONTAP file system
description: Additional HA pairs are added to a scale-out FSx for ONTAP file system.

name: Analyze inactive data with inactive data reporting
description: Enables inactive data reporting on a local tier and displays how much volume data is cold and could be tiered.

name: Attach a local tier to a cloud tier
description: Attach a local tier (aggregate) to a cloud tier so that data tiering is enabled.

name: Change the performance tier of Premium SSD disks
description: The performance tier of the Premium SSD managed disks behind a cloud HA pair is changed, one node at a time through takeover and giveback.

name: Check object tagging status on FabricPool volumes
description: Displays whether FabricPool volumes still need their cloud objects retagged after tag changes.

name: Configure a private worker pool for Infrastructure Manager
description: Create and deploy a Google Cloud private worker pool so Cloud Volumes ONTAP can be deployed and managed through Infrastructure Manager in private mode or protected environments.

name: Configure aggregate capacity management for Cloud Volumes ONTAP
description: The Console agent's setting for managing Cloud Volumes ONTAP aggregate capacity is set.

name: Configure Azure Private DNS zone settings for the Console agent
description: Provide the Azure Private DNS zone details in the Console agent configuration so Cloud Volumes ONTAP private link DNS records are created in the user's own private DNS zone.

name: Configure placement group creation for Cloud Volumes ONTAP HA pairs
description: Change the Console agent setting that controls whether a deployment rolls back when AWS placement group creation fails for single-AZ HA pairs.

name: Create a FabricPool-enabled local tier
description: Create a local tier (aggregate) that is enabled for FabricPool so cold data can be tiered to an object store.

name: Create an FSx for ONTAP file system
description: A new FSx for ONTAP file system is deployed.

name: Delete a cloud tier
description: Removes a cloud tier configuration that is no longer attached to any local tier.

name: Delete a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: A Cloud Volumes ONTAP system and its associated services are removed from NetApp Console.

name: Delete an FSx for ONTAP file system
description: An Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system is permanently deleted.

name: Deploy a Cloud Volumes ONTAP HA pair
description: Launch a Cloud Volumes ONTAP high-availability pair in AWS (including a shared subnet), Azure or Google Cloud from NetApp Console.

name: Deploy a Console agent
description: A NetApp Console agent is deployed in the cloud provider so Cloud Volumes ONTAP can be managed.

name: Deploy a single-node Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: Launch a single-node Cloud Volumes ONTAP system in a public cloud using the advanced creation options.

name: Disable aggressive read-ahead mode on a FabricPool volume
description: Turns off aggressive read-ahead of cloud-tier data for a FabricPool volume.

name: Discover an existing FSx for ONTAP file system
description: Existing FSx for ONTAP file systems are discovered and added to the Systems page.

name: Discover an on-premises ONTAP cluster in NetApp Console
description: Discover an on-premises ONTAP cluster in NetApp Console (directly or through a Console agent) so it can be managed there, including with System Manager.

name: Enable automatic inode management for a file system
