description: Automatic inode growth is enabled for an FSx for ONTAP file system.

name: Explore storage savings
description: Estimated savings from moving existing cloud storage workloads to FSx for ONTAP are calculated and compared.

name: Export a VHD image from the Azure marketplace
description: The VHD file of a Cloud Volumes ONTAP Azure marketplace image is exported so that the platform image can be verified.

name: Fix Cloud Volumes ONTAP image download failures behind a Google Cloud NAT gateway
description: Change the Console agent configuration so Cloud Volumes ONTAP upgrade images download successfully through a Google Cloud NAT gateway.

name: Generate a cost report
description: A report of costs for file system resources is generated from the cost dashboard.

name: Integrate Cloud Volumes ONTAP with Microsoft OneLake
description: Install and configure the on-premises data gateway and create an S3-compatible OneLake shortcut so Cloud Volumes ONTAP S3 data is available in a Microsoft Fabric lakehouse.

name: Modify a cloud tier
description: Changes a cloud tier's name, server, port or access credentials.

name: Modify Azure Premium SSD v2 disk performance
description: Changes the provisioned IOPS and throughput of Premium SSD v2 managed disks used by a cloud ONTAP system in Azure.

name: Modify FSx for ONTAP file system tags
description: Tags on an FSx for ONTAP file system are added, updated or removed.

name: Modify route tables for an HA pair across multiple AWS availability zones
description: Changes which AWS route tables contain the floating IP routes for a cloud HA pair deployed in multiple availability zones.

name: Modify tags on a cloud volume
description: Adds, edits or removes the cloud resource tags on an FSx for ONTAP volume.

name: Modify the Cloud Backup connection
description: Change the connection between the cluster and the Cloud Backup service.

name: Modify the free space ratio for data tiering
description: The aggregate free space ratio threshold used for data tiering is changed.

name: Move the Azure resource group of a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: A Cloud Volumes ONTAP system's Azure resources are moved to another resource group and the system is rediscovered in the Console.

name: Override CIFS locks for HA pairs in Azure
description: The CIFS lock override setting is enabled for Cloud Volumes ONTAP HA pairs in Azure.

name: Provision SSD IOPS for a file system
description: Sets the provisioned SSD IOPS for an FSx for ONTAP file system.

name: Remove an FSx for ONTAP file system from a project
description: An FSx for ONTAP file system is removed from a Console project without being deleted.

name: Remove an on-premises ONTAP cluster from cloud management
description: Remove a discovered on-premises ONTAP cluster from the cloud management workspace.

name: Review supported Cloud Volumes ONTAP configurations
description: Reference tables of the VM types, licenses, capacity limits and single-node or HA pair configurations supported for Cloud Volumes ONTAP in each cloud provider.

name: Schedule automatic shutdown of a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: A schedule is set so the Cloud Volumes ONTAP system shuts down and restarts automatically.

name: Update the throughput capacity of a file system
description: Changes the provisioned throughput capacity of an FSx for ONTAP file system.

name: Verify a Cloud Volumes ONTAP platform image
description: The Cloud Volumes ONTAP platform image file is downloaded and its checksum and signature are verified before it is used.

name: View storage costs
description: Cost and capacity data for file system resources is shown and filtered in the cost dashboard.

name: View the Cloud Backup connection status
description: Display the status and details of the cluster's connection to the cloud backup service.

name: Access a cluster with System Manager
description: Open System Manager for a cluster and log in, either in a browser at the cluster management IP address or by opening it from NetApp Console.

name: Access an ONTAP Select virtual machine console
description: Open the video console of an ONTAP Select virtual machine from the hypervisor client.

name: Access the cluster CLI using SSH
description: Open a CLI session on the cluster, normally over SSH to the cluster management interface.

name: Access the cluster through the node serial port
description: An administrator logs in to the cluster CLI through a node's serial console port.

name: Access the cluster using Telnet or RSH
description: Telnet or RSH is enabled on the management LIFs and used to issue commands to the cluster.

name: Access the SP/BMC of a node
description: Log in to a node's Service Processor or BMC from an administration host or the system console.

name: Access the system console of a node
description: The administrator logs in to and exits a node's system console.

name: Add a management server account to ONTAP Select Deploy
description: Register a vCenter management server and its credentials in the Deploy utility.

name: Add nodes to a cluster
description: Expand an existing cluster by installing new nodes and joining them to the cluster.

name: Assign tags to a cluster
description: Add or modify tags on the cluster.

name: Assign tags to an SVM
description: Add, update or remove the tags on an SVM.

name: Back up the cluster configuration
description: Create cluster and node configuration backup files.

name: Back up the ONTAP Select Deploy configuration
description: Create a password-protected backup of the ONTAP Select Deploy utility configuration data.

name: Boot a node from the boot environment prompt
description: A node is halted to the boot environment prompt and booted into ONTAP or a boot option.

name: Cancel an SVM migration
description: Abort an in-progress SVM migration.

name: Change the instance type of a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: Change the cloud VM, EC2 instance or machine type that a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system runs on.

name: Configure NTP time synchronization for a cluster
description: Associate the cluster with NTP servers, optionally with an authentication key, and set its time zone so that system time stays synchronized across the nodes.

name: Configure ONTAP Select Deploy system settings
description: Edit the Deploy utility settings and AutoSupport configuration for the environment.

name: Configure the remote destination for cluster configuration backups
description: Set the cluster configuration backup settings, such as the remote HTTP/FTP URL where backup files are uploaded and its credentials.

name: Configure the Service Processor network
description: Set the IP address, netmask, gateway or DHCP settings of the node Service Processors (SP/BMC), either one at a time or for all SPs at once.

name: Configure the System Manager inactivity timeout and UI options
description: Set the System Manager session inactivity timeout, plus the log level on older releases, from the System Manager settings.

name: Consolidate cron schedules from transitioned volumes
description: Consolidate the per-volume cron schedules created during transition into shared schedules.

name: Create an SVM
description: Create a storage VM (SVM) with its root volume on an ONTAP cluster, optionally enabling client access protocols (NFS, SMB, S3, FC, iSCSI) and data LIFs, from System Manager, the CLI, or cloud/ASA r2/AFX consoles.

name: Delete an SVM
description: Remove a storage VM from the cluster or file system.

name: Disable a storage port
description: An unused storage port on a node is disabled.

name: Download the cluster configuration
description: The configuration details of selected HA pairs are downloaded from System Manager.

name: Enable authentication for an NTP server
description: Enable a previously configured shared authentication key for an NTP server.

name: Enable automatic SP/BMC network configuration
description: Makes the Service Processor or BMC take its network addresses automatically from a specified subnet.

name: Enable telemetry logging
description: Allow the management GUI to log telemetry data.

name: Free up space on a node root volume
description: Deletes unneeded core dump files and root volume snapshots to free space on a node's root volume.

name: Manage a node using the boot menu
description: Reboot a node into the boot menu and select a maintenance or recovery option.

name: Migrate an SVM
description: Migrate an SVM and its data non-disruptively from a source cluster to a destination cluster, with options for automatic cutover and source cleanup.

name: Modify cluster attributes
description: Cluster identity attributes such as name, location or contact are changed.

name: Modify node attributes
description: Node attributes such as name and location are changed.

name: Modify SVM settings
description: Edit the settings of an existing storage VM (protocols, services, resource settings).

name: Modify the Service Processor API service configuration
description: Change and verify the configuration of the Service Processor API service used by the cluster.

name: Modify the system write speed of Cloud Volumes ONTAP
description: Set the Cloud Volumes ONTAP system write speed to normal or high.

name: Monitor volume migration during an SVM migration
description: Checks the migration status of each volume on the destination cluster during an SVM migration.

name: Power off a node
description: Power off a node through service processor assistance.

name: Reboot a node
description: Reboot a cluster node after verifying it is safe to do so.

name: Record a CLI session
description: The current CLI session is recorded to a file until recording is stopped.

name: Refresh a cluster configuration in the Deploy utility
description: Syncs the Deploy utility's stored configuration of a cluster with the cluster's current state.

name: Relocate a node root volume to new aggregates
description: Move a node's root volume from its current aggregate to a new aggregate or local tier.

name: Remove a resource tag from a volume
description: Deletes the association of a resource tag with a volume.

name: Remove nodes from a cluster
description: Shrink a cluster by unjoining or deleting nodes or an HA pair, optionally forcing the removal, using the CLI, the REST API, System Manager or ONTAP Select Deploy.

name: Rename a cluster in a MetroCluster configuration
description: Change the name of a cluster (site) that is part of a MetroCluster configuration and keep the peer and MetroCluster configuration consistent.

name: Rename a node
description: Change the name of a cluster node.

name: Rename an SVM
description: Change the name of a storage VM.

name: Resize ONTAP Select cluster nodes
description: Change the instance type (CPU and memory size) of the nodes in an ONTAP Select cluster.

name: Restore a cluster from a configuration backup
description: Locate a cluster configuration backup file and use it to recreate the cluster configuration and rejoin nodes.

name: Restore a node from a configuration backup
description: Locate a node configuration backup file and use it to restore a node's configuration and resynchronize it with the cluster.

name: Restore system defaults and clear the configuration on a controller module
description: The LOADER environment variables are reset to defaults and the node configuration is wiped, and the HBA type is set where required, so the controller can be configured fresh.

name: Run FC-to-SAS bridge commands in-band from ONTAP
description: A FibreBridge command is run on an FC-to-SAS bridge from the ONTAP cluster prompt through in-band management.

name: Set CLI display preferences
description: Uses the set command to change how the CLI session displays output.

name: Set the CLI privilege level
description: Change the CLI session privilege level to admin, advanced or diagnostic.

name: Shut down a node
description: Halts a node for maintenance or troubleshooting after checking that the cluster keeps quorum.

name: Sign in to the Deploy utility using SSH
description: Open an SSH session to the ONTAP Select Deploy management shell, with password or YubiKey PIV authentication.

name: Start an SVM
description: Start a stopped SVM so it serves data.

name: Stop a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: Turn off a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system, optionally creating snapshots first, to save compute costs.

name: Stop an SVM
description: Stop a running SVM so it no longer serves data.

name: Synchronize a node with the cluster
description: Synchronize a node's replicated configuration with the cluster to restore cluster-wide quorum.

name: Take an ONTAP Select cluster offline or online
description: Takes an ONTAP Select cluster offline or brings it back online from the Deploy utility.

name: Verify the planned cluster expansion configuration
description: Verify licenses, site readiness, switches and software versions support the planned new nodes before expanding the cluster.

name: View available nodeshell commands
description: The nodeshell is entered and the list of available nodeshell commands is displayed.

name: View chassis
description: Retrieve chassis information for the cluster.

name: View cluster attributes
description: The cluster's identity and configuration attributes are displayed.

name: View cluster nodes
description: Display the nodes in a cluster with their state, attributes, metrics and conditions such as external cache or spare-low status.

name: View cluster ring replication status
description: Display the replication status of the cluster replication rings.

name: View configuration backup settings
description: Show the cluster configuration backup settings.

name: View disk shelves
description: Retrieve all shelves or a specific shelf in the cluster.

name: View resource tags
description: List the resource tags in use, optionally filtered by how many resources use them.

name: View resources with a specific tag
description: List the resources, such as volumes, that carry a given resource tag.

name: View SP/BMC CLI help
description: Shows help for the Service Processor or BMC commands and their options.

name: View storage bridges
description: Retrieve all storage bridges or a specific bridge in the cluster.

name: View storage ports
description: Retrieve storage ports in the cluster.

name: View storage switches
description: Retrieve all storage switches or a specific switch in the cluster.

name: View SVM migration status
description: Retrieve SVM migration operations and track the status of their jobs.

name: View SVMs
description: List SVMs and view their status and details.

name: Abort a SnapMirror transfer
description: Stop an in-progress data transfer of a mirror, vault or mirror-vault relationship, optionally keeping partially transferred data.

name: Activate a destination FlexGroup volume
description: The FlexGroup SnapMirror relationship is quiesced and broken so the destination FlexGroup volume becomes read-write.

name: Activate a SnapMirror SVM DR destination
description: Transfers are stopped, the SVM DR relationship is broken and the destination SVM is started so it serves data.

name: Activate the destination volume for disaster recovery
description: Make the SnapMirror destination volume read-write to serve data after a disaster and verify source and destination status.

name: Add a child consistency group
description: Add a new child consistency group, with new volumes, to an existing parent consistency group.

name: Add a cloud object store for SnapMirror Cloud
description: A cloud object store is registered as a backup target for SnapMirror Cloud.

name: Add a rule to a SnapMirror policy
description: Add a rule to a SnapMirror policy that names the snapshot label to transfer and how many to keep, optionally with a schedule so the destination also creates local copies.

name: Add a schedule to a snapshot policy
description: Add a new schedule with retention count to an existing snapshot policy.

name: Add LUNs to a consistency group
description: Add new LUNs to an existing volume in an existing consistency group.

name: Add NVMe namespaces to a consistency group
description: Add new NVMe namespaces to an existing volume in an existing consistency group.

name: Add volumes to a consistency group
description: Add existing or newly created volumes or storage units to an existing consistency group.

name: Apply a snapshot policy to a consistency group
description: Set or change the local snapshot policy of a consistency group so snapshots of all its volumes are created on a schedule.

name: Assign a snapshot policy to a volume
description: Apply a snapshot policy to a volume so its snapshots are created automatically on the policy's schedule.

name: Assign an alias to a tape device
description: Assign an alias name to a tape drive or medium changer used for ONTAP tape backup.

name: Back up a LUN using a host backup system
description: Snapshot and clone a production LUN, map the clone to a backup server and back it up with the host backup software.

name: Back up a volume to the cloud with SnapMirror Cloud
description: A volume is protected by a SnapMirror Cloud relationship that backs it up to a cloud object store.

name: Back up and restore data using tape
description: Set up a tape topology, enable NDMP and perform tape backup or restore through an NDMP-enabled backup application.

name: Break a SnapMirror relationship
description: Scheduled transfers are stopped and the SnapMirror relationship is broken so the destination volume becomes writable.

name: Bring a tape device online
description: Change the state of a tape device to online.

name: Change cluster peer encryption
description: Enable or disable encryption on an existing cluster peering relationship.

name: Clear S3 snapshot metadata from a bucket
description: Residual snapshot metadata is cleared from an S3 bucket.

name: Clone a consistency group
description: Clone a consistency group, optionally from an existing snapshot.

name: Configure a backup application for NDMP
description: Gather the ONTAP NDMP and tape device details and configure the backup application to use them.

name: Configure a cascade replication relationship
description: A data protection destination volume is itself replicated to a third volume, forming a cascade.

name: Configure a destination SVM for data access
description: Sets up LIFs, shares, export policies or igroups on the disaster-recovery destination SVM ahead of time, so data access resumes quickly when the destination volume is activated.

name: Configure a destination volume for data access
description: An activated destination volume is set up so that NAS clients or SAN hosts can access its data.

name: Configure client access to the snapshot directory
description: Show or hide the snapshot directory so NFS and SMB clients can or cannot access snapshots.

name: Configure event logging for tape backup and restore
description: Enable or disable event logging for tape backup and restore operations.

name: Configure LIFs for node-scoped NDMP
description: Makes sure the intercluster LIFs have the NDMP control service, the right failover policy and firewall access for node-scoped NDMP backups.

name: Configure LIFs for SVM-scoped NDMP
description: Makes sure the intercluster and management LIFs have the NDMP control service, the right failover policy and firewall access for SVM-scoped NDMP backups.

name: Configure SnapMirror global throttling
description: Cluster-wide maximum bandwidth limits for incoming and outgoing SnapMirror transfers are set.

name: Configure snapshot autodelete
description: Enable and set the volume snapshot autodelete policy (trigger, commitment, delete order, destroy list including LUN/file clones) to free space automatically.

name: Configure tape reservations
description: Set the tape.reservations option on the nodes to SCSI Reserve/Release, persistent reservations, or off, to match the backup application.

name: Convert a SnapMirror DP relationship to XDP
description: An existing DP-type SnapMirror relationship is replaced by an XDP-type relationship without a new baseline.

name: Convert a SnapMirror relationship between asynchronous and synchronous
description: A SnapMirror asynchronous relationship is converted to synchronous or vice versa while preserving the common snapshot.

name: Convert a SnapMirror SVM relationship to include SVM configuration
description: An SVM replication relationship that replicates only data is recreated to also replicate SVM configuration.

name: Convert a SnapMirror volume DR relationship to an SVM DR relationship
description: Volume-level SnapMirror relationships are replaced by an SVM DR relationship without re-baselining data.

name: Convert FlexVol SnapMirror relationships to FlexGroup SnapMirror relationships
description: The source and destination FlexVol volumes of a SnapMirror relationship are converted to FlexGroup volumes and the relationship is resumed.

name: Convert FlexVol volumes to FlexGroup volumes in an SVM DR relationship
description: FlexVol volumes protected by an SVM DR relationship are converted to FlexGroup volumes while keeping the relationship.

name: Convert the mode of a SnapMirror synchronous relationship
description: A SnapMirror synchronous relationship is switched between Sync and StrictSync modes.

name: Copy data between storage systems using ndmpcopy
description: Data is transferred within or between storage systems using the ndmpcopy command.

name: Create a cloud backup policy
description: A custom protection policy of type Back up to Cloud is created for SnapMirror Cloud backups.

name: Create a cloud backup relationship for an S3 bucket
description: An ONTAP S3 bucket is backed up to a cloud object store with a SnapMirror S3 relationship.

name: Create a cluster peer relationship
description: Create an intercluster peer relationship between two ONTAP clusters, including the site clusters of a MetroCluster configuration, by generating a passphrase on one cluster and peering from the other.

name: Create a consistency group
description: Create a single consistency group from new or existing volumes/LUNs (System Manager, AFX, CLI or REST API).

name: Create a consistency group snapshot
description: Create an on-demand crash-consistent or application-consistent (including two-phase) snapshot of a consistency group.

name: Create a hierarchical consistency group
description: Create a parent consistency group with child consistency groups, from existing volumes or from newly provisioned volumes or LUNs.

name: Create a job schedule
description: Create a cron job schedule (job schedule cron create) that snapshot policies, SnapMirror relationships, protection policies and other jobs can use, for example to re-create on the remote MetroCluster site the schedules created during a 7-Mode transition.

name: Create a load-sharing mirror relationship
description: A load-sharing mirror of the SVM root volume is created and initialized.

name: Create a SnapMirror destination volume
description: A data protection type destination volume is created for a SnapMirror relationship.

name: Create a SnapMirror failover test volume
description: A writable clone of a SnapMirror destination is created to test failover without breaking the relationship.

name: Create a SnapMirror policy
description: Create a SnapMirror replication policy (asynchronous mirror, vault, or mirror-vault) with a name, type and transfer settings.

name: Create a SnapMirror replication relationship
description: Create and initialize an asynchronous or synchronous SnapMirror relationship (mirror, vault or mirror-vault policy) between a source volume, including a FlexGroup volume, and a destination volume.

name: Create a SnapMirror S3 mirror relationship for a bucket
description: An ONTAP S3 bucket is mirrored to a destination bucket with a SnapMirror S3 relationship.

name: Create a snapshot
description: Create an on-demand snapshot of one or more volumes outside any schedule.

name: Create a snapshot policy
description: Create a snapshot policy defining snapshot schedules and retention counts.

name: Create an on-demand backup of a volume to object storage
description: Create an immediate backup of a volume to object storage outside the regular backup schedule.

name: Create an S3 bucket snapshot
description: Manually create a snapshot of an ONTAP S3 bucket through the CLI or the REST API.

name: Create an SMB server on a SnapMirror SVM DR destination
description: An SMB server, LIF and route are created on a destination SVM in an SVM DR relationship that does not preserve identity.

name: Create an SVM disaster recovery relationship
description: Create and initialize an SVM disaster recovery (SVM DR) relationship from a source SVM to a destination SVM that replicates the SVM's volumes and configuration, with a protection policy and schedule.

name: Create an SVM DR relationship for FlexGroup volumes
description: FlexGroup volumes are protected by an SVM DR relationship.

name: Create an SVM peer relationship
description: Create a (intercluster) peer relationship between SVMs so they can replicate data.

name: Create snapshots of a FlexGroup volume
description: A FlexGroup volume is protected with snapshots created manually or by a snapshot policy.

name: Delete a cluster peer relationship
description: The peer relationship between two clusters is deleted on both clusters.

name: Delete a consistency group
description: Delete an ONTAP consistency group.

name: Delete a consistency group snapshot
description: Delete a snapshot taken of a consistency group.

name: Delete a replication policy
description: Delete an existing replication (protection) policy from an SVM.

name: Delete a restartable NDMP backup context
description: Delete a restartable dump context identified by SVM name and context ID.

name: Delete a schedule
description: Delete an existing job schedule.

name: Delete a SnapMirror Cloud relationship
description: A volume's SnapMirror Cloud backup relationship and optionally its object store endpoint are deleted.

name: Delete a SnapMirror failover test volume
description: Test failover data is cleaned up and the failover test volume is deleted.

name: Delete a SnapMirror relationship
description: A SnapMirror volume relationship is deleted and its information released from the source.

name: Delete a SnapMirror SVM replication relationship
description: A SnapMirror SVM DR relationship is broken, deleted and released.

name: Delete a snapshot
description: Delete one or more snapshots of a volume, for example to reclaim space or to remove leftover 7-Mode snapshots after a transition.

name: Delete a snapshot policy
description: Delete a snapshot policy that is no longer needed.

name: Demote a parent consistency group to a single consistency group
description: Demote a parent (nested) consistency group back to a single consistency group.

name: Detach a child consistency group
description: Remove a child consistency group from its parent so that it becomes an independent single consistency group.

name: Disable cluster peering encryption
description: Encryption is removed from communications in an existing cluster peer relationship.

name: Disable long-term retention snapshots before an ONTAP upgrade
description: Remove long-term retention schedules from SnapMirror policies in cascade configurations before upgrading.

name: Disable SVM disaster recovery protection on a FlexGroup volume
description: Excludes a FlexGroup volume from SVM disaster recovery replication and updates the SVM relationship.

name: Enable backup users for NDMP authentication
description: Create or select backup users and generate NDMP passwords so backup applications can authenticate to an SVM.

name: Enable cluster peering encryption
description: Communications in an existing cluster peer relationship are encrypted.

name: Enable long-term snapshot retention
description: Turn on long-term retention so snapshots of a volume are kept beyond the normal policy limits.

name: Enable node-scoped NDMP
description: Enable node-scoped NDMP mode and the NDMP service on all nodes of the cluster.

name: Enable SVM disaster recovery protection on a FlexGroup volume
description: Includes a FlexGroup volume in SVM disaster recovery replication and updates the SVM relationship.

name: Enable SVM-scoped NDMP
description: Switch the cluster to SVM-scoped NDMP mode and enable the NDMP service.

name: Ensure a common snapshot in a mirror-vault deployment
description: A labeled snapshot is kept on the source until it has been transferred to the vault destination so that a common snapshot exists.

name: Exclude network settings from SnapMirror SVM replication
description: An SVM DR relationship replicates SVM configuration while excluding LIFs and related network settings.

name: Exclude volumes from a SnapMirror SVM DR relationship
description: Selected volumes are excluded from SVM DR replication.

name: Extend the expiry time of snapshots
description: Push out the expiry date of snapshots in a volume so they are retained longer.

name: Fail over to a destination S3 bucket
description: Takes over from the destination bucket of a SnapMirror S3 relationship so clients can use it when the source is unavailable.

name: Forward the tape on a tape device by a number of files
description: Position the tape in a tape device forward by a given number of files.

name: Generate a cluster peering passphrase
description: Generate a passphrase used by a remote cluster to establish a cluster peer relationship.

name: Generate an NDMP password
description: An NDMP-specific password is generated for an NDMP user so backup applications can authenticate.

name: Initialize a SnapMirror relationship
description: The baseline transfer of a SnapMirror relationship is started.

name: Manage SVM disaster recovery relationships
description: Perform actions such as update, quiesce, break or resync on an SVM DR relationship.

name: Modify a cluster peer passphrase
description: The local passphrase of an existing cluster peer relationship is changed.

name: Modify a data protection volume
description: Changes the properties, such as the name, of a data protection volume.

name: Modify a schedule
description: Change the timing of an existing job schedule.

name: Modify a SnapMirror policy
description: Edit the settings of an existing SnapMirror (replication/protection) policy, including SnapMirror S3 policies.

name: Modify a SnapMirror relationship
description: Change the policy, schedule or maximum transfer rate of an existing SnapMirror relationship.

name: Modify a snapshot
description: Edit properties of existing snapshots (name, comment, expiry, SnapMirror label), for one volume or in bulk across volumes via REST.

name: Modify a snapshot policy
description: Edit an existing snapshot policy's schedules and retention, or disable it.

name: Modify an SVM disaster recovery relationship
description: Change the relationship type, protection policy or schedule of an SVM DR relationship.

name: Modify cluster peer network parameters
description: Changes the remote-cluster LIF addresses and other network parameters of a peered cluster.

name: Modify consistency group tags
description: Change the application and component tags assigned to a consistency group.

name: Move a consistency group under a parent consistency group
description: Place an existing single consistency group under a new or existing parent consistency group as a child.

name: Move volumes between consistency groups
description: Reassign volumes from one child consistency group to a new or existing consistency group.

name: Prepare an NDMP configuration
description: Backup application compatibility, qualified tape drives and intercluster LIFs are verified before configuring NDMP.

name: Prepare for cluster peering
description: Checks the time sync and picks the passphrase, subnets, IP addresses and ports for intercluster LIFs before creating a cluster peering relationship.

name: Promote a consistency group to a parent consistency group
description: Promote an existing single consistency group into a parent (nested) consistency group.

name: Promote a load-sharing mirror
description: A load-sharing mirror volume is promoted to become the SVM root volume.

name: Protect a consistency group with SnapMirror asynchronous replication
description: A consistency group is protected with a SnapMirror asynchronous relationship to a destination cluster.

name: Quiesce a SnapMirror relationship
description: Pause future scheduled transfers of a SnapMirror relationship, for example before a controller upgrade or software update.

name: Reactivate the original SnapMirror source SVM
description: After disaster recovery, the relationship is reversed and data serving is returned to the original source SVM.

name: Reactivate the original SnapMirror source volume
description: After disaster recovery, resynchronize and reactivate the original SnapMirror source volume so it serves data again.

name: Redirect clients to the primary volume after a transition disaster
description: After the disaster at the 7-Mode site is resolved, data is resynchronized and clients are redirected to the clustered ONTAP primary volume.

name: Redirect clients to the secondary volume after a disaster during transition
description: The SnapMirror relationship is broken and deleted and clients are redirected to the clustered ONTAP secondary volume.

name: Remove a cloud object store for SnapMirror Cloud
description: A cloud object store is removed from the list of SnapMirror Cloud backup targets.

name: Remove a snapshot policy from a volume
description: Detach the snapshot policy from a volume so scheduled snapshots stop.

name: Remove aliases from a tape device
description: Remove alias names from a tape drive or medium changer used for ONTAP tape backup.

name: Remove snapshot protection from a consistency group
description: Stop scheduled snapshots for a consistency group.

name: Remove volumes from a consistency group
description: Remove volumes or storage units from a consistency group without deleting them.

name: Replicate a storage VM to another file system
description: Sets up replication of a storage VM and its volumes to another FSx for ONTAP file system.

name: Replicate an SVM excluding network and name service settings
description: Create and initialize an SVM disaster recovery relationship that replicates the SVM configuration while excluding network, name service and other settings.

name: Restore a consistency group from a snapshot
description: Restore all members of a consistency group to the contents of a local or remote snapshot.

name: Restore a FlexGroup volume from a SnapVault backup
description: Restore a FlexGroup volume from a snapshot held in its SnapVault backup destination.

name: Restore a single file from a snapshot
description: Restore one file from a snapshot to the active file system.

name: Restore a volume from a backup in object storage
description: Restore a volume from a backup stored in cloud object storage.

name: Restore a volume from a SnapMirror destination
description: Restore volume contents from a snapshot on a SnapMirror mirror or vault (SnapVault) destination to the source volume or another volume.

name: Restore a volume from a snapshot
description: Revert the contents of a volume (storage unit) to a previous snapshot.

name: Restore all LUNs in a volume from a snapshot
description: Stop host access, unmap the LUNs, restore the volume from a snapshot and remap the LUNs to recover all LUNs in the volume.

name: Restore all LUNs in a volume from a SnapVault backup
description: Recover all LUNs in a volume by restoring the volume from a snapshot on the SnapVault secondary.

name: Restore an S3 bucket from a cloud target
description: Restore an S3 bucket from a SnapMirror S3 backup on a cloud object store target.

name: Restore an S3 bucket from a SnapMirror S3 destination
description: Restore an S3 bucket from its SnapMirror S3 destination bucket on the local or a remote cluster.

name: Restore files or LUNs from a SnapMirror destination
description: Individual files, LUNs or NVMe namespaces are restored from a snapshot on a SnapMirror destination volume.

name: Restore part of a file from a snapshot
description: Restore a byte range of a file from a snapshot without restoring the whole file.

name: Restore SMB files and folders from snapshots on the client
description: View and restore earlier versions of files and folders on an SMB share from snapshots using the Windows Previous Versions tab.

name: Resume a SnapMirror relationship
description: Scheduled transfers resume for a quiesced SnapMirror relationship.

name: Resynchronize a SnapMirror relationship
description: Resynchronize a broken-off SnapMirror relationship, including one between FlexGroup volumes, so the destination is again updated from the original source.

name: Resynchronize a SnapMirror SVM DR relationship
description: The data on a SnapMirror destination SVM is resynchronized with the source SVM.

name: Reverse resynchronize a SnapMirror relationship
description: Swap the source and destination roles of a SnapMirror relationship, including one between FlexGroup volumes, and resynchronize in the opposite direction.

name: Rewind a tape device
description: Rewind the tape in a tape device to its beginning.

name: Run SnapMirror operations on multiple relationships with extended queries
description: Apply a single SnapMirror command such as initialize to many relationships at once using extended queries.

name: Set up snapshot replication to a remote cluster
description: Peer the clusters, optionally create a replication policy, create a replication relationship for a consistency group or storage unit, and test replication failover.

name: Split a consistency group clone
description: Split a cloned consistency group from its parent so it no longer shares blocks with the source.

name: Take a tape device offline
description: Change the state of a tape device to offline.

name: Transition FlexGroup SnapMirror relationships to SVM DR
description: Convert existing FlexGroup volume SnapMirror relationships into an SVM disaster recovery relationship.

name: Transition the 7-Mode primary volume as a stand-alone volume after a disaster
description: Make the ONTAP secondary volume a stand-alone volume serving data when the 7-Mode primary site fails during a SnapMirror-based transition.

name: Update a load-sharing mirror relationship
description: A load-sharing mirror set is updated manually with the latest data from the SVM root volume.

name: Update a SnapMirror relationship
description: Perform an unscheduled incremental transfer so the destination of a SnapMirror relationship has the latest snapshot data.

name: Update NDMP backup after a volume move
description: Create a new baseline and migrate the backup LIF so NDMP backups continue after a volume is moved.

name: Use a nonqualified tape drive
description: Identify nonqualified tape drives and make one usable for tape backup by emulating a qualified drive.

name: Verify cluster and SVM peer relationships
description: The cluster peer and SVM peer relationships are confirmed to be healthy before configuring replication.

name: Verify cluster peering
description: The health of the cluster peer relationship and the reachability of the peer addresses are confirmed.

name: Verify snapshot availability for Previous Versions
description: Automatic snapshots and snapshot policies are checked so SMB clients can restore files with Previous Versions.

name: View consistency group snapshots
description: List the snapshots of consistency groups or show the details of a specific one.

name: View consistency groups
description: Retrieve consistency groups on an SVM and their details.

name: View SnapMirror relationship status
description: Display the status, lag and transfer progress of SnapMirror relationships to spot delayed or unhealthy replication.

name: View snapshot policies
description: Retrieve snapshot policies and their schedule attributes.

name: View tape devices
description: List the tape drives and media changers visible to the cluster, or show the details of a specific tape device.

name: View volume snapshots
description: List the snapshots of a volume and retrieve their attributes.

name: Add key servers to an external key manager
description: Add one or more primary key servers to an external key manager.

name: Assign a cluster network security certificate to a node
description: A certificate is assigned to a node for use by cluster network security.

name: Assign a data authentication key to a FIPS drive or SED
description: Assign a data authentication key to FIPS drives or self-encrypting drives so their data is protected.

name: Assign a FIPS 140-2 authentication key to a FIPS drive
description: Assign a FIPS 140-2 authentication key to FIPS drives so they run in FIPS-compliance mode.

name: Back up Onboard Key Manager information
description: Record the Onboard Key Manager cluster-wide passphrase, confirm the key manager is working, and display its backup data (security key-manager onboard show-backup) and copy it to a secure location, for example before a controller upgrade.

name: Change the encryption key of a volume
description: An encrypted volume uses a new encryption key.

name: Change the Onboard Key Manager passphrase
description: The Onboard Key Manager passphrase is replaced with a new one.

name: Check encryption support before replacing the boot media
description: Check NVE support to pick the correct ONTAP image, then verify the Onboard or External Key Manager status and back up its configuration before the boot media is replaced.

name: Configure an external key manager
description: Enable KMIP external key management for the cluster or an SVM by connecting to one or more key servers.

name: Configure clustered external key servers
description: Add secondary key servers to a primary key server so the external key servers work as a cluster.

name: Configure customer-managed encryption keys for Cloud Volumes ONTAP
description: Grant the required permissions and identities so Cloud Volumes ONTAP is created with and uses a customer-managed cloud encryption key.

name: Configure data-at-rest encryption
description: Configure a key manager and turn on hardware and optional software (dual-layer) encryption for data at rest.

name: Configure encryption for HA traffic
description: Shows whether traffic between HA partners is encrypted, and turns that encryption on or off.

name: Configure MACsec encryption on MetroCluster IP switches
description: MACsec key chains, keys, and policies are configured on the MetroCluster IP switches and encryption is verified on both switches.

name: Convert primary and secondary key servers
description: Primary or secondary key servers are converted into clustered key server configurations.

name: Create a Barbican KMS configuration
description: Creates an inactive Barbican key manager configuration for an SVM.

name: Create a customer-managed encryption key in an Azure key vault
description: An Azure key vault and key are created so Cloud Volumes ONTAP can use a customer-managed key.

name: Create an encrypted volume
description: A new volume is created with encryption enabled.

name: Create an IPsec security policy
description: Defines an IPsec policy in the security policy database that specifies which traffic is protected by in-flight encryption.

name: Create and activate a Barbican KMS configuration
description: Create a Barbican key manager configuration for an SVM and make it the active keystore.

name: Create authentication keys for self-encrypting drives
description: Create authentication keys for cluster nodes on the external key manager and verify that they were created.

name: Cryptographically sanitize a self-encrypting drive
description: Cryptographically erase the data on a spare or broken FIPS or self-encrypting drive so it can be reused.

name: Delete a cluster network security certificate configuration
description: The cluster network security certificate configuration for a specific node is deleted.

name: Delete a Google Cloud KMS configuration
description: Remove a Google Cloud KMS configuration from the cluster or SVM.

name: Delete a keystore configuration
description: Delete a specific inactive keystore configuration.

name: Delete an AWS KMS configuration
description: Remove an AWS KMS configuration from the cluster or SVM.

name: Delete an Azure Key Vault configuration
description: Remove an Azure Key Vault configuration from the cluster or SVM.

name: Delete an external key manager
description: Remove a configured key manager from the cluster or an SVM.

name: Delete external key manager connections before an ONTAP upgrade
description: Assign the FIPS key to NSE drives and delete external key management server connections before upgrading.

name: Destroy a FIPS drive or SED
description: Permanently render a FIPS drive or self-encrypting drive and its data unusable.

name: Disable and delete a Barbican KMS configuration
description: Deactivate a Barbican key manager configuration and delete it.

name: Disable cluster network security
description: Encryption of cluster network traffic is turned off.

name: Disable encryption by default
description: Stop new volumes from being encrypted by default across the cluster.

name: Disable ISL encryption on MetroCluster FC switches
description: In-flight encryption is disabled on the FC switch ISLs, with the switches disabled and re-enabled and the MetroCluster verified.

name: Disable MACsec encryption on MetroCluster IP switch WAN ISLs
description: MACsec is shut down, and the keychain and policy are removed from the WAN ISL interfaces of the IP switches.

name: Disable MetroCluster IP end-to-end encryption
description: End-to-end encryption of MetroCluster IP traffic is disabled for each DR group, and the change is verified.

name: Emergency shred data on a self-encrypting drive
description: Data on a FIPS drive or SED is made permanently inaccessible by destroying its encryption key.

name: Enable a cloud key management service for an SVM
description: Configure and enable a cloud key management service (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault or Google Cloud KMS) as the key manager for an SVM.

name: Enable a keystore configuration
description: Enable a specific keystore configuration so that it becomes the active key manager.

name: Enable aggregate-level encryption on a local tier
description: Creates a local tier with aggregate-level encryption (NAE) enabled so that its volumes are encrypted and can share deduplication.

name: Enable cluster network security
description: Cluster network traffic encryption is enabled using TLS and IPsec mode.

name: Enable encryption on an existing volume
description: Convert an existing unencrypted volume to an encrypted volume, by in-place conversion or by volume move.

name: Enable IPsec
description: IPsec in-flight encryption is enabled on the cluster.

name: Enable ISL encryption on FC switches
description: Encryption is enabled on the ISL ports of the MetroCluster FC switches and verified as active.

name: Enable MACsec encryption on MetroCluster IP switch WAN ISLs
description: MACsec and MKA are enabled on the IP switches to encrypt traffic on the WAN ISLs.

name: Enable MetroCluster IP end-to-end encryption
description: End-to-end encryption of MetroCluster IP traffic is enabled for each DR group once external key management is confirmed, and the change is verified.

name: Enable NFS over TLS
description: NFS over TLS is enabled on NFS data LIFs with a valid server certificate so that NFS traffic is encrypted in transit.

name: Enable or disable backend cluster network encryption
description: Turns TLS encryption of backend cluster network traffic on or off and shows its current status.

name: Enable the Onboard Key Manager
description: The Onboard Key Manager is configured on the cluster with a passphrase and its authentication keys are created.

name: Encrypt a node root volume
description: A node root volume is converted to an NVE-encrypted volume.

name: Encrypt an SVM root volume
description: An SVM root volume is converted to an NVE-encrypted volume.

name: Encrypt stored data with self-encrypting drives
description: The Onboard Key Manager is configured and self-encrypting drives are rekeyed so stored data is encrypted in hardware.

name: Encrypt volumes with software-based encryption
description: A key manager is configured and new or existing volumes are encrypted with NetApp Volume Encryption.

name: Install certificates for IPsec certificate authentication
description: CA certificates and a LIF certificate are installed so that IPsec policies can use certificate-based mutual authentication.

name: Install KMIP client and server CA certificates
description: Install the cluster's KMIP client certificate and the KMIP server's root CA (server-ca) certificate so that the cluster and the KMIP server can mutually authenticate.

name: Migrate encryption keys between SVM and cluster key managers
description: Move data encryption keys from an SVM-level key manager (such as Barbican KMS) to the cluster-level Onboard Key Manager, or back, using key migration.

name: Migrate from onboard to external key management
description: The cluster stops using the Onboard Key Manager so that external key management can be configured.

name: Modify a Barbican KMS configuration
description: Update the credentials and settings of an existing Barbican KMS configuration.

name: Modify a cloud key management service configuration
description: Update the credentials, authentication method or connection settings (such as a proxy) of an SVM's AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault or Google Cloud KMS configuration.

name: Modify a cluster network security certificate
description: The certificate used for cluster network security on a specific node is updated.

name: Modify an external key manager
description: Change an external key manager's configuration, such as its server CA certificates or key server timeout and username.

name: Modify an external key server
description: Modify the properties of a key server configured in an external key manager, including its secondary key servers.

name: Modify cluster-level key manager settings
description: Update cluster-wide key manager settings such as the health monitor polling interval, cloud KMS retry count, CC mode, and the per-keystore-type health monitor policy.

name: Modify IPsec policy identities
description: The local and remote identities of an existing IPsec security policy are changed.

name: Reconfigure KMIP server connections after an ONTAP upgrade
description: Set up the key manager and re-add KMIP servers after upgrading from an older ONTAP release.

name: Rekey the Barbican KMS internal key
description: Generate a new internal key for a Barbican key manager configuration.

name: Rekey the external key of a Google Cloud KMS configuration
description: Change the Google Cloud KMS key used by a GCKMS configuration.

name: Rekey the internal key of an Azure Key Vault configuration
description: Generate a new internal key for an Azure Key Vault configuration.

name: Remove a key server from an external key manager
description: Remove a primary KMIP key server from an external key manager configuration, optionally bypassing out-of-quorum checks.

name: Replace KMIP SSL certificates
description: New KMIP client and server-CA certificates are installed and the external key manager is updated to use them.

name: Restore encryption keys from an external key manager
description: Restore encryption keys to cluster nodes from the configured external key manager (a KMIP server or a cloud KMS such as Azure Key Vault, AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS or Barbican).

name: Restore encryption on the replacement boot media
description: Restore the Onboard Key Manager or External Key Manager configuration on the controller from the ONTAP boot menu after boot media recovery, so that encrypted data is available again.

name: Restore external key management on a new controller module during a controller upgrade
description: During a controller upgrade, verify that the external key management (KMIP) servers are available, add them to the new controller module's key manager, run the key management setup, and restore the authentication keys from the linked key servers to the new node.

name: Restore key management on replacement nodes
description: Onboard or external key management configuration is restored on replacement nodes so encrypted root and data volumes are accessible.

name: Restore Onboard Key Manager keys
description: Restore or resynchronize the Onboard Key Manager encryption keys and passphrase across the cluster nodes (security key-manager onboard sync) using the cluster passphrase, for example after a node replacement or controller upgrade.

name: Return a FIPS drive or SED to service after its authentication keys are lost
description: Reset a FIPS drive or self-encrypting drive whose authentication keys are lost so it can be used again.

name: Return a FIPS drive or SED to unprotected mode
description: Reset the FIPS 140-2 and data authentication key IDs of a FIPS drive or self-encrypting drive to the default MSID 0x0 so the drive is no longer protected (storage encryption disk modify, or disk encrypt rekey in Maintenance mode).

name: Rotate the data authentication key of self-encrypting drives
description: Generate a new authentication key and rekey encrypting drives to use it.

name: Securely purge data from an encrypted volume
description: Deleted files or LUNs on an encrypted volume are securely purged, including from snapshots and SnapMirror destinations.

name: Switch from external to onboard key management
description: Disable external key management and move the cluster's keys to the Onboard Key Manager.

name: Switch the cluster key manager between onboard and external
description: Moves cluster-level key management from the onboard key manager to an external one, or back, by creating an inactive configuration, switching to it and deleting the old one.

name: Unencrypt volume data
description: Moves an encrypted volume while decrypting it so the data is stored unencrypted.

name: Verify NVE support on the cluster
description: Whether the cluster version supports NetApp Volume Encryption is determined.

name: View AWS KMS configurations
description: Retrieve AWS KMS configurations and their properties.

name: View Azure Key Vault configurations
description: Retrieve the Azure Key Vault configurations for the cluster and SVMs, including a specific configuration and its advanced properties.

name: View Barbican KMS configurations
description: Retrieve the Barbican key manager configurations, including a specific configuration and its advanced properties.

name: View cluster network security certificates
description: The certificate configurations used for cluster network security on each node are listed.

name: View cluster network security configuration
description: The current cluster network security configuration and mode are displayed.

name: View external key servers
description: Display the primary and secondary key servers configured in an external key manager, including node connectivity status.

name: View Google Cloud KMS configurations
description: Retrieve the Google Cloud KMS configurations, all or a specific one, including advanced properties.

name: View key manager configurations
description: Retrieve key manager configurations, including the cluster-level key manager settings and health monitor policy, and the cluster or SVM key managers with their status fields.

name: View key manager key IDs
description: Key IDs held by a key manager for a node are displayed.

name: View keystores
description: Retrieve information about all configured key managers or a specific keystore.

name: View NFS over TLS interface configuration
description: The NFS over TLS configuration of the data interfaces is displayed.

name: Add a home directory search path
description: Add an SMB home directory search path to an SVM.

name: Add a rule to an export policy
description: A rule with client match, access protocols and permissions is added to an export policy.

name: Add NetBIOS aliases to an SMB server
description: Adds NetBIOS aliases so clients can connect to the SMB server by alternative names.

name: Add preferred domain controllers
description: Add preferred domain controllers to an SVM's SMB server configuration.

name: Add properties to an SMB share
description: Adds share properties to an existing SMB share.

name: Assign an export policy to a qtree
description: An export policy is applied to one or more qtrees to control NFS client access.

name: Assign an export policy to a volume
description: Associate a volume with a different or new NFS export policy so that the policy's rules control client access to the volume.

name: Break file locks
description: Break a specific file lock, or all locks for a protocol, held by an NFS or SMB client on an SVM so that other clients can access the file (CLI vserver locks break; REST DELETE /protocols/locks).

name: Cancel an asynchronous directory delete job
description: An in-progress asynchronous directory delete job is stopped.

name: Change the BranchCache server key
description: The SMB server's BranchCache server secret key is changed.

name: Change the processing order of export policy rules
description: An export rule gets a new index number so that the rules in the export policy are processed in the required order.

name: Change the SMB server domain account password
description: The machine account password of the SMB server in the Active Directory domain is changed.

name: Check whether a client IP address is a member of a netgroup
description: The system reports whether a client IP address belongs to a given netgroup.

name: Configure access to SMB user home directories
description: Access to other users' SMB home directories is enabled or disabled for administrators or public users.

name: Configure Active Directory for an SVM
description: The Active Directory configuration of a storage VM is set or updated.

name: Configure an SVM for NFS access
description: NFS, a data LIF, the root volume export policy, DNS and name services are set up on an SVM so it serves NFS clients.

name: Configure an SVM for NFS and SMB access
description: NFS and SMB protocols, data LIFs, the SMB server and supporting services are set up on an SVM so it serves both Linux and Windows clients.

name: Configure an SVM for SMB access
description: Enable SMB/CIFS on a storage VM by creating the SMB server, joining it to Active Directory, and provisioning shares for Windows clients.

name: Configure and verify NFS and SMB client access
description: File permissions, share ACLs and export rules are set so that selected Windows and UNIX clients can access a multiprotocol volume, and the access is verified.

name: Configure and verify NFS client access
description: UNIX permissions and export rules are set so that selected NFS clients can access a volume, and access is verified from a client.

name: Configure and verify SMB client access to a share
description: Selected Windows users or groups receive NTFS and share ACL permissions on a new share and their access is verified from a client.

name: Configure BranchCache on an SMB server
description: BranchCache is configured on the SMB server of an SVM with a hash store, version and operating mode.

name: Configure central access policies with Dynamic Access Control
description: Dynamic Access Control and GPOs are enabled on the SMB server and Active Directory central access policies are applied to secure data.

name: Configure character mapping for SMB file name translation
description: Configure character mapping on volumes to translate file names for SMB access.

name: Configure folder redirection to an SMB share
description: A Windows client folder is redirected to a network location on the SMB server.

name: Configure NFS access to NTFS volumes for unknown UNIX users
description: The SVM is set to allow or deny NFS access to NTFS-security volumes or qtrees for UNIX users that cannot be mapped.

name: Configure NICs and clients for NFS over RDMA
description: RDMA-capable ports and the NFS server are prepared and a Linux client is mounted over NFS over RDMA.

name: Configure NIS or LDAP name services for an SVM
description: Configure NIS or LDAP name services and the name service switch on an SVM so clients can use them for UNIX user, group, netgroup and name-mapping lookups.

name: Configure NTFS ACL presentation for UNIX security-style data
description: Sets whether SMB clients see UNIX permissions of UNIX security-style data presented as NTFS ACLs.

name: Configure offline files support on an SMB share
description: Set the offline files (client-side caching) mode on an SMB share.

name: Configure oplocks on SMB shares
description: Enables or disables oplocks on an SMB share, either when the share is created or on an existing share.

name: Configure qtree ID validation for NFS file operations
description: The NFS server's check of qtree IDs for qtree file operations is enabled or disabled.

name: Configure roaming profiles on SMB shares
description: Sets a user's profile path in Active Directory to an SMB share so the user profile is stored centrally.

name: Configure SMB home directories
description: End-to-end setup of dynamic SMB home directories: provide storage, create a home directory share with user-name variables and search paths, and verify that users can connect to their home share.

name: Configure SMB shares for continuous availability
description: Modifies existing SMB shares and adds the continuously-available property for Hyper-V and SQL Server over SMB nondisruptive operations.

name: Configure the default user for name mapping
description: Set the default UNIX user (and, for NFS clients, the default Windows user) that an SVM uses when name mapping cannot map a user, and verify that domain accounts map to that default user.

name: Configure the name service switch table
description: Configure the SVM name service switch (ns-switch) table that sets which sources are used, and in what order, for host, user, group, netgroup and name-map lookups.

name: Configure the NFSv4 locking grace period
description: Set the NFSv4 grace period for lock reclamation after a server event on an SVM.

name: Configure the NFSv4 locking lease period
description: The NFSv4 lock lease period is set on an SVM.

name: Configure the NFSv4 user ID domain
description: The NFSv4 user ID domain is set on an SVM so that it matches the NFSv4 clients.

name: Configure the number of group IDs allowed for NFS users
description: The maximum number of group IDs allowed for NFS users, including extended AUTH_SYS groups, is set on an SVM.

name: Configure the security style of a FlexVol volume
description: Set the security style (UNIX, NTFS, mixed) of a FlexVol volume.

name: Configure the security style of a qtree

name: Create a stream on a file

name: Create an NFS server

name: Create an SMB share

name: Create an SVM with an SMB volume and share
description: A new SVM is created with an SMB server, data LIF, volume and share.

name: Delete a file

name: Delete a home directory search path

name: Delete a name mapping
description: Remove a specific name mapping rule from an SVM.

name: Delete a security trace filter
description: A security trace filter entry is removed from an SVM.

name: Delete a UNIX symlink mapping for SMB shares
description: A UNIX symbolic link mapping for SMB shares is removed.

name: Delete an export policy
description: An export policy is removed from an SVM.

name: Delete an export policy rule

name: Delete an SMB server
description: The SMB server is removed from an SVM.

name: Delete an SMB share
description: An SMB share is removed from the SVM.

name: Delete an SMB share access control entry
description: A user or group entry is removed from an SMB share ACL.

name: Delete BranchCache configuration

name: Delete preferred domain controllers
description: Remove preferred domain controller entries from an SVM's SMB server configuration.

name: Delete security trace records

name: Disable BranchCache on SMB shares
description: BranchCache caching stops on a single SMB share or on all SMB shares of an SVM.

name: Disable client asynchronous directory delete
description: NAS clients can no longer delete directories asynchronously on the volume.

name: Enable 64-bit NFSv3 identifiers on an SVM
description: The SVM uses 64-bit NFSv3 file system IDs and file IDs, which avoids ID collisions on FlexGroup volumes.

name: Enable access for Windows NFS clients
description: The SVM's NFS server is set to support Windows NFSv3 clients so they can access NFS exports.

name: Enable BranchCache on an SMB share
description: An SMB share offers BranchCache caching through the branchcache share property.

name: Enable client asynchronous directory delete
description: NAS clients can delete directories asynchronously on the volume.

name: Enable LDAP netgroup-by-host searches
description: Netgroup-by-host searches are enabled in the SVM LDAP client configuration so that netgroup lookups are faster.

name: Enable NFSv4.2 security labels
description: NFSv4.2 security labels are enabled on the NFS server of an SVM.

name: Enable or disable access-based enumeration on SMB shares
description: Turns access-based enumeration on or off for an SMB share so users see only the folders they can access.

name: Enable or disable BranchCache on an SVM

name: Enable or disable export policies for SMB access

name: Enable or disable Group Policy Object support on an SMB server
description: Turns Group Policy Object support on or off for an SMB server.

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 ACL modification for an SVM

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 ACLs

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 read file delegations

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 referrals
description: NFSv4 referrals are turned on or off for an SVM.

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 storepool limit controls
description: NFSv4 storepool limit controls that stop clients from using too many storepool resources are turned on or off.

name: Enable or disable NFSv4 write file delegations
description: NFSv4 write file delegations are enabled or disabled for an SVM.

name: Enable or disable ODX on an SMB server
description: Turns Offloaded Data Transfer copy offload on or off for an SMB server.

name: Enable or disable pNFS
description: Parallel NFS (pNFS) is turned on or off for an SVM.

name: Enable or disable rquota support
description: Remote quota (rquota) support is turned on or off for an NFS SVM.

name: Enable or disable SMB automatic node referrals
description: Turns SMB automatic node referrals on or off so clients are redirected to the node hosting the data.

name: Enable Previous Versions access for SMB shares
description: Configure snapshot policies and snapshot directory access so SMB clients can recover files through Previous Versions.

name: Enable SMB Multichannel
description: SMB Multichannel is enabled on the SMB server for performance and redundancy and multichannel sessions are verified.

name: Enable symlink backup for SMB
description: Enable Windows backup applications to back up UNIX-style symbolic links on SMB servers.

name: Enable the NetBIOS name service
description: NetBIOS name service (NBNS) is enabled on the SMB server.

name: Enable the SMB metadata cache
description: SMB metadata caching is enabled on a new or existing share.

name: Enable trunking on an existing NFS server
description: NFSv4.1 session trunking is enabled on an existing NFS server.

name: Flush export policy caches
description: Export policy caches are cleared so ONTAP retrieves current access information from external name sources.

name: Flush the BranchCache hash store
description: All cached hashes are removed from the SVM BranchCache hash store.

name: Join an SMB server to a different Active Directory domain
description: The existing SMB server is moved into another Active Directory domain without being deleted.

name: Manage Windows local users
description: Add, edit or delete host-specific Windows users on an SVM.

name: Map the administrators group to root
description: Members of the Windows BUILTIN administrators group are mapped to the UNIX root user on the SMB server.

name: Modify a name mapping
description: Update a specific name mapping rule of an SVM.

name: Modify a preferred domain controller
description: Change the IP addresses of a preferred domain controller for an SVM.

name: Modify a security trace filter
description: An existing security trace filter is changed.

name: Modify a UNIX symlink mapping for SMB shares
description: An existing UNIX symbolic link mapping for SMB shares is updated.

name: Modify an export policy rule
description: Change the client match, protocols, access or security settings of an existing NFS export policy rule.

name: Modify an SMB share
description: The properties of an existing SMB share are changed.

name: Modify an SMB share access control entry
description: The permission of a user or group in an SMB share ACL is changed.

name: Modify BranchCache configuration
description: The BranchCache settings of an SVM, such as hash store path, size, version or operating mode, are changed.

name: Modify domain controller discovery mode
description: Set the scope an SMB server uses to discover domain controllers.

name: Modify global name service cache settings
description: Update the global name service cache setting.

name: Modify group-membership cache settings
description: Update the group-membership name service cache settings of an SVM.

name: Modify local Windows group properties
description: Edits the description, privileges or members of a local Windows group.

name: Modify local Windows user properties
description: Edits the properties, such as full name, description or group membership, of a local Windows user.

name: Modify NFS server settings
description: Change an SVM's NFS server settings, such as turning NFS or individual NFS versions (v3, v4.0, v4.1, v4.2) on or off and their ACL, delegation and related options.

name: Modify ports used for NFSv3 services
description: The TCP/UDP ports used by NFSv3 services such as mountd, NLM, NSM and rquota are changed on an SVM.

name: Modify SMB server options
description: SMB server options on the SVM are set to customize SMB server behaviour.

name: Modify SMB server properties
description: The properties and options of an existing SMB server are changed.

name: Modify the export policy of a cache volume
description: The export policy that controls NFS client access to a cache volume is edited.

name: Modify the maximum ACE limit for NFSv4 ACLs
description: The maximum number of access control entries allowed in NFSv4 ACLs is changed on an SVM.

name: Modify the NFS TCP maximum transfer size
description: The NFSv3 and NFSv4 TCP maximum read and write transfer size of an SVM is checked and set to the required value.

name: Modify the NFSv4.1 server implementation ID
description: The NFSv4.1 server implementation ID (domain, name and date) that an SVM reports to clients is changed.

name: Modify the preferred trusted domain list for name-mapping searches
description: Adds, removes or replaces trusted domains in the preferred list used for multidomain name-mapping searches.

name: Modify the SMB machine account password schedule
description: Changes the schedule for automatic SMB server machine account password changes in the SVM's domain configuration.

name: Modify UNIX group cache settings
description: The name-service cache settings for UNIX groups on an SVM are changed.

name: Modify UNIX user cache settings
description: The name-service cache settings for UNIX users on an SVM are changed.

name: Mount a volume in the NAS namespace
description: Mount a volume at a junction path in the SVM NAS namespace so NAS clients can access it.

name: Move an SMB server to a different organizational unit
description: The SVM's Active Directory computer object is moved to a different OU.

name: Open NFS client access through the SVM root volume export policy
description: A rule is added to the default export policy of the SVM root volume so NFS clients are not denied access to the SVM.

name: Open the export policy of the SVM root volume for SMB access
description: An export rule that allows SMB clients is added to the default export policy of the SVM root volume.

name: Optimize export policy access cache settings
description: Access cache timeout and refresh parameters for NFS SVMs are tuned to balance performance against how current cached access information is.

name: Pre-compute BranchCache hashes
description: BranchCache hashes are generated in advance for files on specified SMB share paths.

name: Provision NAS storage
description: Creates and customizes a volume to provide NAS storage for NFS, SMB, multiprotocol or home directory clients.

name: Provision SMB storage for Windows clients
description: Adds a volume with a share on an SMB-enabled storage VM and verifies that Windows clients can access the share.

name: Read a file
description: The contents of a file in a volume are returned.

name: Remove a client from the NFSv4 storepool blocked client list
description: A client blocked for exceeding NFSv4 storepool limits is flushed from the blocked list so it can access the SVM again.

name: Remove an export policy from a qtree
description: A qtree's explicit export policy is removed so it inherits the containing volume's policy.

name: Remove Dynamic Access Control ACEs when Dynamic Access Control is disabled
description: Dynamic Access Control ACEs are removed from resource ACLs after DAC is disabled on the SMB server, leaving only standard ACEs.

name: Remove NetBIOS aliases from an SMB server
description: Removes some or all NetBIOS aliases from an SMB server.

name: Remove properties from an SMB share
description: Removes share properties from an existing SMB share.

name: Rename a file or directory
description: A file or directory in a volume has a new name.

name: Rename a local Windows group
description: Changes the name of a local Windows group on an SVM.

name: Rename a local Windows user
description: Changes the name of a local Windows user on an SVM.

name: Rename an export policy
description: An existing export policy is given a new name.

name: Reorder a home directory search path
description: Changes the position of a home directory search path in an SVM's search path list.

name: Reset and rediscover domain controllers
description: The SMB server discards its discovered domain controller and LDAP server information and rediscovers them.

name: Reset and rediscover trusted domains
description: The SMB server rediscovers the trusted domains used for multidomain name-mapping searches.

name: Reset the password of a local SMB user
description: Set a new password for a local Windows (SMB) user on an SVM.

name: Reset the SMB server domain account password
description: The machine account password of the SMB server in the Active Directory domain is reset using domain administrator credentials.

name: Stop or start an SMB server
description: Changes the administrative status of an SMB server to stopped or started.

name: Truncate a file
description: Truncates a file in a volume to a specified size.

name: Unmount a volume
description: A volume is unmounted from its junction path in the SVM namespace.

name: Update Group Policy Object settings on an SMB server
description: Manually update or reload the Group Policy Object settings applied to an SVM SMB server.

name: Verify client access to the SMB server
description: A Windows client can reach the SMB server by its name and NetBIOS aliases.

name: Verify enabled SMB protocol versions
description: The SMB protocol versions enabled for client and domain controller connections are checked and enabled or disabled as required.

name: Verify NFS access from a client
description: An NFS administration host mounts the new volume and reads and writes a test file to confirm NFS access works.

name: Verify NFS client access from the cluster
description: Client access to exports is checked on the cluster to confirm export policy rules work as intended.

name: Verify that NFS is enabled on an SVM
description: The NFS protocol is confirmed as allowed and enabled on an SVM, and the protocol list is corrected if needed.

name: Verify that the SMB protocol is enabled on the SVM
description: SMB is confirmed as an allowed protocol on the SVM, enabling it if necessary.

name: Verify user access to an SMB share
description: A permitted user maps the share from a Windows client and can create, write and delete a test file.

name: View BranchCache configuration
description: The BranchCache configuration of SVMs and SMB shares is displayed.

name: View file locks
description: Display the file locks held on an SVM or volume, including lock type and state, byte-range, share, delegation and opportunistic (oplock) locks (CLI vserver locks show; REST GET /protocols/locks).

name: View global name service cache settings
description: Retrieve the global name service cache setting.

name: View Group Policy Object configurations
description: Displays the GPO settings defined in Active Directory and applied to the SMB server, including BranchCache GPO settings.

name: View group-membership cache settings
description: Retrieve the name-service group-membership cache settings for all SVMs or for a given SVM.

name: View local SMB groups
