name: Enable snapshot locking on an existing volume
description: Turn on tamperproof snapshot locking for an existing volume.

name: Enable WORM on a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: Activate WORM storage on a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system and set the retention period for the cluster Compliance Clock.

name: Initialize the SnapLock Compliance Clock
description: Initialize the SnapLock Compliance Clock on each node.

name: Lock an existing snapshot
description: Apply or change the SnapLock expiration time of an existing snapshot so it cannot be deleted before that time.

name: Mirror WORM files for disaster recovery
description: A SnapLock volume containing WORM files is replicated to a destination with SnapMirror for disaster recovery.

name: Modify ARP snapshot settings

name: Modify the default retention period of an S3 bucket

name: Respond to abnormal activity detected by ARP
description: Review ransomware alerts and mark the suspected activity as a real attack or a false positive.

name: Resume ARP on a volume
description: Restart ransomware monitoring on a volume or storage unit where it was paused.

name: Review ransomware abnormal activity details
description: Inspect the details, timing, severity and entropy statistics of abnormal activity flagged by Autonomous Ransomware Protection on a volume.

name: Set the default SnapLock retention period
description: Set the default retention period applied to files committed to WORM on a SnapLock volume.

name: Set the retention time for a WORM file
description: Explicitly set a file's retention time by modifying its last access time before committing it to WORM.

name: Set the SnapLock autocommit period
description: Set the autocommit period of a SnapLock volume so files are committed to WORM automatically after they stop changing.

name: Switch ARP from learning mode to active mode
description: Move a volume's Autonomous Ransomware Protection from learning mode to active mode manually.

name: Update the ARP package

name: Verify SnapLock settings
description: Generate and display a file fingerprint to verify the SnapLock type and retention settings of a file.

name: View the ARP package version

name: View volume data entropy statistics
description: Retrieves anti-ransomware data entropy statistics for volumes.

name: Add a restricted command for dynamic authorization

name: Configure role-based access for File System Analytics

name: Configure SMB signing and sealing

name: Configure Storage-Level Access Guard

name: Configure the guest UNIX user for SMB

name: Configure the login banner

name: Configure the message of the day

name: Create a group-to-role mapping

name: Create a name mapping

name: Create a self-signed certificate

name: Remove a WebAuthn MFA credential
description: A registered WebAuthn MFA credential is deleted for a user or group.

name: Remove an SVM connection from the Antivirus Connector
description: An SVM connection is removed from the Antivirus Connector configuration.

name: Remove Cisco Duo configuration
description: Delete the Cisco Duo two-factor authentication configuration (Duo profile) from the cluster or an SVM.

name: Remove members from a local SMB group
description: Removes members from a local SMB group.

name: Remove privileges from SMB users or groups
description: Removes one or more privileges from a local or domain user or group on an SVM.

name: Remove Storage-Level Access Guard
description: Storage-Level Access Guard security is removed from a volume or qtree.

name: Remove the certificate association from an SSH public key
description: Remove the X.509 certificate linked to an administrator's SSH public key and keep the key itself.

name: Renew a certificate
description: Renew an expiring or expired client/server or trusted CA certificate.

name: Renew a local certificate authority
description: A local certificate authority (or client/server) certificate is renewed before it expires.

name: Renew a trusted certificate authority
description: A trusted certificate authority certificate is renewed.

name: Replace ONTAP Mediator self-signed certificates with third-party certificates
description: Replace the ONTAP Mediator self-signed certificates with certificates signed by a trusted third-party CA.

name: Request approval for a protected operation
description: A multi-admin verification request is submitted so approvers can authorize a protected operation.

name: Reset a user's trust score
description: The dynamic authorization trust score of a user is reset.

name: Reset privileges of SMB users or groups
description: Resets the privileges of a local or domain user or group to the defaults.

name: Reset the status of scanned files
description: The scanned status of files is reset so they are scanned again on next access.

name: Reset the TOTP secret key
description: A new TOTP secret key is created for a user account after the old key is lost.

name: Rotate audit event logs
description: Manually rotates the SVM audit event logs so the current events are available to view.

name: Run a Vscan on-demand task immediately
description: An on-demand virus scan task runs immediately instead of waiting for its schedule.

name: Sanitize spare disks
description: Spare disks are non-cryptographically sanitized by overwriting so their data cannot be recovered.

name: Schedule a Vscan on-demand task
description: Assigns a schedule to an existing Vscan on-demand task so scans run automatically.

name: Secure NAS client access with Kerberos
description: Root volume permissions and Kerberos are configured so that NAS client access to the storage VM is authenticated through Kerberos.

name: Secure or unsecure a FibreBridge bridge
description: Enable or disable the secure mode of a FibreBridge bridge from ONTAP and save and restart the bridge configuration.

name: Select buckets for S3 auditing
description: Creates an audit event selector that specifies which bucket and access types are audited.

name: Set the SMB server minimum authentication security level
description: The SMB server accepts only the chosen minimum LM/NTLM/Kerberos authentication level.

name: Set up certificate-based API access
description: Generate and install a client certificate and create a login so that API clients authenticate with the certificate.

name: Set up IAM roles for Cloud Volumes ONTAP nodes
description: Create AWS IAM policies and roles with the permissions required by Cloud Volumes ONTAP nodes and the HA mediator.

name: Sign a certificate signing request
description: Sign a CSR with a local certificate authority on the cluster to produce a signed certificate.

name: Update domain user and group names in local databases
description: Domain user and group names stored in the SVM's local SMB databases are refreshed after renames in Active Directory.

name: Verify IPv6 firewall entries after an ONTAP revert
description: Compare firewall policies with the defaults and add any missing IPv6 entries after reverting.

name: Verify LDAP sources in the name service switch
description: The SVM name service switch table is checked and updated so LDAP is listed as a source for name services.

name: Verify that Kerberos and NTLMv2 authentication are permitted for SMB
description: SMB export policies are confirmed as disabled, and both Kerberos and NTLMv2 authentication are confirmed as allowed for nondisruptive Hyper-V or SQL Server over SMB.

name: Verify the ONTAP Mediator package code signature
description: The code-signing certificate, trust chain, timestamps, and signature of the ONTAP Mediator package are verified before installation.

name: Verify the SSH configuration on a switch
description: Confirm that SSH and SSH keys are enabled on a switch so ONTAP can collect switch logs.

name: Verify UNIX permissions for NFS Kerberos
description: The SVM root volume permissions and local UNIX users and groups are checked for NFS Kerberos access.

name: View Active Directory computer accounts
description: The Active Directory account details are displayed for one SVM or all SVMs.

name: View audit log forwarding destinations
description: Displays the remote syslog or Splunk servers configured to receive audit logs.

name: View audit policies on files and directories
description: Display the audit policies (SACLs) applied to files and directories on an SVM volume.

name: View bulk import status of SMB local users and groups
description: The status of a bulk import of SMB local users, groups and privileges is retrieved, including failure details.

name: View central access policies
description: Displays the Dynamic Access Control central access policies defined in Active Directory or applied to the SMB server.

name: View central access policy rules
description: Displays the central access policy rules associated with central access policies defined in Active Directory or applied to the SMB server.

name: View certificates
description: List the installed certificates and their details, including default certificates for TLS applications.

name: View Cisco Duo configuration
description: Display the Cisco Duo two-factor authentication configuration (Duo profile) of the cluster or an SVM.

name: View Duo groups
description: Display the Duo groups configured for Cisco Duo multifactor authentication.

name: View EMS role-based configurations
description: Retrieve the EMS role-based configuration of access-control roles.

name: View file and directory security settings
description: Display the security descriptor, permissions and ACLs applied to files and directories on an SVM volume.

name: View FIPS compliance status
description: The current FIPS compliance status of the cluster is displayed.

name: View FPolicy configuration
description: The complete FPolicy configuration of one SVM or all SVMs is displayed.

name: View FPolicy engines
description: Retrieve FPolicy external engine configurations for an SVM.

name: View FPolicy events
description: Retrieve FPolicy event configurations for an SVM.

name: View FPolicy persistent stores
description: Retrieve FPolicy persistent store configurations for an SVM.

name: View FPolicy policies
description: Display FPolicy policy configurations and their status for an SVM.

name: View FPolicy server connections
description: Display the status of connections to external FPolicy servers.

name: View group-to-role mappings
description: List the group-to-role mapping entries.

name: View iSCSI initiator security settings
description: Display the default and initiator-specific iSCSI authentication (CHAP) credentials and security settings.

name: View JIT privilege settings
description: The cluster's configured just-in-time privilege settings are displayed.

name: View JIT privilege user configurations
description: Retrieve the just-in-time privilege session configurations for users.

name: View Kerberos interface configurations
description: The Kerberos configuration of the SVM's network interfaces is retrieved.

name: View Kerberos realms
description: Kerberos realm configurations are retrieved.

name: View LDAP schemas
description: Display LDAP schemas, all or a specific schema for a given SVM and name.

name: View local UNIX groups
description: The local UNIX group configurations on SVMs are displayed, optionally filtered by group name.

name: View local UNIX users
description: The local UNIX user configurations for all SVMs, one SVM or one user are displayed.

name: View login messages
description: The configured login banner and message of the day for the cluster or SVMs are displayed.

name: View members of a local UNIX group
description: The users in a local UNIX group, or one specific user in it, are displayed.

name: View multi-admin verification approval groups
description: Multi-admin verification approval groups and their members are displayed.

name: View multi-admin verification global settings
description: The cluster-wide multi-admin verification settings are displayed.

name: View multi-admin verification requests
description: Pending and completed multi-admin verification requests are displayed.

name: View multi-admin verification rules
description: The multi-admin verification rules and the operations they protect are displayed.

name: View NAS auditing configuration
description: Display or retrieve the NAS (SMB/NFS) auditing configuration for one SVM or all SVMs in the cluster.

name: View netgroup cache settings
description: The netgroup cache settings for all SVMs or a given SVM are retrieved.

name: View OAuth 2.0 configurations
description: The OAuth 2.0 authorization server configurations on the cluster are displayed.

name: View OAuth 2.0 status
description: Whether OAuth 2.0 authorization is enabled on the cluster is displayed.

name: View privileges of SMB users and groups
description: Displays the privilege overrides assigned to local or domain users and groups on SVMs.

name: View role privileges
description: Retrieve the privilege tuples and access levels of an access-control role.

name: View roles
description: Retrieve configured access-control roles, including REST and legacy custom roles.

name: View S3 audit configuration
description: Display the S3 auditing configuration of one SVM or all SVMs in the cluster.

name: View security group configurations
description: Retrieve all group configurations used for access control.

name: View SMB server security settings
description: Displays the security settings configured on an SMB server, such as Kerberos, signing, encryption and password settings.

name: View SSH public keys of user accounts
description: Display the public keys configured for user accounts.

name: View Storage-Level Access Guard settings
description: Displays the Storage-Level Access Guard security applied to volumes and qtrees.

name: View supported WebAuthn algorithms
description: Display the public key algorithms supported for WebAuthn MFA.

name: View SVM LDAP configurations
description: Display the LDAP client configuration of one or all SVMs, optionally filtered by settings such as StartTLS or site-restricted discovery.

name: View SVM NIS configurations
description: Display the NIS domain configuration of one or all SVMs, optionally filtered by bound servers.

name: View the cluster LDAP configuration
description: Display the cluster-level LDAP server configuration.

name: View the cluster NIS configuration
description: Display the cluster-level NIS configuration.

name: View the data SVM proxy for domain authentication of cluster accounts
description: Retrieve which data SVM tunnels domain authentication for cluster accounts.

name: View the dynamic authorization trust score
description: The current user's dynamic authorization trust score is displayed.

name: View the effective permissions of a file
description: The effective permissions a user has on a specific file or folder are shown.

name: View the SAML default metadata configuration
description: The default SAML service provider metadata configuration is displayed.

name: View the SAML service provider configuration
description: The SAML service provider configuration of the cluster is displayed.

name: View the SSH security configuration
description: Display the SSH server security settings (ciphers, key exchange algorithms, MAC algorithms) configured for the cluster or for an SVM.

name: View TOTP profiles
description: Retrieve the TOTP profiles configured for user accounts, all or a specific one.

name: View user accounts
description: Retrieve the configured administrator login accounts and their details, optionally filtered by application or authentication method.

name: View Vscan configurations
description: Display the Vscan configurations for all SVMs or a particular SVM.

name: View Vscan on-access and on-demand policies
description: The Vscan on-access or on-demand policies of an SVM are displayed with all fields.

name: View Vscan on-access policies
description: The configuration of an on-access scanning policy on an SVM is retrieved.

name: View Vscan on-demand policies
description: The configuration of an on-demand scanning policy on an SVM is retrieved.

name: View Vscan scanner pools
description: Display the Vscan scanner pools of an SVM.

name: View Vscan server connection status
description: Display the connection status of Vscan servers.

name: View web services configuration
description: Display the cluster-wide web services configuration, including settings such as HSTS state and maximum age.

name: View web services security configuration
description: The web services security settings of an SVM are displayed.

name: View WebAuthn global settings
description: Display the WebAuthn MFA global settings for the cluster or an SVM.

name: View WebAuthn MFA credentials
description: Display the registered WebAuthn multifactor authentication credentials.

name: Cable controller FC-VI and HBA ports to MetroCluster FC switches
description: Cable each controller module's FC-VI and HBA ports to the correct MetroCluster FC switch ports for the switch model.

name: Cable controller ports in a MetroCluster IP configuration
description: Cable controller cluster peering, management and data ports in a MetroCluster IP configuration.

name: Cable controllers and storage shelves in a SAS-attached stretch MetroCluster configuration
description: Cable the FC-VI and SAS ports that connect controllers and storage shelves in a SAS-attached stretch MetroCluster configuration.

name: Cable FC-to-SAS bridges to SAS disk shelves in a MetroCluster FC configuration
description: Daisy-chain IOM12 disk shelves, set shelf IDs, and cable the shelf stacks to FibreBridge bridges in a MetroCluster FC configuration.

name: Cable FC-VI connections between stretch MetroCluster controllers
description: Cable the FC-VI ports connecting the controllers to each other in a bridge-attached stretch MetroCluster configuration.

name: Cable MetroCluster IP switches
description: Cable the MetroCluster IP switches using the platform port tables, including multi-DR-group (eight-node) configurations.

name: Cable SAS controller-to-stack connections using a cabling worksheet
description: Fill out and follow a SAS cabling worksheet to cable controller port pairs to shelf stacks.

name: Cable storage system hardware for a new installation
description: Cable a new storage system's cluster/HA, host network, management network and shelf or storage-switch connections during initial installation.

name: Cable the cluster interconnect
description: The cluster interconnect ports are cabled between the controller modules, or to the cluster interconnect switches.

name: Cable the cluster peering connections
description: At least two ports per controller are cabled for cluster peering, and their network connectivity to the partner cluster is verified.

name: Cable the HA interconnect in a MetroCluster FC configuration
description: Cable the HA interconnect between HA partner controllers in separate chassis at each MetroCluster FC site.

name: Configure an ONTAP Select host to use NVMe drives
description: Configure the hypervisor host to recognize NVMe drives for software RAID before installing ONTAP Select Deploy.

name: Configure FC switches manually for a MetroCluster FC configuration
description: Configure the FC switch settings (virtual fabric, payload, port speeds, licensed ports) required for a MetroCluster FC configuration.

name: Configure FC-to-SAS bridges
description: FC-to-SAS bridges are configured with management IP settings, bridge name, FC connection mode and data rate, and SNMP for use in a MetroCluster configuration.

name: Configure initial Unified Manager settings
description: Completes the first-time Unified Manager setup, covering AutoSupport, NTP, maintenance-user email and SMTP, and adds clusters to monitor.

name: Configure protocols on a cluster
description: Start configuring NAS or SAN protocols on the cluster from the dashboard.

name: Configure the management network during cluster setup
description: Set the cluster management, node management and Service Processor IP addresses (with DNS and NTP details) on the network page of the cluster setup wizard.

name: Configure the MetroCluster IP relationship between sites
description: The connection between the two cluster sites is configured and saved, forming the MetroCluster IP configuration.

name: Configure the MetroCluster software in ONTAP
description: Gather the IP network information and configure the nodes into a two-site MetroCluster configuration in ONTAP.

name: Deploy a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: Subscribe through a cloud marketplace or NetApp Console and deploy a new Cloud Volumes ONTAP system managed from NetApp Console.

name: Deploy an ONTAP Select cluster
description: Deploy an ONTAP Select cluster (production or 90-day evaluation, single-node or multi-node) using the Deploy web UI, CLI or evaluation OVF template.

name: Deploy Cloud Volumes ONTAP in AWS secret regions
description: Set up networking, permissions, AWS KMS and the Console agent, then deploy Cloud Volumes ONTAP in AWS Secret Cloud or Top Secret Cloud.

name: Download ONTAP Select evaluation software
description: Register for access and download the ONTAP Select evaluation software.

name: Enable VMOrchestratorZonalMultiFD for Cloud Volumes ONTAP in Azure
description: Register the Microsoft.Compute/VMOrchestratorZonalMultiFD feature in the Azure subscription for single-node zonal Cloud Volumes ONTAP deployments.

name: Implement the MetroCluster configuration
description: The metrocluster configure command is run to start MetroCluster data protection and the configuration is verified from both sites.

name: Install and cable SAS disk shelves for a new system
description: Physically install and cable SAS disk shelves as part of a new system installation.

name: Install and set up a storage system
description: Complete the full installation of a storage system, covering preparation, racking the hardware, cabling the controllers to networks and shelves, and initial system setup.

name: Install MetroCluster Tiebreaker dependencies
description: Install and configure the host prerequisites for Tiebreaker (JDK, MySQL or MariaDB, Vault) and enable database autostart.

name: Install MetroCluster Tiebreaker software
description: Install or upgrade the MetroCluster Tiebreaker software package on a Linux host.

name: Install ONTAP Select Deploy
description: Download, verify and deploy the ONTAP Select Deploy virtual machine and sign in to its web interface.

name: Install storage system hardware in a rack
description: Install the storage system controllers and shelves in a cabinet or rack (AFF, ASA r2, AFX and other platforms).

name: Install switch hardware
description: Physically rack or cabinet-mount, cable and power on a cluster, storage or shared network switch, including its rails and pass-through panel where applicable.

name: Install the switch operating system
description: Download and install the switch operating system software (such as NX-OS, EFOS or Cumulus Linux) on a cluster, storage, shared or MetroCluster IP Ethernet switch.

name: Perform the initial configuration of a switch
description: Perform the initial setup of an ONTAP cluster, storage, or shared cluster/storage switch (management IP, credentials, RCF).

name: Power on and configure the cluster switches for a new storage system
description: The cluster switches for a new storage system are cabled to power and to each other with ISL cables, powered on and configured to support the storage system.

name: Power on the storage system
description: Power on the storage system's shelves and controllers after installation or a shutdown.

name: Prepare a hypervisor host for ONTAP Select
description: Prepare the ESXi or KVM hypervisor host, including storage pools where required, and review the cluster configuration before deploying ONTAP Select.

name: Prepare a switch for OS software and RCF installation
description: Check the cluster or storage ports, interfaces and cluster health and suppress AutoSupport cases before installing switch OS software and the RCF.

name: Prepare to install a storage system
description: Prepare the site, unpack the boxes and register the storage system before installing its hardware.

name: Rack MetroCluster hardware components
description: Plan the placement of the MetroCluster components and install the controllers, switches or bridges, and disk shelves in the rack or cabinet.

name: Set up a new cluster
description: Create a new ONTAP cluster, join its nodes and complete the initial networking, services, support and storage setup, using System Manager or the CLI.

name: Set up the ONTAP cluster at each MetroCluster site
description: Create and initialize the ONTAP cluster at each site of a MetroCluster configuration (cluster management and node management networks, DNS, NTP), using the CLI cluster setup wizard or System Manager.

name: Verify VMware environment requirements for Unified Manager
description: Confirm the VMware infrastructure meets sizing and interoperability requirements before installing Unified Manager.

name: Add an attribute to a LUN
description: A name/value attribute is added to a LUN.

name: Add capacity to a local tier
description: Add disks to an existing local tier (aggregate) to increase its capacity, optionally choosing the RAID group or simulating the expansion first.

name: Add SSD cache to a local tier to create a Flash Pool
description: Convert an HDD local tier (aggregate) into a Flash Pool local tier by adding physical SSDs or SSD storage pool allocation units as cache.

name: Add SSDs to a storage pool
description: Add SSDs to an existing ONTAP SSD storage pool to increase its capacity.

name: Add tags to a volume
description: Add or modify ONTAP resource tags (key:value) on a volume.

name: Assess physical storage requirements before provisioning client storage
description: Check that local tiers (aggregates) have enough free space for the planned NFS, SMB or S3 storage, and add disks or local tiers if needed.

name: Assign array LUNs to a node
description: Assign ownership of unassigned or spare array LUNs to a selected node so it can use them.

name: Assign disk ownership
description: Assign unowned disks, drives or shelves to a node, or change the owning node, optionally choosing the disk pool (pool 0 or pool 1, as MetroCluster requires).

name: Assign local tiers to an SVM
description: Restrict the local tiers (aggregates) an SVM can use for its volumes by setting the SVM's assigned local tier list (aggr-list), for example on an SVM DR destination SVM.

name: Change the caching method of a FlexCache volume
description: The caching method of a cache volume is changed.

name: Change the pool assignment of a disk
description: Changes the pool (pool0 or pool1) to which an owned or unowned disk belongs.

name: Change the status of a FlexCache volume
description: Sets a FlexCache volume online, offline or restricted.

name: Change the status of a FlexGroup volume
description: Sets a FlexGroup volume online, offline or restricted.

name: Change the status of a volume
description: Sets a FlexVol volume online, offline or restricted.

name: Choose the SVM on which to provision a volume
description: Decides whether to provision a new volume on an existing configured SVM, an SVM needing protocol configuration, or a new SVM.

name: Clone an NVMe namespace
description: Create a copy of an existing NVMe namespace and set the subsystem mapping for the clone.

name: Configure volume provisioning options for SAN
description: Sets space guarantee, fractional reserve and related provisioning options on a volume that holds LUNs.

name: Convert a directory to a qtree
description: Turns an existing directory in a FlexVol volume into a qtree by renaming it, creating a qtree with the original name and moving the contents into it.

name: Convert a FlexVol volume to a FlexGroup volume
description: An existing FlexVol volume is converted in place to a FlexGroup volume.

name: Convert a local tier from RAID-DP to RAID-TEC
description: Changes the RAID policy of a local tier from RAID-DP to RAID-TEC for triple-parity protection.

name: Convert a local tier from RAID-TEC to RAID-DP
description: Changes the RAID policy of a local tier from RAID-TEC to RAID-DP.

name: Convert a LUN into an NVMe namespace
description: An existing LUN is converted in place into an NVMe namespace.

name: Create a FlexCache volume
description: A FlexCache volume is created that caches data from an origin volume, with the cluster and SVM peering it needs.

name: Create a FlexCache volume with write-back enabled
description: A new FlexCache volume is created in write-back mode, so writes are acknowledged at the cache.

name: Create a FlexClone file
description: A space-efficient FlexClone copy of a file is created within a volume.

name: Create a FlexClone volume
description: Create a writable FlexClone volume from a parent FlexVol or FlexGroup volume, optionally from one of its snapshots.

name: Create a FlexGroup volume
description: Create and provision a FlexGroup volume, specifying its properties.

name: Create a FlexGroup volume with NAS access and an S3 NAS bucket
description: A FlexGroup volume with NFS and SMB access is created together with an S3 NAS bucket and S3 access policies.

name: Create a FlexVol volume with NAS access and an S3 NAS bucket
description: A FlexVol volume with NFS and SMB access is created together with an S3 NAS bucket and S3 access policies.

name: Create a local tier
description: Creates a new local tier (aggregate) from spare disks, either from system recommendations or with manually chosen disks and RAID configuration.

name: Create a LUN
description: Create a LUN (an ASA r2 storage unit or a Workload Factory block device), optionally in a new volume and mapped to an initiator group.

name: Create a mirrored local tier
description: Create a SyncMirror-mirrored local tier (data aggregate) with two plexes.

name: Create a qtree
description: Create a qtree inside a volume on an SVM.

name: Create a SnapLock FlexClone volume
description: Create a FlexClone volume with a specified SnapLock type from a parent volume.

name: Create a symbolic link in a volume
description: A symbolic link pointing to a relative path is created in a volume.

name: Create a volume
description: Create a FlexVol data volume on an SVM, optionally setting its local tier, security style, junction path, export policy and tiering policy.

name: Create an NVMe namespace
description: Create an NVMe namespace of a given size in an SVM.

name: Create an SSD storage pool
description: Create an ONTAP SSD storage pool whose allocation units provide Flash Pool cache to local tiers.

name: Create an unmirrored data aggregate in a MetroCluster configuration
description: Enable unmirrored aggregate deployment, assign the new shelf drives and create an unmirrored data aggregate on a MetroCluster node.

name: Delete a FlexCache volume
description: A FlexCache volume and its FlexCache relationship are removed.

name: Delete a FlexGroup volume
description: A FlexGroup volume is deleted.

name: Delete a LUN
description: Unmap and permanently delete a LUN (an ASA r2 storage unit, or a Workload Factory FSx for ONTAP block device) from an SVM to free its space.

name: Delete a LUN attribute
description: An attribute is removed from a LUN.

name: Delete a qtree
description: Delete a qtree from a volume.

name: Delete a storage pool
description: Remove a storage pool from the cluster.

name: Delete a volume
description: Take a FlexVol volume offline and delete it when it is no longer needed; this also applies to encrypted volumes.

name: Delete an aggregate
description: One or more aggregates are deleted from the cluster.

name: Delete an application
description: A provisioned application and its storage are deleted.

name: Determine the volume and LUN configuration combination
description: A decision tree guides the choice of volume and LUN space provisioning settings for the environment.

name: Disable automatic drive assignment
description: Check whether automatic drive assignment is on and turn it off so that drive ownership can be assigned manually.

name: Disable write-back on a FlexCache volume
description: Turns off write-back mode on a FlexCache volume so writes go directly to the origin.

name: Enable automatic drive assignment
description: Automatic drive assignment is turned on so MetroCluster nodes take ownership of their pool drives automatically.

name: Enable file access time updates on a FlexCache volume
description: A FlexCache volume updates file access times at a configured frequency.

name: Enable FlexCache write-back
description: FlexCache write-back is enabled on an existing FlexCache volume.

name: Enable global file locking on FlexCache volumes
description: Global file locking is enabled from the origin so that locks are honoured across all FlexCache volumes.

name: Enable large volume and large file support
description: Modifies an existing volume to support large volume and large file sizes.

name: Increase Flash Pool cache by adding SSDs
description: SSDs are added to an existing Flash Pool aggregate to increase its cache size.

name: Increase the size of a LUN
description: Resize a LUN (a Workload Factory block device) to a larger capacity, then rescan it on the host so the extra space can be used.

name: Manage aggregates on a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system
description: View aggregate information, add disks to, or delete aggregates on a Cloud Volumes ONTAP system.

name: Manage volumes
description: Overview of the actions available for managing volumes from the volume list.

name: Mirror an aggregate
description: Add a second plex to an existing unmirrored aggregate (local tier), such as a node root aggregate, from disks in the other pool so that its data is protected by SyncMirror.

name: Modify a FlexCache volume
description: The properties of an existing FlexCache volume, such as its name, permissions, aggregates or efficiency settings, are changed.

name: Modify a FlexGroup volume
description: Properties of a FlexGroup volume, such as its name or settings, are changed.

name: Modify a LUN
description: Edit the properties of an existing LUN (ASA r2 storage unit), such as its name, size, QoS policy or host mapping.

name: Modify a LUN attribute
description: The value of an existing LUN attribute is changed.

name: Modify a qtree
description: Change the properties of an existing qtree.

name: Modify an application
description: The storage size of a provisioned application is changed.

name: Modify an NVMe namespace
description: Change properties of an existing NVMe namespace, such as its comment or subsystem association.

name: Modify disk ownership auto-assignment settings
description: The automatic disk ownership assignment policy is changed and verified.

name: Modify FlexCache origin volume options
description: The options of a FlexCache origin volume are updated.

name: Modify RAID group size
description: The maximum RAID group size of a local tier is customized.

name: Modify the RAID configuration of a local tier
description: Edit an existing local tier's RAID type and RAID group size; the older System Manager dialog also allows renaming the local tier.

name: Modify volume properties
description: Update the attributes and properties of an existing volume.

name: Move a FlexGroup volume constituent
description: A FlexGroup constituent is moved to a different aggregate.

name: Move a LUN
description: Move a LUN to another volume within the SVM, for example to balance load, and track the move to completion.

name: Move a metadata volume in a MetroCluster configuration
description: A MetroCluster metadata volume is moved from its current aggregate to an eligible target aggregate.

name: Move a storage unit
description: Moves a storage unit to another storage availability zone.

name: Move a volume
description: Move a volume nondisruptively to a different local tier (aggregate) or node within the same SVM.

name: Move files between volumes
description: Move one or more files from one FlexVol volume to another.

name: Prepopulate a FlexCache volume
description: Data from the origin is loaded into a FlexCache volume before clients request it.

name: Provision application storage from a template
description: Storage for an application such as SAP HANA is provisioned from a basic application template.

name: Provision NAS storage for NFS and SMB
description: A volume is added to a storage VM enabled for NFS and SMB and its export and share are verified from Linux and Windows clients.

name: Provision NVMe storage
description: Create NVMe namespaces and subsystems, add host NQNs and map the namespaces so NVMe hosts can use the storage.

name: Provision SAN storage
description: Enable the FC or iSCSI protocol, create LIFs, create LUNs and igroups, and map the LUNs so hosts can use the storage as disks.

name: Recover a deleted volume
description: Recover an accidentally deleted volume from the recovery queue and reset its configuration.

name: Rehost a volume to another SVM
description: Move a volume from one SVM to another with volume rehost, then reapply the settings clients depend on (SMB shares, NFS junction path and export policy, LUN maps, or the SnapMirror relationship).

name: Remove ownership from a disk
description: Removes the software ownership information from a disk so it becomes unowned.

name: Rename a local tier
description: Changes the name of an existing local tier.

name: Rename a qtree
description: A qtree is renamed.

name: Resize a FlexCache volume
description: The size of a FlexCache volume is changed.

name: Resize a FlexGroup volume
description: Change the size of a FlexGroup volume by resizing it or its member constituents, expanding it with new constituents, or shrinking it.

name: Resize a volume
description: Change the size of a volume by increasing or decreasing its capacity.

name: Resize an NVMe namespace
description: Change the size of an existing NVMe namespace (increase, or decrease at advanced privilege) to a new capacity.

name: Set up an active-passive configuration on nodes with partitioned disks
description: Reassigns data partitions from the passive node to the active node so that one node of an HA pair owns all data partitions for a single large local tier.

name: Simulate adding SSD cache capacity to a local tier
description: The projected result of adding physical SSD cache capacity to a local tier is returned without making the change.

name: Simulate the creation of a storage pool
description: Preview the result of creating an SSD storage pool without creating it.

name: Simulate the expansion of a storage pool
description: Preview the result of adding disks to an existing storage pool without expanding it.

name: Split a FlexClone volume from its parent
description: Start a clone split so a FlexClone volume becomes an independent volume that no longer shares blocks with its parent.

name: Stop a FlexClone volume split operation
description: An in-progress volume clone split of a FlexClone volume is stopped.

name: Synchronize FlexCache volume properties from the origin
description: A FlexCache volume's properties are synchronized from its origin volume.

name: Take a LUN offline
description: Take a LUN offline so hosts can no longer access it.

name: Trigger the cutover of a volume move
description: Manually triggers the cutover phase of an in-progress volume move operation.

name: Update the configuration of a FlexCache relationship
description: The FlexCache relationship's configuration is refreshed from the origin.

name: Use FlexCache with an encrypted origin volume
description: Points to documentation on creating and using FlexCache volumes when the origin volume is encrypted.

name: Verify disk pool assignment in a MetroCluster configuration
description: Pool 0 and pool 1 drives are confirmed to be assigned to the correct nodes, with any missing assignments corrected.

name: View disks
description: List the disks in the cluster, or retrieve one disk, with details such as disk and partition ownership.

name: View drive and RAID group information for a local tier
description: Display the drives of a local tier by RAID group, including drive type, size, status and whether cache comes from an SSD storage pool (storage aggregate show-status).

name: View file move operations
description: Retrieve the status and details of file move operations.

name: View files and directories in a volume
description: List the files and directories in a volume and retrieve the properties of a file or directory, such as size, bytes used, times, permissions, and QoS or analytics fields (GET /storage/volumes/{uuid}/files/{path}).

name: View FlexCache connection status
description: Retrieve the connection status between FlexCache volumes and their origins.

name: View FlexCache origin volumes
description: Retrieve the attributes of FlexCache origin volumes.

name: View FlexCache volumes
description: Display FlexCache (cache) volumes and their attributes, including origin volume and SVM, relationship status, available capacity and write mode.

name: View FlexGroup volume constituents
description: The constituents of a FlexGroup volume are listed.

name: View FlexGroup volumes
description: Shows details of FlexGroup volumes.

name: View local tiers
description: List local tiers (aggregates) and view their details and metrics.

name: View LUN attributes
description: The attributes set on a LUN are displayed.

name: View NVMe namespaces
description: List NVMe namespaces, or show the details of one.

name: View plexes of a local tier
description: Retrieve the plexes of one or all local tiers.

name: View qtrees
description: List the qtrees in a volume or SVM, or show the properties of one.

name: View recommended aggregate configurations
description: Gets the data aggregates the system recommends creating on the cluster.

name: View spare disks and their usable capacity
description: List the spare disks and partitions, with their counts and usable size, to decide how many disks a local tier needs.

name: View storage pools
description: Display the ONTAP storage pools on the cluster or the details of a specific pool.

name: View the expansion recommendation for a local tier
description: Retrieve ONTAP's recommended data local tier expansion based on the disks present in the system.

name: View the FlexClone volume hierarchy
description: Shows the hierarchy of FlexClone volumes and their parent volumes.

name: View the target of a symbolic link
description: The target path of a symbolic link in a volume is retrieved.

name: View volumes
description: List volumes or view a volume's attributes, optionally filtered, for example to see which volumes reside on a given local tier.

name: Zero spare disks
description: Zero all non-zeroed spares, both disks and array LUNs, on a node or across the cluster so they are ready for use in new local tiers.

name: Access node log, core dump, and MIB files
description: Browse a node's log, core dump, and MIB files (including System Manager logs) through the spi web service of the cluster management LIF.

name: Check a cluster configuration for errors with Config Advisor
description: Download and run Config Advisor against the cluster or MetroCluster configuration, then review its output and follow its recommendations to correct configuration errors.

name: Configure AutoSupport settings
description: Modify the AutoSupport configuration, such as transport, recipient addresses and SMTP encryption.

name: Continue a transition after ignorable errors
description: Ignorable errors are acknowledged and the transition operation is rerun.

name: Correct misaligned spare partitions
description: Replaces a disk holding a spare data partition with one holding a spare root partition so spare root and data partitions are on the same disk.

name: Create a MetroCluster Tiebreaker dump file
description: A dump file capturing the overall monitoring status is created from the Tiebreaker CLI for troubleshooting.

name: Delete a core dump
description: Deletes a node's core dump file.

name: Download transition log files
description: Logs for all or selected transition projects are collected and downloaded.

name: Enable AutoSupport for the Deploy utility
description: The AutoSupport feature of the ONTAP Select Deploy utility is turned on.

name: Enable or disable AutoSupport
description: Turn AutoSupport messaging on or off for the cluster.

name: Enable verbose logging for NVMe/FC host drivers
description: Set the host FC driver logging parameters and reboot so detailed NVMe/FC events are logged for troubleshooting.

name: Generate a Deploy utility AutoSupport package
description: An AutoSupport package for the ONTAP Select Deploy utility is generated and downloaded.

name: Look up AutoSupport message descriptions
description: Descriptions of AutoSupport messages are looked up in the Syslog Translator.

name: Reallocate LIFs on invalid ports after a controller upgrade
description: Resynchronize MetroCluster SVMs so that LIFs placed on invalid ports after a controller upgrade are reallocated to correct ports.

name: Recover a 7-Mode transition that failed due to MetroCluster switchover or switchback
description: After switchback completes, the transition SnapMirror relationships are re-created and the failed 7-Mode transition operation is rerun.

name: Recover an incorrectly configured cluster LIF
description: A cluster LIF created on the wrong port is fixed by resetting its home port, cleaning up the cluster broadcast domain and completing cluster creation.

name: Recover from a failed LUN transition
description: Identify LUNs that failed to transition and correct the failure as indicated by the EMS messages.

name: Recover from a node crash during a controller upgrade
description: Recover an aggregate-relocation or system-controller-replace controller upgrade after an original or new node reboots, panics or loses power at any stage: before the pre-check or Stage 2 with HA enabled, after HA is disabled, or during a resource-release or resource-regain phase.

name: Recover the Deploy utility for a two-node cluster
description: Recover a failed ONTAP Select Deploy utility instance that manages a two-node cluster, from a configuration backup or by reconfiguring a new instance, and reconfigure the mediator.

name: Relocate aggregates left on the wrong node after a controller upgrade
description: Aggregates that remained owned by the partner node after the upgrade are relocated to their intended home node.

name: Relocate failed or vetoed aggregates during a controller upgrade
description: Aggregates whose relocation failed or was vetoed during a controller upgrade are diagnosed from EMS messages and then relocated, forcing the relocation if needed.

name: Repair SAML configuration
description: Find the node where SAML configuration failed, repair it and verify that SAML is configured on all nodes.

name: Resolve unexpected storage failover show output during controller upgrade
description: Explains that unexpected storage failover show output during a controller upgrade requires no action.

name: Respond to degraded system health
description: Review system health alerts and take corrective action to restore healthy status.

name: Resume a failed transition SnapMirror baseline transfer
description: A failed 7-Mode to ONTAP SnapMirror baseline transfer is restarted from its checkpoint.

name: Resume AutoSupport case creation after maintenance
description: End a maintenance window so that AutoSupport support case generation resumes, by sending a MAINT=end AutoSupport message or using the resume option in System Manager.

name: Retry a failed operation
description: A failed operation in Tracker is run again, either as it was or with edited parameters.

name: Send an AutoSupport message
description: An AutoSupport message is generated and sent from all nodes or a selected node.

name: Suppress AutoSupport case creation during maintenance
description: Suppress automatic support case creation from AutoSupport on selected nodes for a set number of hours while maintenance is performed.

name: Test AutoSupport connectivity
description: AutoSupport connectivity is checked by sending a test message or retrieving connectivity issues.

name: Trace file access to diagnose access errors
description: A file access trace on an SVM identifies the cause of file access errors so permissions can be corrected.

name: Troubleshoot a failed Cloud Volumes ONTAP marketplace deployment
description: Review deployment reports, serial logs and configuration after a failed marketplace deployment and retry the deployment.

name: Troubleshoot aggregate capacity issues
description: Aggregate capacity issues are resolved by identifying and moving volumes to another aggregate.

name: Troubleshoot an automatic unplanned failover that is not triggered
description: Service is restored on the secondary site when SnapMirror active sync automatic unplanned failover did not occur.

name: Troubleshoot AutoSupport message delivery
description: Check the AutoSupport subsystem status and diagnose and fix problems that stop AutoSupport messages from being delivered over HTTPS or SMTP.

name: Troubleshoot LIF migration failure during controller upgrade
description: LIFs that are not online after migration during a controller hardware upgrade are fixed by checking port MTU, cabling and port state.

name: Troubleshoot name service issues
description: Test host, user and group lookups through the SVM's name services and act on the results to resolve name resolution problems.

name: Unfail a disk
description: Return a failed disk to service as a spare, optionally reassimilating its file system labels.

name: Upload core dump files with AutoSupport
description: A node core dump file is uploaded to NetApp in an AutoSupport message.

name: Upload performance archive files with AutoSupport
description: Performance archive files are uploaded to NetApp in an AutoSupport message.

name: Verify name service connections
description: Check that the DNS and LDAP servers configured on an SVM are reachable and report their connection status.

name: View and submit support cases
description: Submit a new NetApp support case from the storage system and view previously submitted cases.

name: View AutoSupport configuration
description: The current AutoSupport settings are displayed.

name: View AutoSupport message history
description: The AutoSupport messages sent from cluster nodes and their status are displayed.

name: View AutoSupport subsystems and triggers
description: The AutoSupport subsystems and the trigger events that collect them are displayed.

name: View core dumps
description: Retrieve all core dumps or a specific core dump in the cluster.

name: View hardware configuration and component status
description: Shows the cluster hardware, component status and cabling, to find hardware problems.

name: View security trace filters
description: Display the security trace filter entries configured on an SVM.

name: Abort a 7-Mode transition project
description: A transition project is aborted and the ONTAP volumes and SnapMirror relationships it created are cleaned up.

name: Add 7-Mode controllers and clusters to the 7-Mode Transition Tool
description: Add the 7-Mode controllers and target clusters with their credentials to the 7-Mode Transition Tool.

name: Add an ONTAP Select image to Deploy
description: An ONTAP Select install image is uploaded to and made available in the Deploy utility.

name: Apply 7-Mode configurations to ONTAP volumes
description: Apply the transitioned 7-Mode configuration to the target ONTAP volumes and SVMs of a transition project.

name: Apply or dismiss recommended automatic updates
description: Act on individual recommended automatic updates, such as installing them now or dismissing them.

name: Assign an explicit value to the NFS v4.2-xattrs option before an ONTAP upgrade
description: The NFS v4.2-xattrs option has an explicit value set before the upgrade.

name: Attach storage shelves and reassign disk ownership to a new controller
description: Storage shelves from the original node are cabled to the replacement node and their disk ownership is reassigned to it.

name: Boot a node with replacement system modules
description: During an in-chassis controller upgrade, boot the node with the replacement modules, handle NSE drives and reassign the old node's disks to the replacement node.

name: Boot the new controllers during a MetroCluster controller upgrade
description: Boot the newly installed controllers during a MetroCluster controller upgrade and restore their configuration.

name: Choose a controller hardware upgrade procedure
description: A guide that helps the administrator pick the right controller hardware upgrade procedure for the current and target systems.

name: Collect inventory and generate an inventory report
description: Storage system and host inventory information is collected with the Inventory Collect Tool and saved as an inventory report.

name: Commit a copy-free transition project
description: Commit a copy-free transition project so that the transitioned aggregates can no longer be rolled back to 7-Mode.

name: Complete a 7-Mode transition project
description: The final data copy is done, client access is cut over and the transition project is completed.

name: Configure LIFs for a transition project
description: Select, add, edit or remove the 7-Mode IP addresses to be configured as LIFs on the SVMs after transition.

name: Configure the TCP window size for transition SnapMirror relationships
description: A SnapMirror policy with a specific TCP window size is created and applied to a transition relationship.

name: Confirm the new controllers are set up correctly after a controller upgrade
description: Storage failover is enabled and the new nodes are confirmed to be in the same cluster with correct storage access, LIFs and aggregate ownership.

name: Convert an original controller node to a drive shelf
description: During a controller upgrade, replace an original node's controller module with a shelf module so its chassis becomes a drive shelf cabled to the new node.

name: Convert Cloud Volumes ONTAP deployments to Infrastructure Manager
description: Prepare a conversion VM and service account, then run the conversion tool to move existing Google Cloud Deployment Manager deployments of Cloud Volumes ONTAP to Infrastructure Manager.

name: Create a 7-Mode transition project
description: A copy-based transition project is created with the source 7-Mode volumes and target cluster.

name: Create a data copy schedule for transition SnapMirror transfers
description: A schedule controlling when transition SnapMirror data copy operations run is created for a transition project.

name: Create a foreign LUN import relationship
description: A destination LUN is created and mapped and an import relationship is created between it and the foreign array LUN.

name: Create a transition peer relationship
description: A transition peer relationship between the 7-Mode system and the SVM is created and verified.

name: Customize the transition of 7-Mode configurations
description: Selected 7-Mode configurations are excluded or consolidated for transition to the target SVM.

name: Decommission the old system
description: Notify NetApp through the Support Site that the old controllers are no longer in operation after a controller upgrade.

name: Delete a 7-Mode transition project
description: A transition project is removed from its project group.

name: Delete a foreign LUN import relationship
description: The foreign LUN import is verified as complete and the import relationship is removed to finalize the FLI migration.

name: Delete active-active SVMs before an ONTAP revert
description: Identify and delete SVMs configured for active-active SAN multipathing so the cluster can be reverted.

name: Delete an ONTAP Select cluster
description: Take an ONTAP Select cluster offline and delete it with the Deploy utility.

name: Delete an ONTAP software package
description: A downloaded ONTAP software package is removed from the cluster package repository.

name: Determine whether a controller has aggregates on internal disk drives
description: Internal disk drives of the original controllers are checked to confirm they hold no root or data aggregates before a controller upgrade.

name: Disable ARP on SAN volumes before a revert
description: Turn off anti-ransomware protection on SAN volumes so the cluster can be reverted to an ONTAP release that does not support ARP for SAN.

name: Disable automatic updates
description: Turn off automatic software, firmware and security updates for the cluster.

name: Disable NFSv4.1 session trunking before an ONTAP revert
description: NFSv4.1 session trunking is disabled on the NFS servers so the cluster can be reverted to a release that does not support it.

name: Disconnect an existing DR group from the FC switch fabric
description: The HBA ports of the existing DR group's controllers are disabled and their cables are removed from the FC switches before recabling.

name: Discover foreign LUNs for FLI migration
description: Foreign array LUNs visible to ONTAP are identified and marked as foreign so they can be imported with FLI.

name: Download an ONTAP software image
description: Download the ONTAP software image to the cluster or a server before an upgrade.

name: Edit a 7-Mode transition project
description: The settings of an existing transition project are changed through the project wizard.

name: Enable automatic updates
description: Turn on the automatic update feature so ONTAP downloads and installs firmware, system and security updates, and choose the default action for each update type.

name: Enable snapshot policies after an ONTAP revert
description: Snapshot policies on data SVMs and node root volumes are re-enabled after the revert completes.

name: Expand a MetroCluster configuration by adding a DR group
description: Add a new DR group (four new nodes) to an existing MetroCluster FC or IP configuration and join the new nodes to the clusters.

name: Expand a two-node MetroCluster FC configuration to four nodes
description: Add a controller module at each site of a two-node MetroCluster FC configuration to form a four-node configuration with HA pairs.

name: Expand an aggregate to the 64-bit format
description: Converts a 32-bit 7-Mode aggregate to the 64-bit format in preparation for transition to ONTAP.

name: Export storage configurations and halt 7-Mode systems
description: The 7-Mode storage configuration is exported and the 7-Mode controllers are halted for the copy-free cutover.

name: Find and remove 32-bit volumes and snapshots
description: Identify and delete remaining 32-bit or mixed-format volumes and snapshots so 7-Mode data can be transitioned.

name: Gather cabling information for a copy-free transition
description: Collect 7-Mode controller and cluster node port and cabling details needed to plan the disk shelf move in a copy-free transition.

name: Gather MetroCluster configuration information before a controller upgrade
description: Record cables, keys, system IDs and port and LIF information of the existing MetroCluster nodes before replacing controllers.

name: Generate a transition assessment report
description: Generate a 7-Mode Transition Tool assessment report on whether 7-Mode controllers and hosts are ready for transition. The input can be systems added directly to the tool or an imported inventory report XML.

name: Generate an FC zone plan for transition
description: The 7-Mode Transition Tool generates an FC zone plan for the target cluster from the collected inventory.

name: Generate an ONTAP upgrade plan
description: An upgrade plan with risks, recommended path and steps is generated for the cluster.

name: Import 7-Mode data to ONTAP in a copy-free transition
description: Import the 7-Mode aggregates and volumes connected to the cluster nodes into ONTAP during a copy-free transition.

name: Import a foreign LUN with FLI
description: A foreign array LUN is imported into an ONTAP LUN with FLI, and the import progress is monitored, paused or resumed until it completes.

name: Install an ONTAP software image on the cluster nodes
description: The target ONTAP software image is installed on each node as the alternate image.

name: Install and boot a new controller node during a controller upgrade
description: Rack, cable, power on and boot the replacement node that takes over from an original node during a controller hardware upgrade.

name: Install and cable a new controller module in a MetroCluster FC configuration
description: Physically install a new controller module and cable its cluster and storage connections when expanding a MetroCluster FC cluster.

name: Install and set up new MetroCluster controller modules
description: Rack, power and cable the new MetroCluster controllers to the IP switches or storage, configure them in Maintenance mode (HA state, disk assignment, partner-sysid), and boot them to cluster setup.

name: Install firmware on a newly added controller module
description: Download and install the current firmware on a controller module added to a MetroCluster FC configuration.

name: Install switch software on MetroCluster FC switches
description: A supported switch operating system image is copied to each FC switch and installed.

name: Install the 7-Mode Transition Tool
description: Install the 7-Mode Transition Tool on a host system.

name: Install Upgrade Health Checker
description: Download, verify and set up Upgrade Health Checker with a service account so it can analyze ONTAP clusters before upgrades.

name: Join a new node to the cluster quorum when its network ports differ
description: During a controller upgrade, adds the new node's cluster ports to the Cluster broadcast domain and migrates cluster LIFs so that the node joins the quorum.

name: Log in to the 7-Mode Transition Tool
description: Open the 7-Mode Transition Tool web interface and log in.

name: Manually cut over clients after an SVM migration
description: Manually runs the client cutover of an SVM migration and verifies that the cutover finished.

name: Map ports from the old nodes to the new nodes
description: During a controller upgrade, map the physical ports, LIFs, broadcast domains and IPspaces of the old nodes onto the ports of the new nodes so the new nodes can communicate with the cluster and the network.

name: Match the ONTAP version of new nodes to the cluster during cluster expansion
description: Nodes being added to a cluster run the same ONTAP version as the existing cluster.

name: Migrate a two-node switchless cluster to a switched cluster
description: Convert a two-node switchless cluster to a switched cluster by adding cluster switches and moving the cluster ports and LIFs to them without disruption.

name: Migrate a volume to another system
description: Replicates a volume to another system with available capacity, breaks the relationship and cuts clients over to the new copy.

name: Migrate an ONTAP Select Deploy instance to a new virtual machine
description: Back up the Deploy configuration, install a new Deploy virtual machine and restore the configuration to it.

name: Migrate an ONTAP Select node to a VMFS6 datastore
description: The ONTAP Select virtual machine is moved to a VMFS6 datastore with Storage vMotion and the cluster is refreshed in Deploy.

name: Migrate cluster switches to a new switch model
description: Replace the existing cluster switches with switches of a different model or vendor by moving the cluster connections to the new switches without disruption.

name: Migrate to shared cluster and storage switches
description: Move the cluster and storage connections of an existing configuration onto a pair of shared switches that carry both cluster and storage traffic.

name: Modify 7-Mode Transition Tool configuration options
description: Edit the 7-Mode Transition Tool configuration file and restart its service to apply new option values.

name: Modify automatic update settings
description: Change the default action (update automatically, show notifications, or dismiss) for each automatic update category, such as firmware, system files or security files.

name: Modify or delete a data copy schedule for transition SnapMirror transfers
description: An existing transition data copy schedule is edited or deleted.

name: Move 7-Mode disk shelves to cluster nodes
description: Power off the 7-Mode disk shelves, disconnect them from the 7-Mode controllers and cable them to the target cluster nodes.

name: Move an FC SAN workload from MetroCluster FC nodes to MetroCluster IP nodes
description: FC SAN LUN access is moved nondisruptively to new MetroCluster IP nodes by adding FC LIFs, updating zoning and reporting nodes, and moving volumes.

name: Move Linux iSCSI hosts to new nodes
description: During a controller upgrade by volume move, Linux iSCSI hosts get connections and reporting-node paths to the new nodes and stale paths are removed.

name: Move NAS data LIFs to another node during a controller upgrade
description: During a controller upgrade, migrate NAS (non-SAN) data LIFs owned by a node being replaced to its partner or replacement node, then verify the LIFs and the SAN LIFs on the new node.

name: Move volumes to new nodes during a controller upgrade
description: Aggregates are created on the new nodes and the volumes from the original nodes are moved onto them.

name: Netboot new controller modules
description: Stage the ONTAP image on a web server and netboot a new or replacement controller module from the LOADER prompt (ifconfig e0M, netboot http://.../image.tgz, then install the software from the boot menu). Used during controller upgrades, MetroCluster expansion and disaster-site replacement.

name: Pause an SVM migration
description: Pause an in-progress SVM migration from the destination cluster.

name: Pause and resume a transition project
description: Pause a running transition project and later resume it from the 7-Mode Transition Tool dashboard.

name: Perform FLI post-migration cleanup
description: After a Foreign LUN Import the foreign LUN attributes, import relationships and backend connectivity are cleaned up so the source array is no longer used.

name: Perform FLI post-migration host remediation
description: After a Foreign LUN Import the host rediscovers the imported ONTAP LUNs and brings its volume groups, file systems and applications back online.

name: Perform FLI pre-migration host remediation
description: The SAN host is prepared for a Foreign LUN Import by identifying the source devices, quiescing applications, unmounting file systems and removing the old block devices.

name: Perform manual post-transition configuration tasks
description: Configure features that were not transitioned and verify the SVM is ready to serve data after transition.

name: Perform the final steps of a controller upgrade
description: Remove unused LIFs, ports and portset entries from the new nodes to finish a controller upgrade.

name: Plan a copy-free transition project
description: Target cluster nodes and SVM and volume mappings are selected for a copy-free transition project.

name: Pre-stage system firmware before an ONTAP upgrade
description: Download the newer service image to each node's boot device ahead of an ONTAP software upgrade.

name: Prepare 7-Mode systems and hosts for inventory collection
description: Enable HTTPS, TLS, SSL and SSH on 7-Mode systems and prepare hosts so that inventory can be collected and assessed for transition.

name: Prepare a 7-Mode system for transition
description: Configure licensing, HTTPS/TLS and cluster connectivity on the 7-Mode system or HA pair so it is ready for transition.

name: Prepare a cluster for transitioning 7-Mode volume SnapMirror relationships
description: Licenses, cluster peering and matching schedules are in place on the target clusters before transitioning 7-Mode SnapMirror relationships.

name: Prepare a host for the cutover phase of a 7-Mode LUN transition
description: Before the 7-Mode transition cutover, stop host I/O, shut down applications, and unmount, export or offline the transitioning LUNs or disks on the host.

name: Prepare a netboot server for new controller modules
description: Stage the ONTAP netboot image on a web-accessible server reachable from the controller modules.

name: Prepare an ONTAP cluster for 7-Mode transition
description: Set up LIFs, routes and connectivity on the target cluster and confirm it meets the requirements for transition.

name: Prepare for a controller upgrade by moving volumes or storage
description: Record licenses, encryption, port and LIF information on the original nodes before upgrading by moving volumes or storage.

name: Prepare manually for an ONTAP upgrade
description: Complete the manual preparation checklist, including choosing the target release and confirming support, before upgrading ONTAP.

name: Prepare snapshots before reverting a cluster
description: Disable snapshot policies and delete snapshots created after the upgrade so the cluster can be reverted.

name: Prepare the network configuration of the old controllers for a MetroCluster controller upgrade
description: Move data and intercluster LIF home ports and adjust VLANs, interface groups, and broadcast domains on the old MetroCluster controllers so their ports can be retired and the new controllers can take over.

name: Prepare the nodes for a controller upgrade
description: The original nodes are checked for resources, health, versions and configuration, and a performance baseline is captured before the controller upgrade.

name: Reassign disks from the original controller to the new controller
description: During a controller upgrade, boot the new controller (to Maintenance mode or the boot menu) and reassign the disks, including root aggregate disks, owned by the original node's system ID to the new node's system ID.

name: Reboot the SP or BMC before an ONTAP upgrade
description: The SP or BMC is rebooted so its firmware can be updated during the ONTAP upgrade.

name: Reconfigure the MetroCluster FC switch layout during a controller upgrade
description: During a controller upgrade, persistently disable the MetroCluster FC switches, determine the new cabling layout, apply the new RCFs and recable, then re-enable the switches.

name: Record original node information before a controller upgrade
description: Cluster, management, intercluster and FC port details, LIFs and broadcast domains of the original node are captured for later port mapping.

name: Refresh a MetroCluster configuration
description: Replace the controllers and storage of a four- or eight-node MetroCluster by temporarily expanding it with new nodes and then removing the old DR group.

name: Refresh cluster hardware in a SnapMirror active sync configuration
description: Replace the nodes of a cluster that participates in SnapMirror active sync by moving volumes, removing old nodes and adding new ones.

name: Refresh the MetroCluster configuration with new controllers
description: The MetroCluster configuration is refreshed so data protection starts on newly added controller modules.

name: Relocate data aggregates and data LIFs to another node during a controller upgrade
description: As a step of a controller upgrade, move the non-root (data) aggregates and data LIFs owned by one node to its partner or replacement node, then verify that the aggregates, volumes and LIFs are online on the destination node.

name: Relocate load-sharing mirror source volumes after an ONTAP upgrade
description: Load-sharing mirror source volumes that were moved during the upgrade are moved back to their original location.

name: Remediate a Windows host for foreign LUN import migration
description: Prepare Windows Hyper-V or failover-cluster hosts before an FLI migration and bring disks and clustered resources back online after it.

name: Remediate VMFS ATS/CAW mode after FLI migration
description: The ATS-only setting of VMFS datastores on ESXi hosts is reset after an FLI migration so the hosts use the correct locking mode on the imported LUNs.

name: Remove a DR group from a MetroCluster configuration
description: A DR group is removed, with storage failover disabled on its nodes and the nodes removed from each cluster.

name: Remove an ONTAP Select image from Deploy
description: An unused ONTAP Select install image is deleted from the Deploy utility.

name: Remove burst settings from QoS policy groups before revert
description: QoS policy groups that use automatic throughput-ceiling burst settings are found and modified so the cluster can be reverted to an earlier ONTAP release.

name: Remove interface configurations and uninstall old controllers
description: LIFs, VLANs, and interface groups are moved off or removed from the old controllers, which are then physically uninstalled during a controller upgrade.

name: Remove MetroCluster FC controllers after transition
description: The MetroCluster FC nodes are removed from the clusters after their aggregates and metadata volumes are deleted during transition to MetroCluster IP.

name: Remove S3 NAS bucket configuration before reverting
description: S3 NAS buckets, their name mappings and the S3 protocol are removed from SVMs so the cluster can be reverted to an earlier ONTAP release.

name: Remove the source SVM after migration
description: Clean up and delete the source SVM from the source cluster after client cutover of an SVM migration.

name: Remove volumes from a transition project
description: Volumes are removed from a transition project and the ONTAP volumes and SnapMirror relationships created for them are cleaned up.

name: Restore the FC and UTA/UTA2 port configuration on new controllers
description: In Maintenance mode on new or replacement controller modules, set the FC and UTA/UTA2 (CNA) port modes and target/initiator types with ucadmin/fcadmin to match the original controllers.

name: Restore the root volume configuration to the boot device
description: Restore configuration information from the root volume to the boot devices from the boot menu.

name: Resume an automated ONTAP upgrade after an error
description: An automated upgrade that paused on an error is resumed after the error is resolved, or cancelled to continue manually.

name: Resume an SVM migration
description: Resume a paused SVM migration and monitor its progress.

name: Retire the original node during a controller upgrade
description: The original controller is removed from service after its aggregates and LIFs have been relocated, with storage failover and cluster HA disabled as required.

name: Return a transitioned MetroCluster system to normal operation
